projecthero.miraculous.ability.pegasus_h: Spin the Horseshoe like a boomerang at what you aim at, up to 18 blocks out (it locks a creature near the crosshair). 12 damage to everything it passes, out and back, then it returns to your hand. 1.5 s cooldown after the catch.
Fling a fan of 3 small golden horseshoes. Each one hits the first creature in its path for 7 damage. 3 s cooldown.
A powerful buck: everything within 3 blocks in front of you or behind you takes 14 damage and is kicked flying. 2.5 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.pegasus_g: Charge 12 blocks along the ground in under half a second. Everything in your path takes 10 damage and is thrown aside. 6 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.pegasus_p: Step through a portal to the spot you look at, up to 20 blocks away. Only a safe spot on solid ground: never into a wall, over the void or above the Nether roof. 4 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.pegasus_g: Toggle: run with Speed III and step assist (walk straight up full blocks), leaving golden hoof prints behind you. Press again to stop.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.pegasus_p: A portal opens under the creature you aim at (24 blocks). It drops out of another portal up to 20 blocks above it and takes the fall damage. Not on bosses. 15 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.pegasus_v: Pick a destination (your bed, the world spawn, a squadmate, a waypoint) and open a big portal there for 30 s that anyone can walk through, both ways. Across worlds only players can pass. Starts the 3-minute countdown. 30 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.pegasus_p: A portal in front of you for 10 s swallows incoming projectiles and spits them out of a second portal back at the attacker. Press again to close it. 15 s cooldown after.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.pegasus_s: Run on the air for 10 s: golden hoof platforms appear under your feet. Jump to climb, sneak to sink. 20 s cooldown after.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.pegasus_m: Save the spot you stand on as a waypoint (up to 3; the oldest is replaced). They are kept with the world, and a small golden marker only you can see shows each one. The Voyage can open to them.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.pegasus_l: Portal A opens where you stand and portal B where you look (up to 32 blocks), both for 20 s. Anyone, mobs and dropped items too, can go through either one and come out of the other. 20 s cooldown after.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.viperion_: Lyre Strike

Press up to three times for a three-swing combo, as Cat Noir's Baton Strike: forehand, backhand, then an overhead finisher. 9 damage a swing to all in front (4 blocks), the last knocks back. Press again within 1 s or it starts over. 1.5 s cooldown after the third.
Lyre Sweep
One wide swing: everything within 4.5 blocks in front of you takes 12 damage and is knocked back. 5 s cooldown.
Sonic Chord
Strum once: a cone of sound 12 blocks long along your look. Everything in it takes 10 damage and is blown back. 6 s cooldown.
Resonance
A ring of sound round you: everything within 6 blocks takes 4 damage and is stunned for 2 s. 15 s cooldown.
Serpent Dash
Slither 18 blocks along the ground, low and fast, under swings and arrows; you keep your speed when it ends. No fall damage on the landing. 5 s cooldown.
Coil Leap
Coil and spring forward and up, about 17 blocks. Never any fall damage on the landing. 6 s cooldown.
Venom Strike
A fang-like jab of the Lyre: 6 damage and strong Poison (Poison III, 8 s). 5 s cooldown.
SECOND CHANCE

Set a checkpoint (it starts the countdown). For 90 s, Shift+Z again turns time back to it for the WHOLE world, every dimension: you, your squad wherever they are, every creature killed anywhere (back as it was), every block broken or placed (chests with what was in them), anything that appeared since gone, and every timer (countdown, cooldowns). Each rewind gives a fresh 90 s. 3 rewinds. A killing blow rewinds by itself.
Constrict
The Lyre's strings wrap the creature you aim at (14 blocks): rooted for 4 s and squeezed for 2.5 damage every half second. Bosses are only slowed. 12 s cooldown.
String Shield
The Lyre spins before you for 6 s: hits and projectiles from the front are blocked (arrows bounce back). 15 s cooldown.
Heat Sense
Toggle: snake infrared. Every living thing within 32 blocks glows through walls in warm colours, only for you. Press again to stop.
Hiss
A loud hiss: every mob within 10 blocks runs from you for 5 s. Bosses are not scared. 20 s cooldown.

message.projecthero.kwami_chat.tikki.cou: Hurry! Your Miraculous is about to run out!
Only one spot left -- find somewhere to hide, quick!
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.tikki.dan: I sense something dangerous nearby. Be careful!
Something is wrong here. Maybe it is time to transform?
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.tikki.hur: You are hurt! Please be careful!
Don't give up! You can do this!
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.tikki.vic: You did it! I knew you could!
That was amazing! Paris -- er, everyone -- is safe thanks to you!
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.tikki.idl: Have you got any cookies? Just asking...
Being a hero is about helping people, not about being noticed.
I believe in you. You know that, right?
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.plagg.cou: Tick tock, kid. You are about to turn back into a pumpkin.
One spot left. Don't make me miss my cheese break.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.plagg.dan: Ugh, something nasty is out there. Can we just go home?
I'd say transform, but honestly I'd rather nap.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.plagg.hur: Hey, you look terrible. Try not to get flattened, okay?
Careful! If you go down, who buys my Camembert?
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.plagg.vic: Not bad, kid. That deserves a whole wheel of Camembert.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.plagg.idl: Is it cheese time yet? It feels like cheese time.
You know what this world needs? More Camembert.
Wake me when something interesting happens.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.trixx.cou: Time is nearly up! Better find a good hiding spot -- foxes always do.
One spot left! Let's not get caught, shall we?
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.trixx.dan: Something sneaky is around. Lucky we're sneakier.
I smell trouble. Want to play a little trick on it?
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.trixx.hur: You're hurt! Even foxes need to retreat sometimes.
Careful! A good illusion beats a bruise any day.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.trixx.vic: Ha! They never saw that coming. Well -- they saw something...
Wonderfully done! Not even a fox could have planned it better.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.trixx.idl: Have you ever fooled someone so well they thanked you for it?
Macarons, please. For energy. Definitely not because they're delicious.
Truth and illusion are closer than you think.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.nooroo.co: M-Master, your time is almost up!
Please, the transformation will end very soon...
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.nooroo.da: I feel strong emotions nearby... something dangerous.
Please be careful, Master. Something is out there.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.nooroo.hu: Master, please... this is too dangerous.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.nooroo.vi: You... you did it. Please use this power for good.
It's over. Thank you for being careful.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.nooroo.id: The butterfly is meant to give hope, not fear.
Thank you for treating me kindly.
A little honey would be lovely, if you have some.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.wayzz.cou: Patience -- but not too much. Your time is nearly spent.
The last spot remains. Withdraw while you still can.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.wayzz.dan: Danger is near. A wise hero is prepared before it arrives.
I sense a threat. Stay calm and stay together.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.wayzz.hur: You are wounded. Protecting others starts with protecting yourself.
Fall back and gather your strength.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.wayzz.vic: Well done. You stood firm, and your friends are safe.
Victory belongs to those who protect, not those who strike.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.wayzz.idl: A turtle does not rush. And yet, it always arrives.
Remember: a shield is only as strong as the heart behind it.
A little dried kelp would be most appreciated.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.kaalki.co: Your time grows short. Do not embarrass us both.
One spot remains. Depart with dignity, please.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.kaalki.da: A threat approaches. I suggest a swift departure -- or a swift transformation.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.kaalki.hu: You are injured. That is most unbecoming.
Withdraw at once. A rider does not fall.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.kaalki.id: I trust you are keeping my glasses polished.
Sugar would be appropriate at this time.
Every door leads somewhere. Choose wisely.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.sass.coun: The last moments are slipping away. Choose your next step carefully.
Time runs short. Even second chances end.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.sass.dang: Something stirs nearby. Listen before you act.
I sense danger. Patience will serve you better than haste.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.sass.hurt: You are hurt. Wisdom is knowing when to try again.
Breathe. A wise snake strikes only when ready.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.sass.vict: Well chosen. Every path led here.
Calm, and clever. You did well.
message.projecthero.kwami_chat.sass.idle: Every moment is a chance to choose differently.
An egg, if you have one, would be most welcome.
Time is a river. Learn its currents.

projecthero.guide.spawn_callings.body: The first time you spawn into a world, a power might choose you: a 5% chance that a Green Lantern Power Ring finds you, otherwise a 5% chance that a Miraculous does (Tikki, Plagg, Trixx or Nooroo), and failing both, a 5% chance that a Quirk awakens in you. A light appears around you and chat asks you to [Accept] or [Refuse]. Accepting gives you the power and replaces any Primary power you have; refusing (or waiting 5 minutes) lets it go for good. It only ever rolls once per player per world. Server owners can turn it off with /gamerule projectheroSpawnCallings false.

projecthero.miraculous.ability.hawk_moth: Cane Strike
A 3-hit combo with the cane, 9 damage each; the third blow knocks the target back. 1 s rest after the third.
Cane Sword
Draw the sword hidden in the cane and lunge 6 blocks, 14 damage to everything in the way. 6 s cooldown.
Akuma

Send an akuma at the mob you look at (30 blocks). It fights for you for 30 s with +50% health and damage, never hurting you or your squad. Up to 3 at once; bosses and players are immune. 4 s cooldown.
Recall
Every akuma flies back to you, the mobs return to normal and Akuma is ready again. 3 s cooldown.
Butterfly Swarm Flight
A cloud of white butterflies carries you: fly for 10 s (press again or land to stop). 20 s cooldown.
Swarm Dash
Burst into a cloud of white butterflies, dart 12 blocks the way you look and come back together; nothing can hurt you meanwhile. 8 s cooldown.
Butterfly Shield
Hold to raise a wall of white butterflies in front of you that stops arrows, fireballs and every other projectile (up to 10 s). 4 s cooldown.
RISE, AKUMA!

Darken a white butterfly in your hands and send it at a target (40 blocks): a mob becomes a Champion for 60 s (1.5x size, 3x health, 2x damage, a fire, ice or storm power); a player is offered the power and must accept. One Champion at a time. Starts the 3-minute countdown. 60 s cooldown.
Swarm Blind
Butterflies swarm every hostile within 8 blocks: Blindness and Slowness II for 6 s. 15 s cooldown.
Hawk Moth's Window
See through the eyes of one of your akumatized mobs for up to 15 s; your body stands still. Press again or take a hit to come back. 10 s cooldown.
Emotion Sense
For 15 s every creature within 50 blocks glows through walls, for you only: hostile red, calm white, scared blue; players by health (low = blue). 25 s cooldown.
Akuma Link
Point your akumatized mobs at the creature you look at (40 blocks), or speak straight into your Champion player's mind.

projecthero.power.power_01_super_strengt: Super Strength

Raw, overwhelming physical force: fists that hit like wrecking balls, a body that can throw anything it gets its hands on — creatures, players, even the ground itself — and every leap landed like a hero.
Experimental Adrenal Serum
Drink the serum, then take an electrical surge from an Overloaded Redstone Coil or Charged Copper Plates (or a natural lightning strike).
Ground Slam

G: 20 damage in a 5-block radius, slows for 2s and launches enemies up. Used airborne it becomes a dive that hits harder the farther you fell (20, up to 34) and ends in a superhero landing that shrugs off the fall. Leaves the ground intact. 6.8s cooldown. Shift + G = Thunderclap: clap a 120° cone of air 9 blocks out — 9 damage, a hard shove and a 2.5s stun (Slowness V + Weakness), arrows turned around, and every fire in the cone snuffed out (on creatures, on you and on the ground). Thunderclap has its own 8s cooldown; the G box shows whichever of the two is longer.
Power Leap

X: hold to charge (a bar above your keys fills), release to launch yourself the way you are looking — 11 blocks at a tap, up to 38 fully charged — and touch down in a superhero landing: one knee down, fist driven into the ground, cracks racing out through the block you land on. 7 damage in a 2.5-block radius at a tap, up to 22 in 5.5 blocks fully charged. No fall damage. 2.5s cooldown.
Bull Rush

Z: hold for 5s to charge (damage resistance and full knockback resistance while charging; a bar above your keys fills), then plough forward for 8s at double sprint speed with a 4-block step assist, hitting everything in your path for 24 and a 5-block knockback — the same bar drains as the rush runs out. Releasing early cancels. 34s cooldown.
Maximum Effort

C: 30 seconds of everything turned up — every Super Strength move and your fists hit twice as hard (Bull Rush +25%), slams grow 50% wider, you are immune to knockback, take 30% less damage, move and jump faster, and ability cooldowns are halved. Red veins light up under your skin and a bar above your keys counts it down. 70s cooldown.
Haymaker

R: a three-punch combo — jab (10), cross (12), then a launching haymaker (22) that sends the target flying and knocks their shield down. Each follow-up must land within 1.5s; the full combo goes on a 5.1s cooldown, dropping it half way costs 2.5s. Snaps onto the nearest enemy in reach if you are not aiming at one.
Grab & Throw

V: grab the creature or player in front of you and hoist it over your head — or, if there is none, rip the block you are looking at straight out of the world. Press again to throw: a thrown creature takes 12 when it slams into a wall, the floor or another mob (and so do they); a thrown block hits for 19 and shatters for 8 around it. Sneak + V while holding a creature sets it down gently. Anything held is dropped after 15s. 3.4s cooldown. Shift + V with empty hands = Rip & Hurl: tear a boulder out of the ground in front of you — it rises over your head in half a second — and hurl it about twice as far as before: 26 damage to whatever it strikes and 14 to everything within 3 blocks as it shatters. Rip & Hurl has its own 9.4s cooldown; the V box shows whichever is longer. Containers and obsidian-hard blocks cannot be ripped; with terrain damage off the block is copied, not removed.
Thunderclap
Rip & Hurl
+10 melee damage (a bare-handed hit lands 11) — with anything in hand, stacking with a sword or tool
Your melee hits knock enemies back 150% as far

Charged Punch: hold the attack key for 1s (not while aimed at a block you could mine), then release — your melee damage +15 (26 bare-handed), massive knockback, disables shields. A bar above your keys fills as it charges, then drains over its 2s cooldown.
A photonic mutation that runs on heat: twin eye beams that reach 100 blocks. Every beam heats your eyes — push it too far and you overheat.
Drink the serum and look into an active Experimental Light Projector / Beacon Lens for several seconds.

R: hold to fire twin heat beams from your eyes, up to 100 blocks — 4.8 damage every half-second, ramping up to 2.5x the longer you hold, setting what it touches alight. +1 heat a second. Aim it down while in mid-air and the beam holds you up, slowing your fall. Shift+R: Piercing Blast — a 100-block needle of light that runs through up to 4 creatures for 29 damage and cuts straight through glass, leaves and panes (with terrain damage on). +10 heat, 7.5s cooldown (shown on R).

Z: press to charge for 1.5s (the bar above your keys), then a thick, pulsing, powered-up beam tears out for 10s, following your aim up to 100 blocks: 22 damage to what it hits plus splash, a 12-damage burst every half-second where it lands, and it burns through soft blocks. Takes you straight to max heat and holds it there — you overheat when it ends. Can't be used above 50% heat. 55s cooldown.

V: flick a pinpoint of heat up to 100 blocks, just like flint and steel — sets the block you hit on fire (with terrain damage on), lights campfires, candles and TNT, and sets a creature alight. +2 heat, 0.5s cooldown.
C: toggle thermal highlighting of living things within 50 blocks, through walls and cover (only you can see it). Keeps your eyes warm: a slow trickle of heat, and heat does not vent while it is on.

X: fire a blast wherever you are looking, up to 100 blocks — the ground, a wall, behind you — and the recoil throws you the other way. 9.6 damage, knockback and fire in a 2.5-block splash where it lands; no fall damage for 4s after. +5 heat, 4.25s cooldown.
G: swing the beam through a 150° arc across your view in half a second, 100 blocks out — 14.4 damage and fire to everything it crosses. +10 heat, 8.5s cooldown.

Heat (0–100): every beam adds heat — Heat Vision 1 a second, Piercing Blast 10, Sweeping Arc 10, Recoil Blast 5, Ignite 2. Heat never changes how hard a beam hits. A full gauge overheats you: 3s locked out. Heat only starts to vent once you have not used Laser Vision for 5s, and then cools by 3 a second (3%).
Cooked on the spot (v0.15.11): an animal your lasers kill drops cooked meat or fish, never raw.
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.name: Flight
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.desc: A Superman-style flier: double-tap jump to take off, cruise at 20 blocks a second and sprint-fly at 50. A Lift meter pays for sprint-flying, dashes and the big moves -- flying punches, dive bombs, sonic booms, carrying foes into orbit -- and refills on the ground or while cruising.
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.trigge: Drink the serum, then activate an Unstable Gravity Plate, a Gravity Distortion Rig or a Pressure Chamber — or survive a fall of 14+ blocks.
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.abilit: R: shoot up to 8 blocks into the creature you aim at, fist first: 14 damage and a huge knockback. 15 Lift. Shift+R: Dive Bomb -- in the air, rocket down at the aim point and crater the ground: 12 to 30 damage in a 4-block ring, more the higher you dove from (full at 30 blocks). 25 Lift.

G: grab the mob or player in front of you and fly with them held out in your hands (up to 30s). Press G again to throw them where you look. 15 Lift, no bosses. Shift+G: Orbital Drop -- grab them, rocket 40 blocks straight up and let go: a full-height fall. 40 Lift, 15s cooldown.

X: a 12-block burst the way you are moving (or where you look). 10 Lift. Shift+X: Barrel Roll -- a spinning roll to the side you are strafing (or alternating); projectiles cannot touch you for 0.5s. 10 Lift.

Z: break the sound barrier -- a cone of shock rings 10 blocks ahead: 16 damage and a launch to everything in it, and a surge forward if you are flying. 30 Lift. Shift+Z: Takeoff Blast -- from the ground, blast 20 blocks the way you look into flight (always at least a little upward), knocking everything within 5 blocks away. 20 Lift.

V (toggle): hang dead still in the air for steady aim; nothing can knock you back. Any dash ends it. Free. Shift+V (toggle): Slipstream -- you fly 50% faster, and so does any squadmate flying behind you. 4 Lift a second.

Hold C: +60% flight speed with a vapour contrail behind you (takes off if you are not flying). 8 Lift a second. Shift+C: Updraft -- every enemy within 6 blocks is lifted 6 blocks up into the air. 25 Lift.
projecthero.power.power_03_flight.passiv: Lift (0-100): plain flight is free; sprint-flying spends 6 a second, Afterburner 8, Slipstream 4, and the moves their cost. It refills 12 a second on the ground or while cruising. With none left you can still cruise.
Double-tap jump to take off or drop out of flight; touching down lands you. You lean into cruising and lie flat sprint-flying, arms at your sides.
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.d: A speedster mutation that stands alone: it never stacks with any other power (gaining it replaces them, gaining another replaces it). Brew its serum like any mutation -- or, with Strength, Speed and Jump Boost all on you at once, activate Charged Copper Plates or get struck by lightning, and the Speed Force may take you (a 50% chance; see The Speed Force below). You are always 30% faster, regenerate (Regeneration III) and eat and drink 50% faster. Blitz enemies from across the field, sweep through every enemy around you and back, spin up a cyclone, throw a punch with all your momentum behind it, run on water, straight up walls and through leaves, phase through walls and slow time itself.
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.t: Drink the serum, then activate Charged Copper Plates or an Overloaded Redstone Coil (or get struck by lightning).
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.a: N: snatch up the creature or player you are looking at and carry it up on your shoulders as you run, for as long as you like. It is a carry, not an attack: whatever you carry takes no fall damage and can't suffocate in walls, and it can't hurt you. Press N again to set it down in front of you — it stays safe from fall damage for 3 more seconds. You also let go if you die or become exhausted after a Time Slow. No cooldown.

R: a blur of blows on everything in front of you — 4 punches of 5 damage each (20 in all; twice as hard in Overdrive). Every punch lands in full, even on players and mobs that were just hit. 1.5s cooldown. Shift+R: Mach Punch — one punch with all your momentum behind it: 20 damage, a huge knockback, and a shockwave that hits everything within 4.5 blocks of the impact for 6 and throws it back. 8s cooldown (shown on the R box).

X: an instant dash exactly where you are looking — look up to dash upward, down to dash downward. Further in Overdrive. In speed modes, jumps also keep their momentum for long leaps. 1.7s cooldown. Shift+X: Speed Sweep — blink from enemy to enemy through every hostile mob (and anything hunting you, and players when PvP is on — never your squad or pets) within 50 blocks, one every 2 ticks, hitting each for 15 (30 in Overdrive). It does not stop until every one of them has been hit (or has died or run out of range), then you snap back to exactly where you started, facing the same way. Nothing can hurt you while it runs. An enemy there is no room to land beside is given up on after 5s, a sweep never runs longer than 60s, and pressing X again calls it off early. 10s cooldown (shown on the X box).

V: for 30s — walk at 32 blocks/second and SPRINT at 120 blocks/second (a faster tier that replaces Speed Mode), +150% attack speed, a 10-block step assist, fall immunity, and your melee and every Super Speed move hit twice as hard. Your run gets even more extreme, your after-image trail turns red and leaves crackling yellow-white lightning streaking behind you, and speed explosions burst behind you while you run. Ordinary armour cannot take it: every second you run in Overdrive, each armour piece you wear loses 10 durability -- only the Flash Suit is built for this speed. Press V again to end it early (the cooldown still counts from when you switched it on). 42.5s cooldown.

C: toggle: walk at 20 blocks/second (easy to control in a fight) and SPRINT at 40 blocks/second in a speedster run, +50% attack speed, a 3-block step assist, run on water (you steer, speed up and stop on water just like on land; keep moving or hold a direction to stay up, let go to sink), +100% swim speed, -80% fall damage. You run straight through leaves (in Overdrive too) -- tree tops still hold you up when you land on them. Run into a wall while looking straight up to run up it (faster in Overdrive), with a hop onto the top. A trail of yellow after-images follows you while you run (a new one every tick, each fading over 1s). Shift+C: Phase — hold C to vibrate through walls on your own level (you can't sink through floors or rise through ceilings); while phasing you take no damage but can't deal damage or use any other ability. Release C to stop; if you end inside a wall you step out to the nearest open spot.

Z: HOLD Z for 5s to charge it — you brace, vibrate and crackle with building speed-force (the bar above your keys fills; let go early and nothing happens, no cooldown). When full it fires by itself: for 45s everything in the world except you slows to 5% of its normal speed — every mob, animal and player, projectiles, items, falling blocks, TNT, water and lava, redstone, crops, block animations, particles, the sun, moon and clouds, the weather. You live at full speed while the world crawls, but at a normal person's pace: no speed boost from the passive, Speed Mode or Overdrive while it runs. Slowed creatures still take your hits in full, as fast as you can land them, anything you kill drops its loot at once and you can pick it up straight away. Only one Time Slow can run at a time. Your view turns cold and grey (everyone else sees it too). Press Z again to end it early. Afterwards you are EXHAUSTED for 30s (the Exhausted bar drains): no Super Speed moves, Speed Mode and Overdrive switch off, no speed passives, and you drop whatever you carry. 300s cooldown, starting when it ends.
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.p: +30% movement speed: walking, sprinting and swimming
Eat and drink 50% faster (food, potions, milk, honey)
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.a: G: zip to the enemy under your crosshair (up to 24 blocks away, even past a narrow miss) in a streak of after-images and hit it for 20 damage (40 in Overdrive) with a heavy knockback that sends it flying, landing right in front of it and facing it -- the impact bursts out round it, hitting every other enemy within 4 blocks for 10 (20 in Overdrive) and knocking them back. No target, no cooldown. 4s cooldown. Shift+G: Speed Vortex — for 3s you run circles around yourself so fast you become a cyclone: everything within 8 blocks is dragged round and lifted, taking 3 damage every half second, and when it ends the vortex bursts for 8 more and flings them all away. It moves with you. 14s cooldown (shown on the G box).
projecthero.power.power_04_super_speed.p: Regeneration III, always (a speedster's metabolism heals you fast)
message.projecthero.speed.exhausted_star: Exhausted! Time Slow took everything you had
projecthero.power.power_05_geokinesis.de: An earthbender on an Earth meter instead of cooldowns: it refills fast while you stand on natural ground (stone, dirt, sand, gravel) and slowly anywhere else, so fights go best with your feet on the earth. Rip stones out of the ground and fire them, heave boulders, grab legs with stone hands, swallow foes in sinkholes, surf on a slab of rock, raise pillars, quakes, spikes and walls, wear a skin of rock and bore tunnels — every rock, hand and pillar made of the very ground it came from.
projecthero.power.power_05_geokinesis.tr: Drink while standing on natural stone/deepslate, ideally in a Geological Resonance Chamber.
projecthero.power.power_05_geokinesis.ab: Rock Shot

R: rip a stone out of the ground in front of you — it rises to your hand and flies where you look: 12 damage. 8 Earth. Shift+R: Boulder Toss — hold to heave a huge boulder up out of the ground and over your head; let go to throw it. It hits for 26 in a 3-block area and shatters into flying shards. 30 Earth. Hold R: Stone Barrage — five stones rise and circle you, then fire one by one at your aim, 8 each (25 Earth).
Stone Barrage
Hold R: five stones tear up out of the ground and circle you, then fire one after another at what you aim at — 8 damage each. 25 Earth, 8s cooldown.
Earth Grip

G: two stone hands burst out of the ground and grab the legs of the mob or player you aim at (20 blocks) — rooted for 3s, no moving or jumping. Bosses are only slowed. 15 Earth. Shift+G: Sinkhole — the ground under the target drops it 3 blocks and closes over it: it suffocates until it digs out. Natural ground only, no bosses. 35 Earth, 15s cooldown. Hold G: Quicksand — a 6-block pool of sand swallows the target waist-deep for 5s, then hardens back (30 Earth).
Quicksand

Hold G: a pool of churning sand 6 blocks across opens under the mob you aim at — everything in it sinks waist-deep, slowed hard and unable to jump, for 5s, then it hardens back exactly as it was. Natural ground and build permission only; never under you, squadmates or bosses. 30 Earth, 12s cooldown.
Rock Surf

X: ride a slab of rock across the ground, fast, the way you face, stepping straight up ledges up to 4 blocks tall — no time limit: 20 Earth to start and 1 a second while you ride (no refill till you step off); X again steps off. Shift+X: Tectonic Pillar — a pillar of rock erupts under the mob you aim at (20 blocks) and launches it 12 blocks up; aim at nothing and it launches you. 15 Earth. Hold X: Burrow — travel 15 blocks underground and burst out for 10 damage in 4 blocks (20 Earth).
Burrow

Hold X: sink into the ground and travel up to 15 blocks under it the way you look — a mound of earth runs along the surface over you — then burst out with a shockwave: 10 damage to everything within 4 blocks. Not through bedrock or anything unbreakable. Start on natural ground. 20 Earth, 6s cooldown.
Earthquake

Z: slam the ground — a ripple of heaving earth runs out 10 blocks around you: 14 damage to everything it passes, a stagger, and Slowness II for 4s. 30 Earth. Shift+Z: Earth Spikes — a line of stone spikes stabs up along the ground 12 blocks the way you face: 18 damage to each mob it catches, thrown upward. 25 Earth. Hold Z: Fissure — a 20-block crack opens along your look: mobs over it drop 3 blocks in and take 16; it closes after 5s (40 Earth).
Fissure

Hold Z: the ground splits open in a 20-block crack the way you face, 3 deep — every mob over it drops in and takes 16. It grinds shut after 5s, the ground put back as it was and anything still inside pushed up. Natural ground and build permission only; bosses just take the damage. 40 Earth, 14s cooldown.
Stone Wall

V: raise a wall of the local stone in front of you, 5 wide and 4 tall, row by row. It crumbles after 20s and gives nothing when mined. Needs build permission. 15 Earth. Shift+V: Earth Armor (toggle) — plates of rock close over your body: 50% less damage, but 20% slower. 4 Earth a second; Shift+V again to shed it. Hold V: Stone Dome — a radius-4 dome of stone closes round you for 8s, shoving mobs out (30 Earth).
Stone Dome

Hold V: a dome of the local stone closes round you (radius 4), blocking everything for 8s, then crumbles from the top. Mobs inside are shoved out first. Gives nothing when mined; needs build permission. 30 Earth, 20s cooldown.
Tunnel

C (tap on, tap again to stop): bore a 3x3 tunnel through stone and earth the way you look, fast — you keep the blocks (they go into your inventory). It also stops when the Earth runs out. Needs build permission. 3 Earth a second. Shift+C: Seismic Sense — feel every mob and player within 32 blocks through the ground: they glow through walls for 10s, on your screen only. 20 Earth. Hold C: Avalanche — rocks rain on an 8-block area up to 24 away for 3s, 6 each (35 Earth).
Avalanche
Hold C: rocks rain down on the area you aim at (8 blocks across, up to 24 away) for 3s — 6 damage from every rock that lands on a mob. 35 Earth, 15s cooldown.
projecthero.power.power_05_geokinesis.pa: Earth (0–100): every move spends some — Rock Shot 8, Boulder 30, Grip 15, Sinkhole 35, Surf 20, Pillar 15, Earthquake 30, Spikes 25, Wall 15, Seismic Sense 20; Earth Armor 4 and Tunnel 3 a second. Hold moves: Barrage 25, Quicksand 30, Burrow 20, Fissure 40, Dome 30, Avalanche 35. It refills 15 a second standing on natural ground (stone, dirt, sand, gravel), 5 a second anywhere else.
50% knockback resistance while on the ground
Stone and dirt break twice as fast
No fall damage when you land on natural ground
projecthero.power.power_06_crystalkinesi: Crystalkinesis

Plant crystal nodes, then shatter them: every Crystal Shard grows a glowing amethyst node where it lands (up to 8 at once, 30s each), and your other moves detonate, split and empower them. Reflective amethyst armor, a crystal rail to glide on and a turret spire round out the kit.
Crystalline Resonance Serum
Drink the serum and stay near 8+ amethyst blocks (a natural geode, a Meteor Impact site) — or activate a Crystal Test Chamber or Geological Resonance Chamber.
Shatter
G: detonate every crystal node you own — each bursts for 16 damage to everything within 3 blocks (a Resonance Spire bursts half again as hard and wide). 4s cooldown; needs at least one node.
Crystal Path

X: glide along your aim — climbing or diving up to 35 degrees — while a rail of amethyst grows beneath you (solid for 3s, so others can follow) with a line of light running ahead. Up to 10s; press again to stop. No fall damage for 3s after. 5.1s cooldown.
Resonance Spire

H: grow a great crystal spire where you aim (16 blocks) — for 12s it fires a crystal shard (8 damage) at any hostile creature it can see within 14 blocks, about 1.7 times a second. It counts as a node: Shatter it for a bigger burst. 17s cooldown.
Refract

N: fire a beam of refracted light (32 blocks, 11 damage). If it passes through one of your nodes first, the node splits it into three beams (9 damage each) aimed at the nearest enemies it can see — fanned out ahead if there are none — and the node itself splits into three. 4.3s cooldown.
Crystal Shard

R: fire a flying amethyst shard for 13 damage and Slowness II — wherever it lands it grows a crystal node (on the block face it struck, or at the feet of the creature it hit). 1.7s cooldown. Sneak + R fires a volley of 5 shards (7 damage each), each planting its own node, 8.5s cooldown.
Crystal Eruption

Z: hold for 4.25s to charge, then a burst for 48 damage across a 20-block radius that raises a dense field of amethyst pillars — and every node you own shatters along with it. 60s cooldown. Sneak as you press Z to charge a Colossal Crystal instead: a huge crystal hurled at speed that explodes for 66 damage and leaves three nodes behind. 85s cooldown.
Crystal Prison
V: seal a target in an amethyst cage for 7s with Slowness X and a jump lock — they cannot move at all — and grow a crystal node beside the cage for a Shatter follow-up. 10.2s cooldown.
Crystal Armor

C: toggle thick amethyst plating with crystal spikes at the shoulders and spine — Resistance I, knockback resistance, +10 ability damage and +8 melee — that turns projectiles back: an arrow or fireball that hits you is cancelled and fired back at its shooter as a crystal shard (30 strain each). Drains a strain bar (575, ~29s) that recharges once dropped; 20s cooldown once dropped.
Your crystal nodes, spires and shards never harm you; nodes crack away on their own after 30s, when you leave, or when you plant a ninth.
projecthero.power.power_07_electrokinesi: Electrokinesis
A general electricity mutation — intentionally weaker than Thor’s true lightning. Every hit leaves static stacks on its target; three stacks stun it and set it up for Overcharge and Ion Pull.
Electrochemical Serum
Drink the serum and activate an Overloaded Redstone Coil while inside its discharge radius.
Electric Bolt
Fire a 26-block bolt for 12 damage that adds a static stack and briefly powers nearby redstone. 45 charge, 1.7s cooldown.
Chain Lightning

Lightning arcs from the enemy under your crosshair through up to 6 enemies for 11 damage each, adding a stack to every one. It jumps 8 blocks to a fresh target but 14 to one already carrying static — and always prefers the stacked one. 85 charge, 7s cooldown. Shift + G fires an EMP instead: redstone, powered doors, minecarts and robotic mobs within 20 blocks shut down for 6s (200 charge, 25s cooldown).
Bolt Form

Become a streak of lightning: jump up to 10 blocks along your aim (stopping short of walls), zapping everything along the path for 8 damage and a stack. Brief damage immunity and no fall damage on landing. 60 charge, 3.4s cooldown.
Electrical Storm

Hold Z for 4 seconds, lightning gathering over your raised arms, then call the storm on your aim point (up to 40 blocks): a 36-damage strike on everything within 5 blocks (+2 stacks), then four follow-up bolts over the next 2.4s for 10 each on enemies within 9 blocks — stacked targets first. Small crater when terrain damage is on. 575 charge, 55s cooldown.
Power Surge
Energise redstone from up to 50 blocks away — plants a short-lived block of redstone against whatever you are looking at. 70 charge, 6s cooldown.
Charged Mode

Toggle: a crackling blue shell and glowing blue eyes — +10 ability damage, +8 melee damage, Speed III, and every punch jolts for 3 more and adds a static stack. Drains your charge cell (~28s); getting hit while charged costs you 3 health and staggers you.
Overcharge

Detonate every static stack within 16 blocks: 8 damage per stack on each stacked enemy (+5 in Charged Mode), knocking them back; fully stacked targets are stunned again. Clears the stacks. 140 charge, 10s cooldown — needs at least one stacked enemy.
Ion Pull

Magnetise the static: every stacked enemy within 20 blocks is yanked to you and slowed. With nothing stacked it pulls the enemy under your crosshair instead and gives it a stack. 80 charge, 8s cooldown.
Lightning deals no damage to you at all; standing near a lightning strike instantly refills your charge cell

Every ability spends from a 1150-point charge cell (always shown) that refills on its own in about 40s, far faster during a thunderstorm. Abilities briefly power nearby redstone, and powered rails energise as you run over them.

Static stacks: every Electrokinesis hit adds one (max 3, lasting 8s). Stacked targets crackle with sparks everyone can see, take +10% Electrokinesis damage per stack, and are stunned for 1.5s when they reach three (then immune to that stun for 4s).
projecthero.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.d: A fire-wielder on a Heat meter that every move RAISES: the hotter you run, the harder your fire hits (up to +40% from 80 Heat). Hit 100 and you overheat: a forced nova of fire bursts out of you and you can't use a move for 5s. Fireballs, a flamethrower, a fire whip and lasso, a flame dash and jet flight, a charged meteor, a wall of fire, a living-fire body, a heat wave and cauterizing burns.
projecthero.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.t: Drink the serum and remain in ordinary fire for several seconds while resistance protects you.
projecthero.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.a: Fireball

R: hurl a ball of fire — 14 damage and burning on a hit, and fire where it lands. +8 Heat. Shift+R: Flamethrower — hold to pour an 8-block cone of fire: 4 damage four times a second and burning to everything in it, lighting what it washes over. +10 Heat a second. Hold R: Blue Flame — a blue-white fireball, 24 damage that Fire Resistance doesn't stop.
Blue Flame
Hold R (0.6s): a blue-white fireball swells in your hand, then flies — 24 damage (+Heat) on a hit that Fire Resistance doesn't stop, and 8s of burning. +20 Heat, 6s cooldown.
Fire Whip

G: crack a 12-block lash of living flame — 12 damage and burning to what it catches, yanked in to you. +10 Heat. Shift+G: Fire Lasso — a burning ring binds the creature you aim at (12 blocks) for 3s: it can't move and takes 3 a second. Shift+G again lets go. +20 Heat, 6s cooldown, no bosses. Hold G: Flame Serpent — a serpent of fire that hunts down your foe.
Flame Serpent
Hold G: a serpent of fire coils off your arm and hunts what you aim at, or else the nearest threat within 25 blocks — 18 damage (+Heat) and 8s of burning. +25 Heat, 10s cooldown.
Flame Dash

X: burst 10 blocks along your aim in a rush of fire, leaving a trail of flames and setting whatever you pass alight. No fall damage straight after. +10 Heat. Shift+X: Jet Flight (toggle) — fly on jets of fire from your hands and feet, steered like every flight in the mod; lands on its own, or Shift+X again. +2 Heat a second, so you can fly a good while. Hold X: Phoenix Dive — rise as a firebird and dive into a blast.
Phoenix Dive
Hold X: rise wrapped in a firebird, then dive along your aim into a blast 8 blocks across — 20 damage (+Heat), burning, knockback and the ground set alight. No fall damage. +25 Heat, 8s cooldown.
Meteor

Z: tap to start charging a huge fireball over your head (up to 2s), tap again to throw it (it throws itself after 5s): 16 to 30 damage in a 5-block blast, burning, knockback and fires. +25 Heat, 3s cooldown. Shift+Z: Inferno — dump all your Heat in a nova of fire: up to 30 damage (at full Heat) to everything within 8 blocks. Heat to 0; needs 10 Heat. Hold Z: Meteor Shower — six smaller meteors on the spot you aim at.
Meteor Shower
Hold Z: six smaller meteors rain down round the spot you aim at (up to 30 blocks away) — 10 damage (+Heat) each in 2.5-block blasts, with burning and fires. +35 Heat, 15s cooldown.
Flame Wall

V: raise an 8-wide wall of fire 3 blocks ahead, across your aim, for 8s — whatever crosses it burns (3 damage every half second) and arrows burn up in it. +15 Heat, 3s cooldown. Shift+V: Flame Body (toggle) — become living fire: melee attackers catch fire, you take 30% less melee damage and you walk on lava. +4 Heat a second. Hold V: Ring of Fire — a circle of flame round you that burns whatever crosses it.
Ring of Fire
Hold V: a circle of flame 6 blocks round you for 10s — whatever crosses it burns (4 damage (+Heat) every half second); you're immune. +20 Heat, 15s cooldown.
Heat Wave

C: roll a wave of heat out across an 8-block cone — it throws everything back, melts snow and ice and smelts dropped items, the whole stack at once. +10 Heat. Shift+C: Cauterize — sear your wounds shut: burn 40 Heat to heal 8 hearts. 20s cooldown. Hold C: Solar Flare — a blinding burst of sunfire round you.
Solar Flare
Hold C: a sun bursts out of you — every threat within 12 blocks is blinded for 4s and set alight (bosses only burn), and nearby screens flash white. +15 Heat, 12s cooldown.
projecthero.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.p: Heat (0–100): every move raises it — Fireball 8, Flamethrower 10 a second, Whip 10, Lasso 20, Dash 10, Jet Flight 2 a second, Meteor 25, Flame Wall 15, Flame Body 4 a second, Heat Wave 10; the hold moves Blue Flame 20, Flame Serpent 25, Phoenix Dive 25, Meteor Shower 35, Ring of Fire 20, Solar Flare 15. Your fire hits up to 40% harder from 80 Heat. It cools 10 a second while nothing hot is running, three times faster in water or rain. At 100 you overheat: a forced nova (12 damage around you), Heat back to 0 and no moves for 5s.
Immune to fire and lava — you never catch fire, even from your own flames
Your punches set things alight. You cook with your hands: Sneak + use raw food to sear the whole stack, and raw food you eat counts as cooked
projecthero.power.power_09_cryokinesis.d: An Iceman / Frozone ice caster on a Cold meter: ice hits add Frost to their target, and five Frost freeze it solid in a block of ice for 2.5s. Throw bolts and shards, fire a freezing beam, ride a ramp of ice, raise spikes and walls, armour yourself in ice, grow a blade on your arm, then Shatter everything you froze.
projecthero.power.power_09_cryokinesis.t: Drink the serum and stay sunk in Powder Snow for a few seconds — or activate a Crystal Test Chamber.
projecthero.power.power_09_cryokinesis.a: R: hurl a lance of ice — 10 damage and 1 Frost. 8 Cold. Shift+R: Ice Shards — a fan of 7 shards at short range, 4 damage and 1 Frost each (point-blank, enough to freeze outright). 15 Cold. Hold R: Ice Javelin -- a piercing ice spear, 18 damage and 3 Frost to up to 4 creatures. 25 Cold.
Hold R: a great spear of ice forms in your raised hand, then flies -- it pierces up to 4 creatures, 18 damage and 3 Frost each. 25 Cold, 6s cooldown.

G (toggle): a beam of frost (20 blocks) that slows its target and adds 1 Frost every half second; water it hits freezes over and fire goes out. 10 Cold a second; tap G again (or run out of Cold) to stop. Shift+G: Ice Prison — seal a creature you aim at (16 blocks) in ice for 4s: it cannot move or attack. No bosses. 30 Cold, 12s cooldown. Hold G: Frozen Ground -- a 10-block sheet of ice for 8s that slows, trips and frosts enemies on it. 30 Cold.
Hold G: the ground freezes over in a 10-block radius round you for 8s -- enemies on the ice slip about, are slowed and take 1 Frost every 2s (bosses only take the Frost). 30 Cold, 16s cooldown.

X: toggle a ride on a ramp of ice you lay as you go -- no time limit, 20 Cold to start and just 1 a second while you ride (no refill till you step off). Steer with your look: look up to build it rising, look down to ride down (no ice under you then). You step up blocks and hop taller ones; the ice never closes round you or anyone else. Melts behind you. No fall damage while sliding (or for 3s after). X again steps off. Shift+X: Ice Pillar -- a column of ice launches you 10 blocks up. 15 Cold. Hold X: Ice Wings -- 10s of flight on beating wings of ice. 30 Cold.

Hold X: wings of ice grow from your back and beat -- 10s of flight (steer with your look, Space / Sneak to rise and sink), leaving a frost trail; water under you freezes. Ends early if you land. 30 Cold, 25s cooldown.

Z: a 12-block line of ice spikes erupts from your feet along your look — 16 damage and 2 Frost to everything over it, tossed up. 25 Cold. Shift+Z: Absolute Zero — a crown of ice bursts out round you and everything within 8 blocks takes all 5 Frost: frozen solid. Nearby water freezes. 50 Cold, 20s cooldown. Hold Z: Blizzard -- an 8s snowstorm up to 30 blocks away: Slowness III, 1 Frost a second, blinding snow. 45 Cold.

Hold Z: a snowstorm 10 blocks across rages where you aim (up to 30 blocks) for 8s -- enemies inside get Slowness III, 1 Frost a second and blinding snow (bosses only take the Frost). 45 Cold, 24s cooldown.

V: raise a wall of ice 5 wide and 4 tall, 3 blocks ahead, row by row; anything where it rises is shoved back. Melts after 15s. 15 Cold. Shift+V: Frozen Armor (toggle) — ice plates over your body give 8 hearts of absorption, and anything that hits you in melee takes 1 Frost. Shatters when the ice is gone. 3 Cold a second. Hold V: Ice Fortress -- an ice dome round you for 15s that shoves enemies out. 30 Cold.
Hold V: a dome of ice (radius 4) closes over you, row by row; enemies inside are shoved out. Melts after 15s and puts back what was there. Needs terrain effects on. 30 Cold, 25s cooldown.

C (toggle): a blade of ice grows from your forearm — +8 melee damage and 1 Frost per hit. Free. Shift+C: Shatter — every frosted enemy within 10 blocks takes 20; frozen ones take double (40) and burst out of their ice. 20 Cold (only when something nearby is frosted). Hold C: Ice Golem -- an ally of ice fights for you for 20s, its punches adding Frost. 50 Cold.
Hold C: an ice golem (60 health) rises beside you and fights for 20s -- each punch hits for about 10 and adds 1 Frost. It never touches you or your squad. 50 Cold, 40s cooldown.
projecthero.power.power_09_cryokinesis.p: Cold (0–100): moves spend it; it refills 15 a second (25 in a snowy biome or on snow or ice) while the Freeze Beam and Frozen Armor are not draining it. A move you cannot afford is refused.

Frost: ice hits add Frost (shown as ice pips over the target). At 5 the target is frozen solid in a block of ice for 2.5s — no moving, no attacking. Frost fades one at a time after 3s without a new hit.
Water freezes under your feet as you walk over it
Immune to freezing damage; your own cold never builds up on you
Walk on powder snow with no leather boots, and through a drift at full speed
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.a: Hurl everything orbiting you at the crosshair at once, each object hitting 20% harder than a single throw. 30 Psi, 3s cooldown.

Seize the creature you are aiming at (50 blocks) and freeze it in mid-air, 1.5 blocks up, for 4 seconds -- it cannot move, attack or target anything, and drifts down safely afterwards. No bosses. 90 Psi, 12s cooldown.
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.p: Up to three grabbed objects orbit you at once; they cost Psi to hold and fall gently if you burn out
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.d: Psionic force manipulation built around juggling: pull creatures, loose items and torn-up blocks into an orbit around you -- up to three at once -- then fling them one at a time or all together. Everything is paid for out of one Psi reserve; empty it and the power shuts down for ten seconds.
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.t: Drink the serum near an Enchanting Table ringed by 8+ bookshelves, or activate an Enchanting Resonance Array.
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.a: 12 damage and a hard shove to the entity you are aiming at (50 blocks), plus anything within 3 blocks of it. 0.85s cooldown, 35 Psi. Sneak for Force Pull instead: reels in a target and every loose item within 50 blocks (25 Psi).
A toggled shell of pure force. Nothing gets through while it holds -- but it burns 1.6 Psi a tick, and every blow it eats costs 4 Psi per point of damage. Break your reserve on it and you burn out.
Toggle telekinetic flight. A low, steady Psi drain (0.4 a tick) that stops at a safety floor instead of emptying you mid-air; what you juggle while flying is what costs.

Hold Z for 5s: every enemy within 50 blocks is torn off the ground and hauled toward you, held at arm’s length, then blown apart for 66 damage. 76s cooldown, 320 Psi, and your reserve crawls back at a fifth of its speed for 10s afterwards.

Pull the creature or dropped item under your crosshair (50 blocks) into your orbit -- up to 3 objects circle you at chest height (55 Psi a creature, 20 an item, plus 0.45 Psi a tick each while they orbit). With the orbit full, or nothing grabbable aimed at, V flings the object nearest your aim at the crosshair instead (creature 14 damage and 8 to itself on impact, item 9, block 16). Sneak: set the whole orbit down gently -- or, with an empty orbit, Force Crush: reel a victim in and squeeze for 12 damage a second while it drains Psi and roots you.

Hold to lift a block up to 50 blocks away and steer it with your crosshair; release to throw it. A quick tap instead plucks the block straight into your orbit. Sneak to tear a 3x3 chunk out of the ground -- a thrown chunk hits the first creature it reaches for 31.
projecthero.power.power_10_telekinesis.p: Nearby dropped items drift slightly toward you while charged
Every telekinetic ability is paid for out of one large Psi reserve, which refills by itself
You never take fall damage — but catching yourself draws Psi in proportion to the fall
projecthero.power.power_11_teleportation: Nightcrawler-style combat teleporting on a Strain meter instead of long cooldowns, so you can chain jump after jump: blinks, a chaining Bamf Strike, place-swapping, wall phasing, a linked Rift that crosses dimensions, and a fold in space that sends arrows back where they came from. Every jump leaves a puff of purple smoke and a fading afterimage where you stood.

R: an instant blink to the spot under your crosshair, up to 25 blocks, always landing somewhere safe (it stops short of walls). Walk up to a wall and aim at it and Blink takes you through instead, up to 3 blocks thick. 15 strain. Shift+R: Long Blink — hold to paint a spot up to 150 blocks away, release to jump there. 35 strain.

G: vanish and reappear behind the creature you are aiming at (30 blocks) with a strike for 11, then keep going: every 0.3s you hop behind the nearest new enemy within 10 blocks and hit it too, up to 4 targets in all. 40 strain. Shift+G: Swap — trade places with the creature or squadmate you are aiming at (40 blocks); only if both spots are safe for both bodies, an enemy arrives briefly disoriented, no bosses. 20 strain.

X: teleport 10 blocks straight back from where you are facing, with 1s of Resistance III on arrival. 15 strain. Shift+X: Sky Blink — 15 blocks straight up (less under a ceiling) with 6s of Slow Falling. 15 strain.

Z: step straight through the wall in front of you, up to 3 blocks thick, as long as the far side is clear. 20 strain. Shift+Z: Displace — teleport the creature you are aiming at (30 blocks) 15 blocks up into the air and let it fall. No bosses, no squadmates. 30 strain.

V: hold for 5 seconds to charge (a bar shows it), then pick an exact destination — coordinates and dimension — in a screen. A linked pair of gates forms out of particles: one where you stand, one at the destination; step into either to come out of the other. One pair at a time: tap V again (or sneak + right-click a gate) to close it. 60s cooldown, no strain. Shift+V: Mark / Recall — set a return mark where you stand; press again to jump back to it, even from another dimension. 25 strain on the recall.

Hold C: fold space around you. Any arrow, trident, fireball or other projectile about to hit you is teleported back at whoever shot it, and any enemy who comes within 3 blocks is folded back out to 6 blocks away (a boss is thrown back). 10 strain to raise it, then 18 strain a second while you hold it; it drops when you let go or overload. Shift+C: Group Jump — your next Blink or Long Blink (within 10s) also takes every squadmate within 5 blocks, who land around you.

Strain (0–100): every jump adds strain — Blink 15, Long Blink 35, Bamf Strike 40, Swap 20, Escape and Sky Blink 15, Phase Step 20, Displace 30, Recall 25; holding Spatial Fold costs 10, then 18 a second — and it drains at 10 a second. Hit 100 and you overload: Nausea and 4s with no teleports. Ambush: the first hit you land within 1s of any teleport does double damage.
No fall damage for the first second after any jump.
Drink the serum and throw an Ender Pearl while the effect is active, or activate an Enchanting Resonance Array.
projecthero.power.power_12_super_regener: Pure cellular regeneration, always on: no keys to press. You heal 10 health every quarter second, burn off any harmful effect within 2 seconds, and carry 3 revive charges that each recharge on their own. Ascends into Wolverine with an Adamantium Serum.
While the serum is active, survive being reduced below 3 hearts without dying.
Healing: 2 health every tick (40 health a second) whenever you are hurt, with no hunger cost. Red veins pulse and trickle over your whole body while it works
Cleansing: any harmful effect (poison, wither, slowness, weakness...) dissolves out of you after 2 seconds. The unstable mutation is not a poison and is never touched

Revive charges: 3 charges, shown as green dots beside the power name (grey while recharging). A killing blow spends one before any Totem of Undying: you get back up at half health, cleansed, with 1 second of damage immunity. Each spent charge recharges on its own 60-second timer. /kill and the void still kill you
Sonic Scream
Manipulate destructive sound. Every scream spends Voice and travels as visible rings of sound.
Resonance Serum
Blow a Goat Horn while the serum is active, or activate a Resonant Chamber.
Sonic Blast
A 5-block cone of sound for 12 damage with knockback and a brief stun. 16 Voice, 4.25s cooldown.
Focused Scream
A 30-block beam of sound for 19 damage with knockback, nausea and a brief stun. 24 Voice, 8.5s cooldown.
Sonic Jump

Blast the ground away beneath you to launch high into the air (4 damage and a shove to anything within 3 blocks) — and take no fall damage from the landing. Boosts an open elytra instead. 12 Voice, 4.25s cooldown.
Supersonic Scream

Hold Z for about 4 seconds as the sound builds in your throat, then unleash a 20-block cone of sound for 60 damage with severe knockback, nausea and a stun, shattering glass, ice and leaves along the way (terrain damage on). Start the hold while sneaking to scream all round you instead: 48 damage in a 20-block radius (68s cooldown). 55 Voice, 60s cooldown.
Resonance

Vibrate a spot up to 14 blocks away: glass, ice, leaves and other fragile blocks in a 3x3x3 shatter (terrain damage on), and anything within 3.5 blocks takes 6 damage and is stunned and nauseous for 2–3s. 18 Voice, 4.25s cooldown.
Echolocation

Toggle: a sonar ping every 2 seconds (4 Voice each) and pale rings of sound around your head — everything living within 20 blocks glows through walls for you alone, and your screams reach 30% further. Pings don’t stop your Voice recovering. Ends when Voice runs dry.
Sound Barrier

Raise a 5-wide, 3.5-tall wall of sound 3 blocks in front of you for 5 seconds: projectiles that fly into it are shredded, and enemies caught in it take 3 damage every half second and are shoved out. 30 Voice, 12s cooldown.
Disorient
A warbling pulse: everything within 10 blocks takes 4 damage, is slowed and nauseous for 6 seconds, and every mob forgets who it was fighting for 3 seconds. 20 Voice, 12s cooldown.

Greatly reduced self-damage from sonic effects. Enhanced hearing: anything living within 40 blocks flashes for you alone the instant it moves. Shift + right-click makes everything within 20 blocks glow for you alone for a few seconds.
Voice (115), always shown: every scream spends it, and it recovers 16 per second once you have been quiet for 1.5s.
projecthero.power.power_15_invisibility_: Invisibility / Light Manipulation
Hard-Light Blade

Conjure a glowing sword of solid light straight into your hand for 30 seconds: 9 damage, makes whatever it hits glow, never wears out. It is light, not an item -- switch away from it, drop it, open a container or let the 30 seconds run out and it is gone. Press again to dismiss it early. 20s cooldown once it fades.
Prism Shield

Hold to raise a pane of refracted light in front of you: arrows, fireballs and other projectiles coming at your front are bounced back at whoever shot them, and beams or ranged hits from the front are refracted away and 60% of them sent back at the sender. Melee still gets through. You move 35% slower while holding it; it drains its own 115-point Prism bar (and more per reflection), which refills when lowered.
Your cloak hides your held items and armour from everyone; Mirror Images and the Hard-Light Blade are pure light and can never be looted or kept

Bend light: refract yourself into decoys and prisms, vanish completely, conjure a blade of solid light, and burn enemies with blasts, flashes and pillars of holy light. Stronger and longer-ranged in direct sunlight.
Photonic Refraction Serum
Drink under direct sunlight with an unobstructed sky for several seconds.
Light Blast

Fired from your hand for 10 damage and 4s blindness, 0.85s cooldown. Hold to charge: +7 damage and +0.85s cooldown per second held (max 3s). Shift for a 5-blast volley, half a second apart (9.4s cooldown).
Flash

A searing burst of light around you (8 blocks): 12 damage, 10s blindness and Slowness II, and every mob caught loses track of you. 8.5s cooldown. Shift for Radiant Lance: a piercing line of light (30 blocks) that hits everything along it for 24, blinds, makes them glow and bursts at its far end (10s cooldown).
Sparkling Flight
Hold to fly wherever you look; your body scatters into light while it lasts. Drains the sparkle meter (115, ~29s), which refills on its own. 2.5s cooldown once you land.
Holy Light
Hold for 5 seconds to charge, then channel a single blinding pillar of light for 3 seconds — 14 continuous beam damage plus a radiant 29-damage burst every half second where it lands. 64s cooldown.
Mirror Images

Refract yourself: 2 Mirror Images (3 in direct sunlight) step out of you wearing your face, skin and gear, and scatter. For a second you vanish while every mob hunting you turns on an image instead -- and they keep luring nearby hostiles for 10 seconds. Any hit bursts an image into light that blinds whoever struck it. 16s cooldown.
Cloak
Sustained full invisibility — your armour and whatever you hold vanish too, for every player watching. Attacking reveals you for 2 seconds.
Reduced detection range while crouching. Always-on night vision. +10% ability damage and +20% range in direct sunlight.
projecthero.power.power_16_spider_climbi: Spider Climbing / Adhesion

Cling to any surface and move across it. Turn the grip on, then double-tap jump against a wall or ceiling to grab it -- climb up, crawl sideways, hang still, and double-tap sneak (or jump) to let go. A predator's kit on top: sticky strikes, pounces, a spider-sense that side-steps the next attack and a venomous bite. Slower and less sure-footed than the arachnid who evolves out of it.
Adhesive Mutation Serum
Get hit by a Cave Spider while the serum is active and survive the poison.
Adhesive Strike
A sticky palm strike (4.5-block reach): 8.5 damage and the target is glued in place -- rooted and weakened for 7 seconds. 3.4s cooldown.
Pounce
A predatory leap along your aim. The first enemy you land on within 1.5 seconds takes 7 damage and is slowed. No fall damage from the leap. 4.25s cooldown.
Wall Leap
Powerfully launch away from the surface you are gripping (or kick off backwards in mid-air). 2.55s cooldown.
Predator Rush
35 seconds of the hunt: Speed II, Haste II, Jump Boost III and Strength, with your eyes glowing red. 30s cooldown.
Wall Grip

Arm the grip. With it on, double-tap jump against a wall or ceiling to stick, then look where you want to go and move relative to the surface. Stop and you stay put; sneak and you hold tighter. Double-tap sneak, or reach the ground, to let go.
Adhesion Mode
The same grip, armed permanently -- double-tap jump against walls, overhangs and ceilings to hold them, double-tap sneak or jump to let go.
Reduced fall damage
Improved jump height
Spider-Sense Dodge

H: your spider-sense tingles for about a second -- the next attack that would hit you (melee or projectile) is dodged outright with a sidestep and a burst of speed. A red halo pulses over your head while it is primed. 6s cooldown.
Venom Bite
N: a lunging bite on whatever is in front of you (3.8 blocks): 7 damage, Poison II for 6 seconds and Slowness II for 4. A miss costs nothing. 7s cooldown.
Spider-sense: you see a faint red shimmer over every hostile creature nearby (brighter and wider while Spider-Sense Dodge is primed)
projecthero.power.power_17_elasticity.de: A Mr. Fantastic / Plastic Man rubber brawler on a Stretch meter instead of long cooldowns, so you can chain move after move: your arms and legs really stretch -- the limb itself lengthens out to the target in your own skin, then snaps back -- to punch from 18 blocks, grab and hurl, slingshot across the map, roll into a bouncing ball, inflate into a balloon, flatten into a parachute or squash into a barrel.
projecthero.power.power_17_elasticity.tr: While the serum is active, fall at least 10 blocks onto a Slime Block — or activate a Gravity Distortion Rig.
projecthero.power.power_17_elasticity.ab: R: your arm shoots out up to 18 blocks for 12 damage and snaps back. Hold R to coil it — the arm visibly twists — for up to 1.5s: up to 24 damage, 22 blocks and a big knockback. Release to snap. 10 Stretch. Shift+R: Gatling Barrage — hold to flurry stretched punches into the cone in front, 6 hits a second at 12.8 each, a blur of arms. 12 Stretch a second.

G: your arm wraps a mob or player up to 20 blocks away and reels it in to arm's length (up to 6s). Press G again to hurl it where you look: 10 damage when it lands, 16 if it hits a wall or another mob (which takes 6 too). 15 Stretch, no bosses. Shift+G: Wrap & Squeeze — your rubber body coils round the creature you are holding or aiming at (6 blocks): for 4s it cannot move or attack and takes 4 a second. Press G again to let go. 25 Stretch.

X: both arms shoot out and grip the block you aim at (up to 80 blocks) — once caught, they hold that block wherever you look. Hold to coil (a bar shows it), release to launch yourself at it: a full coil hits more than twice as hard as a tap, and a farther anchor flings you further. In the air you keep every bit of that speed until you land, hit a wall or splash down. 15 Stretch. Shift+X: Rubber Ball — roll up into a bouncing ball: fast, bounces off walls, bowls through mobs for 6 each, and projectiles bounce off. No time limit: 30 Stretch to start and 3 a second while you roll (no refill meanwhile); Shift+X again rolls back out.

Z: your fist swells to a boulder and slams the aim point (12 blocks): 20 damage in a 4.5-block area, plus Slowness. Hold Z to coil for a bigger fist, up to 34 damage. 30 Stretch, 8s cooldown. Shift+Z: Spring Stomp — your legs stretch you 8 blocks up on stilts, then you slam down: 20 damage in a 5-block ring, launching mobs into the air. 25 Stretch, 6s cooldown.

Hold V: inflate into a balloon. Projectiles bounce back at whoever fired them, melee attackers are flung away and you take 60% less damage — but you move at half speed. 8 Stretch a second. Shift+V: Parachute — your torso stretches into a canopy between your arms and legs and you glide like an elytra: steer with your look, dive for speed, pull up to climb (on the ground you hop up first). Lands on its own, or Shift+V again to fold up. Free.

C (toggle): your arms reach 12 blocks for everything — break and place blocks, open doors and chests, hit things — and items within 12 blocks are pulled in to you. Free. Shift+C: Shape Shift — squash into a harmless-looking block: the one you are looking at (a chest, say), else a barrel. Mobs lose you and cannot find you. You can creep about as the block; sprinting, swinging or attacking, using a block, or taking a hit ends it. 20 Stretch, 10s cooldown.
projecthero.power.power_17_elasticity.pa: Stretch (0–100): every move spends some — Stretch Punch 10, Gatling 12 a second, Grab 15, Wrap 25, Slingshot 15, Ball 30, Hammer Fist 30, Spring Stomp 25, Rubber Shield 8 a second, Shape Shift 20 — and it refills 5 a second (10 in Gear 2) while you are not holding a move. Run it dry and you go limp: Slowness II and no moves for 8s.
No fall damage and no kinetic-energy deaths (flying into a wall just squashes you), and a real fall springs you back up. Hold Shift to land dead.
Rubber body: 25% less damage from blunt hits (melee and explosions), but 25% more from fire and lava.
Squeeze through a one-block gap without needing a trapdoor
message.projecthero.elasticity.gear2_off: Gear 2 wears off — your body gives out
message.projecthero.elasticity.gear2_tir: Too worn out for Gear 2 — rest first
projecthero.power.power_17_elasticity.pa: Gear 2: Sneak + use a Lava Bucket (it empties) and the heat drives your blood like a pump for 2½ minutes — +60% speed, +50% melee, faster swings, every move at half the Stretch and it refills twice as fast; your skin flushes and steams. When it ends you go limp, then you're worn out for 45s (Slowness II, Weakness II, Mining Fatigue, hungry) and can't use it again until you've rested.
message.projecthero.elasticity.limp: Gone limp -- no moves for 8 seconds
message.projecthero.elasticity.wrapped: Wrapped up -- press G to let go
message.projecthero.elasticity.shape_on: Shape Shift -- creep about; sprinting, swinging, using a block or getting hit ends it
message.projecthero.plant.no_room: No room to plant a sentry there
message.projecthero.size.mount_needs_for: Mount needs Tiny form (ride) or Large / Giant form (carry)
projecthero.power.power_18_density_manip: Density Manipulation

Dial your density anywhere from 25% to 300% -- lighter is faster, heavier hits harder and shrugs off blows -- phase through walls, flicker intangible, and crush your enemies under their own weight. A thin shell over your body glows blue when light and orange when heavy.
Molecular Density Serum
Activate a Molecular Compression Chamber while the serum is active.
Increase Density
Raise your density by 5% (up to 300%). Higher density: more damage dealt, less taken, more knockback resistance, but slower.
Decrease Density
Lower your density by 5% (down to 25%). Lower density: faster, but you deal less damage and take more -- and you lose the knockback resistance that higher density would give you.
Density Anchor
Slam to maximum density and root in place for 10s: cannot be moved by mobs, immune to knockback, 76% damage reduction, but cannot sprint or jump. A 25.5s cooldown starts when it ends.
Heavy Impact

More than 6 blocks up: slam straight down for up to 54 damage in a 20-block radius (falls off with distance) and shatter some ground. On the ground: launch upward, then slam -- the rise only ever lasts 3 seconds before the slam forces itself, so you are never left stranded in the sky. 8.5s cooldown.
Zero Density
Drop straight to 25% density -- maximum speed, minimum weight. 1.7s cooldown.
Phase

Toggle: vibrate and walk straight through solid blocks while the Phase meter lasts (115, 15% bigger than before). You are immune to all damage while phasing, and you render see-through so everyone can tell. This is intangibility, not flight -- you cannot rise more than 2 blocks above the ground beneath you. Jump to rise, sneak to sink; your head buried in a block costs air.
Your density (25%-300%) sets your speed, damage dealt, damage taken and knockback -- shown on the HUD
Intangible Dodge
H: flicker intangible for half a second with a short dash -- every attack, projectile and blast passes straight through you. A cyan shimmer shows it. 4s cooldown.
Crushing Touch

N: charge your fist (it glows orange) for up to 8 seconds. The next creature you hit becomes super-dense for 5 seconds: 70% slower, unable to jump, triple gravity, and anything flying is dragged out of the sky. 12s cooldown.
A thin shell over your body shows your density: blue when you are light, orange when you are heavy
projecthero.power.power_19_shadow_manipu: Shadow Manipulation
Shadow Bind

Black chains erupt from the ground around the creature you are aiming at (24 blocks) and up to 2 others beside it: 9 damage, rooted in place, weakened and briefly blinded for 5 seconds (longer in the Deep Dark, shorter in light). 10s cooldown. Shift for Shadow Grab: seize a target up to 20 blocks away and hold it; press again to throw, or Shift to set it down.
Shadow Walk

Sink into the ground as a moving puddle of shadow: invisible (armour and held items too), Speed III, no fall damage and half damage from everything, and every mob loses track of you -- but you cannot attack, and using an attack ability surfaces you. Drains its own 115-point bar (~10 seconds in darkness, twice as fast in bright light), which refills when you surface.
Shadow Servant

Raise a silhouette of living darkness with glowing eyes that fights for you for 20 seconds: 30 health, 8 damage a hit (scaled by the light), and it goes for whatever hurt you, whatever you are fighting, or the nearest hostile. It never targets you, your squad or your pets. One at a time. 30s cooldown.
Shadow Walk and Shadow Step let you travel through darkness itself; the Shadow Servant never turns on you or your squad

Darkness as a resource and a road: bolts, tendrils, binding chains, a shadow servant, and travel through the shadows themselves -- step through darkness or sink into a moving puddle of it. Everything is stronger in the dark and weaker in sunlight.
Umbral Serum
Drink at night while standing in true darkness (light level 0) for several seconds.
Shadow Bolt
Fire a dark-energy bolt for 13 damage that blinds the target for 4 seconds (1.7s cooldown). Shift for a 5-bolt fan volley (12.75s cooldown).
Shadow Tendrils

Lash nearby enemies with tendrils from the ground for 18 damage and blind them for 8 seconds (6.8s cooldown). Shift for a 10-block cone that also roots everything it hits in place for 8 seconds (17s cooldown).
Shadow Step
Blink up to 75 blocks through darkness, hitting anything at the landing spot for 6 (2.5s cooldown). Out of darkness you need Shift to seek out a dark spot to land in instead (6.8s cooldown).
Shadow Zone
Hold for 5 seconds to charge, then unleash a 20-block shadow zone: every enemy caught sinks, slows, blinds and takes 10 damage a second for 11 seconds. 51s cooldown.
Shadow Form

Become a thick black silhouette with burning purple eyes. Toggle for Shadow Cloak: +12 ability damage, +8 melee damage and a slowing, blinding aura, draining a 115-point bar (~40 seconds) and ending on a 17s cooldown. Shift+toggle instead for the indefinite stealth Shadow Form: in darkness you turn invisible, fast, and mobs lose track of you.
Every ability scales with ambient light: 50% in bright light, 75% indoors, 100% in darkness, 130% in the Deep Dark. Always-on night vision.
message.projecthero.shadow.need_darkness: You need to be in darkness — or hold Shift to seek some out
message.projecthero.shadow.no_darkness_f: No darkness found along your line of sight
message.projecthero.shadow.cloak_low: Your shadow bar is too low
message.projecthero.shadow.no_target: No target in your shadow's reach
message.projecthero.shadow.walk_low: Not enough shadow left to sink into
projecthero.power.power_20_energy_absorp: Energy Absorption
Absorb fire, lightning, explosions and magic — and release them again as the same element.
Energy Conversion Serum
While the serum is active, survive two different kinds of energy (fire, explosion, lightning) — or activate a Controlled Blast Chamber.
Energy Blast
Spend 10 energy on a 16-damage bolt of your stored element, 1.7s cooldown. Hold to charge: +6 damage and +1.7s cooldown per second held, up to 3s.
Energy Beam

Hold for a sustained beam of your element: 11 damage a hit and the element’s effect every half second, draining 20 energy/s; 4.25s cooldown on release. Shift for an 18-damage burst in 9 blocks instead (50 energy, 17s cooldown).
Energy Dash
Dash forward on a trail of your element, hitting anything in the first few blocks for 7 damage and the element’s effect. 5 energy, 1.7s cooldown.
Overload

Hold Z for 3.5 seconds as a ball of your element grows overhead, then release the WHOLE meter at once (at least 100): 25 damage + 1 per 10 energy spent, in a 6–11-block radius that grows with the energy, with the element’s effect on everything hit and a crater when terrain damage is on. 25s cooldown.
Energy Drain

Hold on a creature within 12 blocks: every half second it takes 5 magic damage and you take 14 energy and 1 health. Aim at a redstone block, ore, lamp or lightning rod to drink its current instead (10 energy, as lightning). Up to 6s, 8s cooldown. Shift + V instead converts 10 energy into 2 health every half second.
Absorption Mode

Toggle: a glowing lattice shell in your element’s colour. Soak 80% of elemental and 40% of physical damage (up from 60% / 25%), +10 ability damage, +8 melee, Speed II and Haste II; your punches glow with your element. 7 energy/s; 17s cooldown when it ends.
Redirect

For 3 seconds the next projectile flying at you is caught and thrown back at whoever fired it, and a melee blow is negated and fired back at the attacker for 1.5x its damage + 6 with your element’s effect. Half the caught damage becomes energy. 25 energy, 10s cooldown.
Empower

Spend 100 energy on a 12-second buff that depends on the stored element: Fire — Strength and Fire Resistance; Lightning — Speed II and Haste II; Explosion — Resistance II; Magic — Regeneration II and Absorption II; raw — Strength and Speed. Your punches carry the element while it lasts. 25s cooldown.

575-point Energy meter, always shown and coloured by its element: fire orange, lightning blue, explosion yellow, magic purple, raw cyan. Trickle-regenerates to 25% after 10s without absorbing. 80% grants Strength and Speed; a full meter slowly hurts you. Redstone charges it as lightning (stand on it, harvest dust, or Sneak + use a block or dust to burn it).

Fire, lightning, explosion and magic damage: 60% is soaked into the meter and sets its element. Other hits: 25% soaked, element unchanged. Everything you fire comes out as the element — fire ignites, lightning arcs to a second target and stuns, explosion blows the target away, magic withers and weakens.
projecthero.power.power_21_shockwave_man: Shockwave Manipulation
Store kinetic force — the blows, falls and blasts you take — and release it as pressure waves.
Kinetic Amplification Serum
Drink the serum and survive an explosion (TNT, a creeper) or activate a Controlled Blast Chamber.
Shockwave Punch
A 7-block pressure cone for 12 damage with knockback, trailing distortion rings. Spends up to 10 Kinetic for up to x1.5 damage and knockback. 1.7s cooldown.
Ground Wave

A shockwave that races about 20 blocks along the ground (2-block step assist) for 16 damage to everything it passes, throwing it up. Shift + G bursts all round you instead: 18 damage in 8 blocks (6s cooldown). Spends up to 15 Kinetic for up to x1.5 damage. 5s cooldown.
Recoil Jump
Blast yourself up and forward like a super-leap — no fall damage on landing. With 10+ Kinetic it spends 10 for a 30% bigger jump and a 6-damage blast on the spot you left. 2.5s cooldown.
Kinetic Detonation
Hold for about 4 seconds with a full Kinetic gauge to release a 20-block shockwave for 72 damage, launching every enemy. Spends the whole gauge, 85s cooldown.
Repulsion Field
Hold to keep a 3-block field of force up: enemies are shoved away, projectiles thrown back, and damage you take is cut by 30%. Drains 6 Kinetic/s.
Charge
Hold to brace: bank 5 Kinetic/s, and every blow, fall or blast you take while bracing stores double and hurts less (melee 40% off). 4.25s cooldown once released.
Aftershock

A delayed second wave where your last wave landed (within 12s and 48 blocks): rings tighten on the spot for 0.8s, then it erupts for 14 damage in 5 blocks and launches everything up. Spends up to 15 Kinetic for up to x1.5. 8s cooldown.
Kinetic Parry

Open a 0.7s parry window: the next melee hit is negated, stored at double its damage, and the attacker takes 5 damage and is thrown back and slowed. A successful parry cuts the cooldown to 2s. 6s cooldown.
70% less knockback taken; immune to your own shockwaves.

Kinetic storage (a gauge of 115, always shown): melee hits you take are 15% dampened and banked, falls 40% dampened and banked at 1.2x, explosions halved and banked at 1.5x. Only kinetic force — never fire, lightning or magic.
projecthero.power.power_22_plant_manipul: Plant Manipulation / Chlorokinesis
Command growth itself: thorns, snaring vines, living walls, explosive overgrowth, a planted thorn turret that fights for you and healing spore clouds -- all stronger on living ground.
Chlorokinetic Serum
Drink beneath open sky while surrounded by natural plant blocks, flowers or saplings.
Thorn Shot

Fired from your hand for 9.5 damage and Poison III for 8 seconds (1.7s cooldown). Shift, while on natural ground or holding bone meal/a sapling, for Branch Thrust: a 15-block lunge dealing 18 damage with a trail of logs that grows into a tree (8.5s cooldown).
Thorn Snare
Root a target for 8 seconds with a lashing vine, 3.6 damage. Shift for a 10-block cone that snares every enemy in front of you. 6s cooldown.
Vine Swing
Attach a vine line to a block up to 100 blocks away and swing toward it (no fall damage for 10s) -- or, aimed at a target instead, pull them to you. 0.85s cooldown.
Overgrowth
