projecthero.guide.spider_man.body: You cannot become Spider-Man directly. It is what Spider Climbing / Adhesion grows into: the same adaptation, refined until it is something else. Everything Adhesion could do, this does better, and it replaces it outright -- you are never carrying both.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.step.adhesi: Mutate into Spider Climbing / Adhesion the ordinary way (Adhesive Mutation Serum, then survive a Cave Spider bite).
projecthero.guide.spider_man.step.mutage: Craft an Arachnid Mutagen: phantom membrane, an echo shard, spider eyes, fermented spider eyes, amethyst and a golden apple.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.step.evolve: Use it. With the adaptation already in you it evolves; without it, nothing happens and the mutagen is not consumed.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.s: Shift+N mutes (or unmutes) your notification sounds -- the Spider-Sense ping and Pulse, the web alarm and the web-building sounds. "Sounds: OFF" shows on your HUD while they are muted; it stays as you left it.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.controls.bo: Each of R, G, X, Z, V and C has three moves: tap the key, Shift + the key, or hold it (about half a second -- a tap fires when you let go). Every move has its own cooldown; the HUD shows each key's tap cooldown in its box, its Shift and hold cooldowns as thin blue and red bars under it, and holding Left Alt lists all 18 names.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.s: Web Swing -- hold right-click with an empty hand and let go to release with your momentum (a fast release somersaults; a long drop ends in a superhero landing). Let go in the air and you keep that speed -- no air drag, like the Hulk's leap -- until you land, hit or grab a wall, swim, or fire the next line, and you can steer it: W turns you toward where you look, A / D turn you left / right, S brakes. Zip Boosts and the end of a Web Wings glide carry their speed the same way. Right-click still opens doors, chests and villagers when you are looking at one.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.t: Swing tricks -- tap Jump within about a second of letting go of a swing: W front flip, S backflip, A corkscrew, D twist, or no direction for a random one (the split too). Each trick adds a little forward speed (10%, then 5%, then 3%, never past top swing speed) and opens the window for the next -- up to 3 per airtime ("x2", "x3" under the crosshair). The count resets when you land or grab a wall. Holding Jump instead of tapping does not trick. In the Black Suit each trick feeds the symbiote a little Hunger.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.w: Wall Run -- sprint ALONG a wall beside you (heading well off straight into it) and you run across its face, feet on the wall, about 9 blocks a second; look up or down to drift up or down it. Keep Sprint and W held to keep running; it carries on round outside corners. Let go of Sprint to drop into the wall crawl, Jump to kick off the wall away and up, Sneak to let go. Running or holding W straight into a wall still climbs. N's wall-crawl switch turns it off too.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.z: Zip Boost -- Sprint + Jump in the air for a quick web-zip forward (3 webbing). Its speed carries, with no air drag, until you land -- steer it with WASD like a swing release. Plain Jump in the air is still the double jump.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.c: Wall crawling engages by itself when you run or fly into a wall in the air, sprint into one, or just hold W against one from the ground -- swinging into a wall drops the line and takes the wall. On a wall W climbs up unless you look clearly down; look along the wall to crawl sideways. Climbing rough rock you slide round blocks that jut out, and at the top you pull yourself up over the edge. Sneak lets go. N switches the automatic wall crawl on or off (shown next to your Web bar; it stays as you left it); while it is off nothing sticks you to a wall.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.p: Ledge perch -- Sneak standing still at the edge of a drop (3+ blocks), or up on a fence, wall or post, and you sink into the perch: a deep crouch with your feet together on the ledge, knees spread wide, leaning forward with both hands planted between your feet and your head up. Sneak still keeps you from falling off.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.r: On your tightrope you stay balanced, and at a junction you carry on along whichever rope runs your way; Sneak just crouches, and Z drops you under it to hang upside down. Tap G at a rope to zip onto it and land standing. Mark a mob with Shift+V, then Shift+V on a rope or woven web to reel it onto the strand and cocoon it there (Web Pin).
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.h: Upside-down hang -- tap Z on a ceiling, a woven web or one of your tightropes to drop head-first on a web line, feet locked round it and knees out wide, hands on the line. Hold Jump to climb and Sneak to lower, quickly (about 8 blocks a second) -- there is no length limit: you can lower all the way until your head is just above the ground. You can still weave (hold C) while you hang. Z again zips you back up; Shift+Z lets go. Hanging uses no webbing.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.t: Inverted Takedown -- hanging upside down (Z) over a mob that hasn't noticed you (not a boss, not too heavy), up to about 6 blocks below and in front: left-click. You drop down the line, snatch it and haul it up to hang beside you, cocooned -- for good from your own web, for 25 seconds from a ceiling. Silent: you stay hidden. 8-second cooldown; a prompt under the crosshair shows when a target is below.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.p: Perfect dodge -- about 0.6 s before a hit lands (a mob's swing, a drawn bow, an arrow on course) Spider-Sense warns you: red screen edges, a tingle and a Jump cue. Press Jump any time during the warning and that hit misses completely: you sidestep or flip, the attacker and every enemy within 4 blocks are heavily slowed for 1.5 s, and your next melee or ability hit within 3 s is a counter for double damage and a knockback. 5-second cooldown; not while swinging or hanging. The automatic dodge chance still works on every other hit.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.c: Attack one of your own webs to cut it down.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.suit_v2.bod: The Spider-Man Suit v2, the Advanced Suit with the big white spider: the same skin-tight suit, mask (H) and poses, in its own colours. Each piece is crafted from the matching original piece plus materials -- and the original stays in the grid, so you keep both suits.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.suit_v2.rec: Every piece needs a phantom membrane plus the matching original piece, which stays in the grid -- you keep your old suit. Mask: leather, a phantom membrane, red dye, blue dye, string. Suit: string, a phantom membrane, red and blue dye, leather, an iron ingot. Leggings: red and blue dye, leather, string, a phantom membrane. Boots: red and blue dye, leather, a phantom membrane.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.suit_v2.win: Web Wings (the v2 suit on your chest): hold Jump while falling and after a moment the webbing under your arms spreads -- and you fly like an elytra. Look down to dive and pick up speed, pull up to turn that speed into height (hold it too long and you stall and drop), level off for a long glide that slowly loses height, and look left or right to bank round. Let go of Jump to drop and keep your speed; fire a swing line from a glide and keep it too. No fall damage while gliding.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.suit_v2.tri: Trip Mine (Shift+C in the v2 suit, instead of the Web Wall): a web laser on any block face that yanks the first enemy across it onto the mine and cocoons them. 6 at a time, 10 minutes each, sneak + right-click to pick one up.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.suits.body: Six more suits, each drawn skin-tight like the original with its own mask (H): Comic Classic, Brand New Day, Amazing (2012), Amazing 2, 2002 and Future Foundation. They are costumes with the original suit's powers -- no Web Wings or Trip Mine. Every piece is crafted from the matching original piece, which stays in the grid (you keep it): the two dyes either side of it and the suit's own extra below.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.suits.recip: Comic Classic: red dye, blue dye, paper. Brand New Day: red dye, blue dye, a sunflower. Amazing (2012): red dye, blue dye, a gold nugget. Amazing 2: red dye, blue dye, white dye. 2002: red dye, blue dye, a cobweb. Future Foundation: white dye, black dye, string.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.suits.displ: Show them off on a Mannequin, or keep up to ten on a Wardrobe (see Laboratory Devices -> Mannequin & Wardrobe).
projecthero.guide.spider_man.webs.body: Tightropes, Web Walls and woven webs are spun from silk, not blocks -- nothing in the world is placed or broken, and they fade after 5 minutes (or when their area unloads). You and your squad stand, walk, climb and swing on them; anyone else who touches one sticks fast, and your Spider-Sense pings -- a chime and an arrow on your HUD pointing at the spot, wherever you are within 160 blocks. You can have 12 at once; a new one replaces your oldest.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.sen: Spider-Sense -- a ring round your crosshair lights up on the side trouble is coming from: red for a blow or shot about to land, orange for a hostile closing in (even from behind) or a bow, crossbow or gun aimed at you, yellow for a hazard (primed TNT, a swelling creeper, lava ahead, a falling block, a TNT-wired pressure plate). Icons and up/down arrows tell you what and where; the screen edge ripples on that side. Anyone winding up or aiming at you is outlined for you alone, incoming arrows show a faint path line, and invisible threats shimmer. Others see the tingle lines round your head. Move, jump or crouch during a warning for a guaranteed dodge.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.dod: Half of all melee attacks and 60% of projectiles are simply dodged. A dodged projectile never passes through: about 40% of the time it is sent straight back at whoever fired it, otherwise an arrow is caught and anything else is swatted aside.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.arr: Arrows you dodge and do not send back are caught out of the air and kept.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.cra: Wall and ceiling crawling -- run or fly into a wall to stick, look where you want to go and move; Sneak or reach the ground to let go.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.cei: Ceiling crawling, and clean transitions between wall and ceiling in both directions.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.wal: Jump while clung to a wall to launch about 7 blocks in the exact direction you are looking, with a slight upward kick -- a wall leap.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.dou: A second jump in mid-air, once every second (with Sprint held it is the Zip Boost instead).
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.sup: Sneak and jump from the ground to leap about 10 blocks straight up.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.web: Web Blossom -- sneak and hold V for 3 seconds, then leap into the air and blast webbing outward. Everything within 20 blocks takes 40 damage and is frozen in cobwebs for 20 seconds. Costs 75 webbing.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.str: An unarmed hit lands 8 damage (a sprint punch, 10), and the same strength adds to any weapon you hold, plus Speed II, Resistance II, a jump that clears 2 blocks, and solid resistance to being knocked around.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.fal: Falls hurt far less, and a fall you web out of does not hurt at all.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.passive.res: Organic webbing -- no shooters, no ammunition, just a reserve that refills.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.swinging: Swinging prefers real terrain and always will: a city, a mountainside or a dense forest gives longer, faster, more dramatic arcs than open ground. Where there is genuinely nothing to catch, the web goes up and ahead anyway so traversal never stops -- but those swings will only carry you so far above where the run began, so webbing across a desert stays swinging rather than becoming flying. Climb real terrain and that limit rises with you.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.combat.body: N swaps Traversal Mode (the swing / zip / yank / shot kit above) for Combat Mode. Wall Crawl (C) and Web Net (V) work in both; the HUD shows which mode you are in. Web strands -- Web Zip's line, a released swing, the Combat Mode webs -- leave from your hand and phase out over 5 seconds instead of vanishing.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.combat.r: R  Web Strike -- web a target and get pulled straight at it; on arrival you hit it for 15 damage and knock it back. 3-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.combat.g: G  Web Zip -- as before, but aimed at a mob or player it rips whatever they are holding out of their hands and pulls it to you.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.combat.x: X  Web-Throw -- hold to web a target and whirl it around your head; release to hurl it the way you are looking. 3-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.combat.z: Z  Impact Web -- one heavy ball of webbing: 10 damage and a hard knockback, and whatever it hits is wrapped in a web cocoon for 12 seconds; a mob knocked into a wall is pinned to it too. 1-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.combat.v: V  Web Blossom (sneak + hold) charges in 2 seconds in Combat Mode instead of 3.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.reserve: Every web ability spends from your Web Reserve, shown under the ability row. Swinging costs very little; combat webbing costs real amounts. It refills by itself a moment after you stop using it.
item.projecthero.turbo_stabilizer.tip1: Regulates unstable T.U.R.B.O. Energy during Ultralink bonding.
item.projecthero.turbo_stabilizer.tip2: Allows bonding with Steel without reaching Level 30.
message.projecthero.max_steel.cannon_too: The Turbo Cannon folds away -- hold C longer to fire.
message.projecthero.max_steel.emergency_: EMERGENCY TOTEM -- T.U.R.B.O. suit forced online!
message.projecthero.max_steel.steel_low_: Steel: Your energy output isn't high enough. Yet.
message.projecthero.max_steel.bond_requi: Bonding Requirement: reach Experience Level 30, OR use a T.U.R.B.O. Stabilizer.
message.projecthero.max_steel.steel_busy: Steel is already bonding with someone.
message.projecthero.max_steel.already_bo: You have already bonded with a Steel.
commands.projecthero.maxsteel.already: That player already has Max Steel.
commands.projecthero.maxsteel.no_power: That player does not have Max Steel.
hud.projecthero.max_steel.title: MAX STEEL
projecthero.guide.max_steel.body: Maxwell McGrath generates raw T.U.R.B.O. Energy but cannot control it. Steel -- an alien Ultralink -- bonds with him to regulate that energy, form a nanotech suit around him, and channel it into specialised Turbo Modes.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.step.find: Find a Steel Crash Site -- a rare crater in the open Overworld with Steel floating at its centre. Use /locate structure projecthero:steel_crash_site if you have permission.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.step.bond: Right-click Steel while at Experience Level 30 or higher (this consumes 5 levels), or while carrying a T.U.R.B.O. Stabilizer (this consumes the Stabilizer, with no level requirement). The bond is permanent.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.energy.body: A pool of 250 that regenerates on its own, suited or not -- 10/second out of combat, 5/second in combat (a full refill takes 25 seconds), and not at all while a Turbo Mode is draining it or the Turbo Cannon is charging. If a Turbo Mode drains it to 0 you overload: you drop to Base Mode and cannot use any ability until natural regen brings T.U.R.B.O. Energy back up to 150. Turbo Modes have no time limit -- this pool is the only clock on them.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.suit.body: Steel's nanotech builds the suit one pixel at a time: it spreads out from the T.U.R.B.O. core in your chest -- a bright band of nanites sweeping over you, undersuit first and armour plates last -- while you clench a fist to the core and then throw your arms wide. Powering down runs it backwards, the suit drawing back into your chest from your hands, feet and head. Every Turbo Mode rebuilds it the same way: the new form (Strength, Speed or Flight) rematerialises over the old one from the chest out, extra armour and all. Going straight into a mode from Normal form builds that form in one pass.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.hud.body: Bottom-right while suited: the six ability keys (cooldowns drain up each box, the active mode's box lights up), MAX STEEL with IN COMBAT / READY, the Turbo Mode you are in, then thin hairline bars: T.U.R.B.O. Energy with its percentage, the Turbo Cannon (charge %, lock status, or its recharge), and the Turbo Blast charge while you hold R. In Normal form a smaller version shows MAX STEEL, MODE Normal and your T.U.R.B.O. Energy, which keeps refilling out of the suit too.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.controls: Press H to Go Turbo, and H again to power down (not while IN COMBAT). You can also go straight into a Turbo Mode from Normal form: G, X, Z or V while unsuited forms the suit directly as that mode (Strength, Speed, Flight or Stealth) and switches it on the moment it settles -- no stop in Base first. R and C need the suit on. Shift+H while suited opens or seals the helmet; hold Left Alt to see every move name beside the HUD. The six abilities:
projecthero.guide.max_steel.ability.turb: Tap for a fast T.U.R.B.O. bolt (15 damage). Hold to charge: a ball of energy forms in your fist and grows through three stages over 2 seconds (a chime marks each), your arm raises to aim, and the bolt grows with it -- up to 34 damage, and a full charge detonates for 17 more on everything within 3.5 blocks.

Reconfigure into the heavy Strength form -- pauldrons, gauntlets, a chest plate and heavy boots materialise over the suit, 20% larger. +8 unarmed damage and Resistance I, but slower to move and swing. Crouch to brace and block 50% of incoming damage. Sprint into a melee hit for a Heavy Punch shockwave. Press G again for a Turbo Slam -- 15 damage to everything within 5 blocks. Shift+G returns to Base. Pressed in Normal form, the suit builds straight into the Strength form.

Reconfigure into the sleek Speed form -- a helmet crest, forearm blades and calf fins. Very high, controllable ground speed with automatic step-up. Tap X again for a short Turbo Dash that hits the first thing in front of you; Shift+X returns to Base. Pressed in Normal form, the suit builds straight into the Speed form.

Reconfigure into the Flight form -- swept-back wings on a thruster pack, helmet fins and ankle jets -- and take off, an energy trail streaming behind you. Movement keys steer, jump climbs, sneak drops, sprint boosts: 18 blocks a second, 36 sprinting. Costs more the faster you go. Touch the ground and you drop back to Base, as if you had pressed the key again. Pressed in Normal form, the suit builds straight into the Flight form and you lift off as it settles.

Near-total invisibility -- the suit vanishes and nearby hostiles lose track of you. Breaks the moment you attack or take a real hit, then goes on a 12-second cooldown; the suit forms back over you pixel by pixel. Pressed in Normal form, the suit forms and then fades straight into Stealth.

Hold C: an arm cannon materialises over your right forearm and you brace side-on, aiming down the crosshair. While it charges (up to 3 seconds) it locks onto the enemy nearest your crosshair -- blue brackets close in around it. Release to fire a piercing beam at the lock (or exactly where you aim): 16 to 45 damage to everything along it, then a blast at the far end for almost half that again, over 2.5-5 blocks. Wider, hotter and costlier the longer you charge; it kicks you back unless you are in Strength. Let go too early and it just folds away, free. Works in every mode; 8-second recharge, shown on the HUD.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.passives.bod: Diamond-tier suit armour, +4 melee, some knockback resistance, half fall damage, a higher jump, passive Regeneration I, and you breathe underwater. Steel also chirps and marks the direction of a projectile you can't see coming.
projecthero.guide.max_steel.emergency.bo: If a hit would kill you while you are NOT transformed, Steel forces the suit online instead: the death is cancelled, you are healed and briefly shielded, and you Go Turbo on the spot. It costs 150 T.U.R.B.O. Energy and then will not fire again for 20 minutes. Being suited up when the blow lands does not trigger it -- power down somewhere safe, not mid-fight, to keep it in reserve.
projecthero.guide.punisher.body: Frank Castle is not superhuman. Everything he brings is a firearm, an explosive, a piece of tactical gear, or the training to use them. A Punisher never runs out of reserve ammunition, reloads faster, handles weapons more steadily, and finishes wounded enemies without hesitation.
projecthero.guide.punisher.step.safehous: Find a rare Abandoned Vigilante Safehouse -- a buried bunker with a weapon workbench, ammunition, target boards and a Vigilante Training Manual. Locate one with /locate structure projecthero:vigilante_safehouse.
projecthero.guide.punisher.step.training: Right-click the Manual to begin. Objectives: defeat 25 hostiles, 10 of them at range, land 5 firearm headshots, craft a firearm, and defeat a Pillager Captain. Complete them all and you permanently become the Punisher.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ammo: You (the Punisher) carry a personal reserve for each gun -- three full magazines' worth -- that drains as you reload and slowly refills on its own (about 1% every 0.7s). No ammo item is consumed. Anyone else may craft and fire these guns, but must carry the matching ammunition: Handgun Rounds, Rifle Rounds, Shotgun Shells or Sniper Rounds.
projecthero.guide.punisher.controls.note: Shift = sneak. Every Shift move has its own cooldown. With a gun in hand, tap R to reload and hold R for its moves.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.mark: Target Designation -- mark the enemy you aim at (48 blocks) for 30s. It takes +30% damage from all your attacks and glows red for you alone. One mark at a time. 5s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.threa: Threat Assessment -- everything alive within 18 blocks glows for you alone for 10s. 12s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.strik: Brutal Strike -- 10 damage to the enemy in front of you (5 blocks) and a 2s stun: it can't move or attack. 2s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.kick: Breach Kick -- 15 damage, kicks the target about 10 blocks back and stuns it for 5s. 5s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.grena: Frag Grenade -- hold Z to cook, release to throw. It sticks where it lands and goes off on its fuse; hold too long and it goes off in your hand. 12s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.warzo: Warzone -- hold for 5s to call artillery on the spot you aim at (up to 100 blocks). Missiles rain on a marked 15-block area for 10s: 30 damage each, no block damage, never you or your squad. 2 min cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.roll: Tactical Roll -- a tumbling dive of about 7 blocks in your movement direction with brief knockback resistance and light damage reduction. Cancels an active reload. 4s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.advan: Tactical Advance -- Speed IV for 30s. 60s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.smoke: Smoke Screen -- a thick 5-block smoke cloud for 6s. Mobs inside lose their target and can't pick a new one; other players inside are blinded. 12s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.flash: Flashbang -- thrown, goes off after 1.5s. Everything within 6 blocks but you and your squad is blinded, slowed and dazed for 8s, and mobs lose their target. 12s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.satch: Tactical Satchel -- a 9-slot bag that rides with you through death, power changes and dimensions. Opens only while you wear the full Punisher tactical armour.
message.projecthero.punisher.weapon.snip: Steady... firing in 3s -- aim it yourself
projecthero.guide.punisher.ability.weapo: Weapon Ability -- depends on the gun in your hand (see below).
projecthero.guide.punisher.weapon_abilit: V does something different for each gun in your main hand; Shift+V is a second move with its own cooldown (the thin bar under the V box). Putting the gun away or swapping cancels anything still running. With no gun in hand: "Hold a gun".
Pistol -- V: your next 3 shots deal double damage (12s). Shift+V: an instant 18-damage shot that gives Slowness II for 4s (20s).
Shotgun -- V: spends 3 loaded shells on one blast, 15 damage per pellet out to 5 blocks (12s). Shift+V: the same 3 shells in a 90-degree fan of 12 pellets, 10 damage each (20s).

Assault Rifle -- V: double fire rate and half reload time for 15s (20s). Shift+V: locks onto the target under your crosshair (40 blocks) and empties the magazine into it -- the camera tracks it and you cannot reload until it ends (25s).

Sniper Rifle -- V: your next shot pierces everything in its line and ignores 40% of armour (12s). Shift+V: Steady Shot -- raises the scope and steadies for 3s while you aim (no auto-aim), then fires one shot where you are looking that deals double headshot damage wherever it lands (30s).
projecthero.guide.punisher.passives.body: Weapon Proficiency (a regenerating personal reserve of 3 magazines per gun, less recoil, faster handling), Faster Reloading (15%), Ballistic Expertise (tighter aim), Headshot Feedback, and No Mercy: +25% firearm damage to a non-boss hostile below 15% health (+10% to a boss).
projecthero.guide.punisher.crafting: Weapons are built from Weapon Parts (iron + copper + redstone), Gun Barrels and a Weapon Scope. The pistol is cheapest; the sniper is the most expensive. The Punisher Tactical Vest, Leggings and Boots (there is no helmet) protect between iron and diamond, and while you hold the power the full set adds 20% projectile-damage reduction, knockback resistance and a little less recoil. They take enchantments like any armour, at the enchanting table or an anvil: Protection of every kind, Unbreaking, Mending and Thorns, plus Swift Sneak on the leggings and Feather Falling, Depth Strider, Frost Walker and Soul Speed on the boots.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.body: An alien symbiotic lifeform that bonds to a host and covers them in a living black suit, sharing its strength, agility and regeneration -- at the cost of a hostile reaction to loud sound. The Symbiote is the mod's only Secondary power: it can bond with any player, but it only shares a host with Spider-Man (Black Suit) or the Punisher (Agent Venom). Bonding purges every other power you hold, and gaining any other Primary power later on removes the Symbiote again.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.overview: An alien organism that bonds with you and wraps you in a living black suit: diamond-grade armour, Resistance I, tendrils, spikes and a blade -- all fed by its own Biomass bar. It hates fire and loud sound.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.get.find: 1. Find one: it crawls out of a Symbiote Meteorite in a crater, waits in a hidden research lab's containment cell, or bursts out of a rare Symbiote Host mob when it dies.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.get.bond: 2. Right-click it (or use a filled Symbiote Vial) and win the bonding minigame: stop the marker in the green zone three times running.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.get.settle: 3. Ride out 35 seconds of sickness while it settles (no moves yet), then press H.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.get.purge: Bonding removes every other power, except Spider-Man (Black Suit) and the Punisher (Agent Venom).
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.suit.body: H wraps the suit on or draws it back in. It spreads over you pixel by pixel from the chest outward -- arms and legs, then the head last -- in 2 seconds, and you grow to 2.7 blocks tall. Your moves work with the suit off too.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.suit.resist: Resistance I for as long as the suit is on.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.suit.stats: +15% speed, +20% jump, +20% knockback resistance, and your bare fist hits for 6.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.suit.bonded: Suit off but bonded: +7% speed and +10% knockback resistance.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.biomass.bod: A 200-point bar under your ability boxes. You still take every hit in full, and the Symbiote loses 40% of it as well.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.biomass.reg: Grows back 8 a second after 3 seconds out of combat (4 with the suit on, none while the Blade or Shield is out).
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.biomass.cos: Costs: Blade 0.3 a second, Shield 0.5 a second, healing you about 2 a second, catching an arrow 3.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.biomass.emp: At 0 the suit melts off and every move locks until it is back to 20%.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.tendri: A tendril whips 30 blocks down your aim: 15 damage and a knockback. It can miss, and blocks stop it.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.spike_: A living spike, fast and almost flat: 14 damage and Wither V for 5 seconds. Spikes burst out of your back and arms as it fires.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.leap: Launches you 20 blocks the way you look; the first enemy in your path takes 15. No fall damage on the landing.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.barrag: A second-long flurry of tendrils from both hands, 4 damage a hit, 30 blocks. With the Blade out it is a wide 8-damage slash instead.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.blade: A curved blade grows from your hand: +5 melee, 50% faster swings. Feeds on 0.3 Biomass a second; nothing else fits in that hand.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.spikes: Spikes bristle out of your back and arms and stay out: anything that hits you in melee takes Thorns IV damage.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.tendri: Seven tendrils fan across everything in front of you: 8-10 damage each and Slowness for 7 seconds.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.spike_: Five spikes in a 40-degree fan from both hands, each 14 damage and Wither V.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.grappl: A 30-block tendril reels you to whatever it hits (no fall damage), or pulls a dropped item to you.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.onslau: Hold 3 seconds, then let go: tendrils erupt 9 blocks around you -- 20 damage, Wither III, Blindness, Slowness IV, Weakness II, and they are thrown up. Let go early to cancel for free.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.shield: A living shield: stops 90% of hits from the front, none from the sides or back. Slows you; 0.5 Biomass a second.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.tendri: Seize a target within 15 blocks and hold it helpless. Press C again to hurl it (it is thrown for you after 3.5 seconds).
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.symbio: Replaces Web Wall. In the air it drives you straight down for a 10-damage shockwave on landing; on the ground it is a 6-damage slam.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.passive.rec: Symbiote Recovery: Regeneration III while you are hurt, paid for in Biomass.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.passive.pro: Protector: a heavy, dangerous or fatal hit -- or dropping under 5 hearts -- wraps the suit on you by itself.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.passive.res: Resurrection: a fatal hit brings you back at half health with a tendril blast that throws everything back. Once every 10 minutes (20 for Black Suit Spider-Man and Agent Venom); a sound attack stops it. Black Suit Spider-Man must have the suit on and at least 50 Hunger -- the revive eats the whole meter.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.passive.arr: Arrows that reach you are snatched out of the air (3 Biomass each).
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.passive.clo: Camouflage: crouch for 5 seconds with the suit on to vanish; stand up to reappear.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.passive.pre: Predator Vision: everything alive within 20 blocks is outlined -- hostiles red, players purple, the rest blue. Only you see it; N switches it off and on.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.passive.cla: Living Claws: your empty hand mines like a wooden pickaxe, axe and shovel.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.passive.die: Iron stomach: with the suit on, raw food feeds you like cooked.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.passive.squ: Squadmates: no Symbiote move ever touches them, and their hits cost no Biomass.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.passive.pet: Symbiote Pet: sneak + right-click your tamed wolf or cat (empty hand, suit on) to share the Symbiote with it -- 40 Biomass for a Normal host. Again to take it back.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.passive.via: Symbiote Vial: sneak + use one to cut the Symbiote out of you and bottle it.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.weakness.so: Sound -- a Warden's boom, a bell, a goat horn -- tears the suit off and locks every move for 5 seconds. Sonic damage +50% while suited.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.weakness.fi: Fire and lava hurt 50% more while suited. Burn for 2 seconds and the suit retracts for 10 seconds (you stay bonded).
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.tip.carnage: Call Carnage: hold right-click on a free Symbiote for 5 seconds. It turns crimson and dissolves -- and a Carnage meteor comes down nearby. Let go to cancel. 10-minute cooldown.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.tip.burn: Flint and steel burns a free Symbiote away for good; an empty Vial bottles it.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.tip.biomass: Put the Blade and Shield away when you are not using them, so the Biomass can grow back.
projecthero.guide.symbiote_spider_man.su: H wraps the black suit over your Spider-Man gear or draws it back in -- it spreads from the chest outward, the head last. You keep your own size.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.step.find: Find a loose Symbiote -- break open the Symbiote Meteorite at the heart of a meteor crater and it crawls out of the rock, it waits sealed in the containment cell of a hidden research lab, or it tears itself free of a rare Symbiote Host mob when that mob dies. A free Symbiote is alive: it crawls off looking for a creature to take over -- monsters first, but cows, pigs, sheep, chickens, rabbits, foxes, ocelots, wolves and cats too (and when that host dies it comes back out) -- and it shrinks away from fire, lava and loud sound. It holds still while you reach for it. Use flint and steel on it to set it alight -- it writhes in the flames and burns away for good.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.step.bond: Right-click it (or use a filled Symbiote Vial). The Symbiote tests you first: a BONDING MINIGAME opens -- a marker sweeps across a bar and you must stop it inside the green zone (Space or click) three times running, faster and tighter each round. Miss and the Symbiote recoils: you are nauseous and cannot try again for 5 seconds (nothing is used up). Win and it does not click cleanly into place -- it spreads through you over 35 seconds. During that time you have its protection but none of its abilities, and your body fights it: nausea, weakness, the shakes. Ride it out. Once it settles, press H to let the suit take hold, and H again to retract it. (An operator granting the Symbiote with a command skips all of this.)
projecthero.guide.symbiote.host.normal: Anyone who is neither Spider-Man nor the Punisher becomes a Normal Host: plain black living armour with its own six tendril, mobility and defence abilities.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.host.spider_m: A player who already holds Spider-Man becomes Black Suit Spider-Man instead -- the GeckoLib black suit, keeping the whole web kit, plus three Symbiote moves on Shift+X, Shift+Z and an airborne Shift+C.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.controls.body: A Normal Host's moves (Black Suit Spider-Man keeps his web abilities instead, and Agent Venom the Punisher's kit -- see below and the Punisher chapter).
projecthero.symbiote.ability.tendril_gra: Sneak+C: lash a tendril out of your hand and suspend a target helpless in front of you. Press C again to hurl it away (it is thrown for you after 3.5 seconds). 5-second cooldown.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.tendril_str: R: a living tendril whips out of your hand along your aim, up to 30 blocks, and hits whatever it meets first for 15 damage and a solid knockback. It fires whether or not something is in your sights -- aim well, it can miss. Blocks stop it. Shift+R: Tendril Sweep -- seven tendrils fan across everything in front of you for 8-10 damage each and slow it for 7 seconds.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.leap.desc: X: the Symbiote launches you in the direction you are looking with enough force to carry you 20 blocks -- a single real launch, so you fly and fall in an arc. You ram the first enemy in the way for 15 damage. 2-second cooldown. You take no fall damage until you next land.
G: fire a living spike from your hand -- a real projectile that flies fast and almost flat, so it can miss. It hits for 14 damage and poisons the target with Wither V for 5 seconds. 4-second cooldown. Sneak+G: Spike Fan -- five spikes from both hands in a cone in front of you, 10-second cooldown.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.grapple.des: Sneak + X: fire a tendril up to 30 blocks and reel yourself to it -- no fall damage on the landing. It needs something to hold onto: aimed at open air the tendril reaches out the full distance and finds nothing. Aim at a dropped item and it is pulled to you instead.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.slam.desc: A short-range ground slam that damages and knocks back everything nearby. No terrain damage.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.onslaught.d: The ultimate. Sneak and hold Z for 3 seconds: a pool of living black spreads under you and tendrils claw up out of it, slowing everything inside. Release and it erupts -- a crown of huge tendrils bursts outward to 9 blocks and a tendril spears up out of the ground into every enemy in range: 20 damage, Wither III for 8 seconds, Blindness, Slowness IV and Weakness II, and they are thrown into the air. 90-second cooldown; releasing early cancels it for free.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.shield.desc: Sneak+V: raise a living shield in front of you. It works like a real shield -- it stops almost all damage from your front, nothing from the side or back -- and you are slowed while it holds. No time limit: it feeds on 0.5 Biomass a second while it is up, and drops when the Biomass runs out.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.frenzy.desc: An aggressive burst -- more damage, more speed, more knockback resistance -- with a brief defence dip once it wears off.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.barrage.des: Z: a flurry of tendrils from alternating hands for over a second, each one flying down your aim up to 30 blocks and hitting whatever it meets -- it fires whether you are aiming at something or not, so it can miss. Sneak + hold Z charges Symbiote Onslaught, the ultimate. With Symbiote Blade out, Z is a wide slashing arc instead.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.blade.desc: V: a curved living blade grows out of your hand -- +5 melee, swings 50% faster, bites past armour. No time limit: it feeds on 0.3 Biomass a second while it is out, and dissolves when the Biomass runs out. Nothing can be held in that hand while it is out: scroll onto an item and your hand snaps back to the blade, and anything that lands in it is tucked into your pack. Sneak+V toggles Symbiote Shield.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.spikes.desc: C: raise living spikes -- attackers in melee take reflected damage, like Thorns IV. Sneak+C is Tendril Grab.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.spike_fan.d: Sneak+G: five Symbiote Spikes at once, fanned across 40 degrees in front of you -- each one 14 damage and Wither V for 5 seconds. Its own 10-second cooldown, shown as a thin strip along the bottom of the G box.
message.projecthero.symbiote.spent: The Symbiote is spent -- give it time to recover
message.projecthero.symbiote.recovered: The Symbiote steadies -- it can fight again
message.projecthero.symbiote.suit_collap: The Symbiote is spent -- the suit melts away
message.projecthero.symbiote.suit_locked: No Biomass left to form the suit -- it needs %s%% to reform
message.projecthero.symbiote.blade_no_it: The blade fills your hand -- sheathe it (V) to hold anything
message.projecthero.symbiote.warn_1: I can't keep this up forever...
message.projecthero.symbiote.blade_spent: The blade dissolves -- it needs to reform
message.projecthero.symbiote.blade_hands: Empty your hand to form the blade
message.projecthero.symbiote.cloaked: The Symbiote folds light around you
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.fire_d: FIRE IS DESTROYING US. Extinguish it.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.both_d: We are both dying. GET OUT.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.host_d: Host death imminent. RUN. You will not die.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.fallin: We are weak. Catch something -- grapple.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.biomas: WE ARE DYING. Do not let them hit us again.
Critical biomass. Our body is failing.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.form_c: We cannot protect you. Our form is collapsing.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.surrou: We are surrounded and wounded. Break through.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.big_hi: That damaged us badly. Do not take another hit like that.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.you_ar: You are fine. We are not. Stop using us as armour.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.we_can: We can still protect you. Get to safety.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.fight_: Too soon. We have not recovered. Fight carefully.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.boss_w: This fight will last too long. Withdraw.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.boss: Powerful organism detected. This is not ordinary prey.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.incomi: Too much incoming fire. Find cover.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.multip: Multiple threats. We are being surrounded.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.biomas: Half our biomass remains. We are injured.
We need time to recover. Avoid unnecessary damage.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.repair: We are repairing ourselves. Give us time.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.stop_g: Stop getting hit. We are trying to recover.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.need_f: You need food. Your body lacks energy and our healing slows.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.unseen: They do not know we are here.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.we_are: We are whole. We are ready.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.lava_n: Do not. The lava will tear us apart.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.fire_o: Water. Stay in it until the fire is out.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.host_c: Critical injury. Disengage. We cannot sustain this.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.big_fa: Long way down. Grapple -- we have the reach.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.biomas: This is a bad idea. We cannot protect you like this.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.keep_m: Good. Keep moving. Do not stop.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.use_he: You have healing. Use it now.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.both_f: Both of us are failing. Retreat.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.boss_a: Powerful organism detected. This is not ordinary prey.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.cluste: They are clustered. Strike them all.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.we_are: You do not need a weapon. We are the weapon.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.weapon: Your weapon is damaged. It will not last.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.two_th: Two of them. Do not let them flank us.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.lone_p: Alone. And it has not seen us.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.strike: They have not seen us. Strike from above.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.avoid_: Avoid them. This fight is not worth it.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.good_g: Good. Keep your distance while we heal.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.biomas: Our condition is worsening. We cannot keep taking hits like this.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.host_5: You are injured. Avoid unnecessary damage.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.host_3: Host survival probability falling. We should retreat.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.host_s: Condition stabilizing. We are repairing you.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_swi: Faster. We were made to move like this.
Let go of the line. We will catch the next one.
Your webs never pulled this hard before us.
So high. Nothing down there can touch us.
Look at them all. Small as insects.
The whole city, laid out for us to take.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_wal: Walls, ceilings... all of it is ours to crawl.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_pre: It has not looked up. They never look up.

projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk3_r: A palm repulsor bolt: 14 to the first thing in 40 blocks.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk3_t: A bolt from each hand at once: 2 x 12.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk3_u: Hold to charge the chest beam (full at 1.5 s), release to fire: up to 36, piercing 40 blocks.
The Unibeam swept across a 90-degree arc: 24 to everything it crosses.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk3_f: 3 s of x1.8 flight speed. Takes off if you are on the ground.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk3_b: A sideways dodge roll: nothing can hurt you for 0.6 s.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk3_m: Locks up to 3 targets in front and sends a missile at each: 18 each.
6 missiles rain onto the crosshair area: 14 each.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk3_t: Hold: pull a mob or item within 20 blocks to you and keep it there. Release to let go. 15 energy a second.
Fling what the beam holds (or the nearest thing in front): 16.
Toggle: mobs within 32 blocks are outlined (only you see them) and your hits get a 20% crit chance. 4 energy a second.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk4_t: A straight torpedo: 30. Fast in water; out of water it drops.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk4_h: A torpedo that homes in on the nearest target: 26.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk4_s: Outlines every mob within 48 blocks, through walls, for 10 s. Only you see them.
10 to everything within 8 blocks and a 2 s stun (4 s on Guardians and water mobs).
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk4_h: A jet dash where you look. Three times as strong in water.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk4_b: Underwater: sink fast. On land: a stomp, 20 within 4 blocks (no fall damage).
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk4_d: A thrown charge that sinks and blows: 28 within 4 blocks.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk4_m: Lays 3 proximity mines in front of you: 22 each. They last 60 s.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk4_w: A vortex where you aim pulls in mobs within 10 blocks for 4 s: 3 a second.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk4_b: An 8 s air bubble round you (4 blocks): you and allies breathe, mobs are pushed out.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.comic.e1mk4_h: Toggle: strong lamps light up where you are and where you look.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_pre: Drop on it. Wrap it. It will never know.
Patience. Let it walk right beneath us.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_hid: Stay still. We are a shadow on the wall.
They cannot see us. Choose one.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_sen: Your tingle and our instinct. Move!
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_coc: Wrapped tight. We can feed on it later.
Our webs are stronger now. It is not going anywhere.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_tak: Up into the dark with you.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_str: More. Every one makes us stronger.
Do not stop now. We are only waking up.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_bos: That one is big. Webs first, then fists.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_hp_: You are bleeding. We are holding you together.
Get above it. Swing out and breathe.
Not like this. Swing away. Now!
We will not let you fall. Not today.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_fir: Fire! Get it off us! Find water!
It burns! Out of the flames, now!
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_sta: We are starving. Hit something and feed us.
Why hold back? Let us taste the fight.
You pull your punches. We feel it.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_bon: Yes. Now you feel what we can do.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_ove: We are not letting go. Not until we are fed.
Your food is ours now. Your strength is ours.
Do not fight us. Fight them.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_ful: We are full. Let us take over.
Let go of the leash. Just for a moment.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_foo: Eat something. We are hungry, so you are hungry.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_tak: Now we are bigger. Now they run.
No more holding back. Tear through them.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_cra: Too much... we need to rest.
Spent. Give us time. Give us a fight later.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_pat: Up here we can see everyone who needs us.
We could swing all night. Can you?
Do not go home yet. The night is young.
Listen. Trouble, somewhere below. Let us find it.
You were never this strong before us.
They will learn to fear the spider.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_sui: Why take us off? We make you better.
Put us back on. The city needs what we can do.
Cloth and thread. You are wasting yourself.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_bon: Hold still. We fit you like a second skin.
Your webs, our strength. Let us in.
We feel everything you feel. Everything.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_wra: You are hurt. We wrap you, like it or not.
That hit would have broken you. We took it.
No. You do not die while we are here.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_res: Up. We spent everything we had on you.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bs_son: That noise! It tears us apart!
Quiet again. We are back with you.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.patrol: This world is full of prey.
The quiet is ours for now.
Where do we go now, host?
Listen. Something always moves out there.
We are whole. We are patient.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bond_h: Hold still. This is easier if you do not struggle.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bond_d: Do not fight us. We are not here to hurt you.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bond_a: Almost. We are almost part of you.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bond_y: Your pain is ours now. We will carry it.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bond_w: When this is done, nothing will touch you without going through us.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bond_s: You were never strong enough alone. Together, we will be.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.bond_b: Breathe. The shaking will stop soon.
projecthero.symbiote.ability.symbiote_sl: Airborne, it drives you straight down for a 10-damage shockwave on landing; on the ground it is a 6-damage slam where you stand.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.spider_passiv: Symbiote Spider-Man keeps his own kit: the black suit (extra armour), the extra abilities above, a double-size web reserve and stronger swings and Spider-Sense. The base host's Biomass bar, Regeneration, Resistance, camouflage, Predator Vision and tool-claws are not part of it.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.bioma: Biomass -- the Symbiote's own 200-point life bar, shown under the ability boxes as a percentage and a thin bar. When a hit lands on you (in full), the Symbiote also loses 40% of that damage from its Biomass -- falls and your squadmates never cost it anything. Out of combat for 3 seconds it repairs itself at 8 Biomass a second (4 while the suit is on, and not at all while the Blade or Shield is feeding on it). Dying does not refill it: you come back with the Biomass you had. At zero Biomass the suit melts off you and every Symbiote ability locks; neither the abilities nor the suit come back -- not even by the Symbiote wrapping you itself -- until it has recovered to 20%.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.recov: Symbiote Recovery -- Regeneration III whenever you are not at full health, paid for with a little of the Symbiote's Biomass (about 2 per second of healing). It does nothing while you are at full health.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.bare_: Living Claws -- your empty hand mines and harvests like a wooden pickaxe, axe and shovel all at once.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.weakness.soni: Sound attacks -- a Warden's boom, a bell, a goat horn -- tear the suit off you and disable every Symbiote ability for 5 seconds, and the Symbiote reacts out loud. Sonic damage also hurts 50% more while suited.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.weakness.fire: Fire and lava hurt 50% more while suited. Stay on fire for more than 2 seconds and the suit deactivates -- it retracts and cannot be called back for 10 seconds (it will not re-wrap you on its own while you burn). The bond itself is never lost.
projecthero.guide.symbiote_spider_man.bo: A Symbiote that bonded with an existing Spider-Man: the living black suit over the web-slinger's own gear. With the suit on, six web moves become symbiote moves, and its strength depends on how well you keep it fed (Hunger).
projecthero.guide.symbiote_spider_man.pa: Web Reserve capacity doubled -- a permanent perk of the bond, kept even with the suit retracted.

projecthero.guide.green_lantern.body: A bonded Power Ring channels willpower into Ring Charge — a reserve shown as a percentage that fuels flight, ranged bolts, shields and hard-light constructs shaped on the fly. A permanent, passive Resistance II comes with the bond itself, suited or not. Everything the ring makes is now a visible shape of hard light — the fist that flies, the hammer that falls, missiles, a buzzsaw, an anvil, a giant hand, a knight of light — and the Lantern moves with it: every ability has its own animation. Green Lantern is the mod's toolbox hero: exceptionally versatile, with the Ring Charge pool and construct upkeep as the balancing axis — strong offense, defence and utility at once drains it fast.
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.step.fin: Find a Fallen Lantern Site — a rare, damaged crater holding a Dormant Power Ring pedestal.
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.step.tri: Requires experience level 20 or higher, and starting the trial consumes those 20 levels. Right-click the pedestal to begin the Will Trial: three waves of enemies within 32 blocks — glowing green, immune to daylight burning. A shimmer of green particles marks the edge of the trial; everyone and everything but you and the trial's own mobs is pushed straight back out, and re-expelled if they wander in again. Leaving the radius for 8s, dying or logging out fails it (10-minute cooldown to retry). Win, and the ring asks only: 'Are you afraid?' Answer NO to earn the ring — the pedestal breaks for good and the ring and its Power Battery core are yours. Answer YES and the trial is cancelled with nothing gained, the site immediately open to anyone (you included) again. Right-click the ring to put it on: it bonds and the item is used up — and it makes you Green Lantern in place of whatever other Primary power you had (a bonded Symbiote is removed too).
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.charge.b: 0-10,000, with no passive regeneration at all — the only way to recharge is a Personal Power Battery. The last 250 points are an emergency reserve, spendable only on an emergency flight descent — never on attacks or constructs. You take no fall damage at all as long as the ring has any charge left.
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.flight.b: Double-tap Space while airborne to take off, or land to end it automatically, the same gesture Thor and Iron Man use. Ring Flight is directional: hold forward and you fly exactly where you are looking, climbing or diving with your aim, while strafing, Space (up) and Sneak (down) still work like creative flight, and letting go of everything eases you into a steady hover. The whole time you are in the air, a very faint skin of green light hugs your body, following every move. Costs a flat 1 charge/sec while flying. Sprint to fly much faster at 40 charge/sec: a streamer of hard light trails out behind you from your feet, with two strands of light twisting round it, and the glow gets a little brighter. Ends safely on depletion with a brief controlled descent instead of a plummet.
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.air_tank: No key press needed. Swim below half your air supply and the ring builds a small hard-light rebreather on your own body — a tank on your back, a mask under your chin, pipes connecting them — that keeps your air topped up for as long as you're underwater and can afford 1 charge/sec. Shuts off the instant you surface or the ring can't cover it.
Ring Bolt (tap) / Beam (hold) / Shift: Blast Wave

Tap R to fire a streak of hard light from the ring hand (18 damage, 40-block range, 10 charge). Hold R to channel a solid beam instead: 5 damage every 0.3 seconds (about 17 DPS) for as long as you hold it, draining charge as it goes and slowing you a little; your free hand grips your wrist to steady it. Sneak + R sends a Blast Wave: a wall of green light rolls out over the 120 degrees in front of you, 8 blocks deep, throwing back everything it hits for 18 damage with Slowness III for 4 seconds (7s cooldown, 150 charge). Your squad and pets are never hit.
Construct Fist / Shift: War Hammer Slam

A giant fist of light flies from your ring (up to 20 blocks) and smashes the first thing in its path for 24 with heavy knockback, splashing half that onto anything next to it (1.5s cooldown, 30 charge). Shift raises a huge war hammer of light over your head and brings it down on the ground ahead: 26 damage and a knock-up to everything within 10 blocks (4s cooldown, 40 charge).
Green Lantern's Light! / Shift: Emerald Gatling

Hold to recite the Oath, your ring fist raised before your face (release early and it's cancelled, no cost). Finish it and you punch the ring to the sky, empowered for 30 seconds: double ability damage, double melee, double construct strength — at double the Ring Charge cost for everything, plus a flat 10 charge/sec just to sustain it. An 80-second cooldown follows once it ends. Shift + hold X instead spins up the Emerald Gatling: six barrels of light form on your fist and hose the crosshair with 10 bolts a second (5 damage each, 2 charge a shot) for up to 8 seconds.

Hold Z to wrap yourself in a bubble of hard light. While it is up, every arrow, bullet and blow struck in person is stopped, from any side, and projectiles that fly into it are destroyed. Explosions, fire, magic and falls still get through. The bubble has 150 HP of its own: everything it stops chips it, it shows cracks and turns amber, then red as it weakens, and at 0 it shatters. A thin bar above your ability keys shows its HP while it is up and while it heals. It costs 20 charge a second for as long as you hold Z, and drops by itself when the ring runs dry. Whenever you let go (or it breaks) it goes on an 8-second cooldown and heals 5 HP a second; the bar disappears once it is full again. Sneak + Z expands a 10-block dome out from you over a second and a half instead, pushing out anyone nearby who is not in your squad and keeping them out while it is up. Sneak + Z again dismisses it early (8-second cooldown). The dome has an uptime meter above your ability keys: up to 22 seconds of continuous use, refilling once you stop.

H forms or retracts the hard-light suit (it was on V). You hold the ring out in front of you and watch it as the suit pours out of it: it spreads up your ring arm and out over your body behind a bright green edge while the ring blazes, and recedes back into the ring when you take it off. Pick which suit it forms with Sneak + N. Full diamond-level protection (20 armour, 2.0 toughness) plus a flat +10 melee damage bonus while worn. Costs 10 charge to summon, plus 1 charge every 5 seconds while worn — running out of charge forces it to retract.
Deploy Construct / hold: construct wheel / Shift: Missile Barrage

Tap to shape the selected construct. Hold for half a second to open the construct wheel — a ring of every construct, grouped into Attack, Defence, Mobility and Utility, with the one under your cursor described in the middle — and pick a different one. Shift fires a Missile Barrage: six homing missiles of light streak out at the hostiles in front of you and burst for 12 each (8s cooldown, 60 charge). A construct still on cooldown is listed, with a countdown, just above the HUD.

V (it was on H): a huge hand of light closes round whatever is under your crosshair (up to 28 blocks), lifts it in front of you and crushes it (6 damage every half-second). Press V again — or wait 6 seconds — to hurl it where you look; whatever it slams into takes 22, and so does it (10s cooldown, 50 charge). Sneak + V casts Ring Scan: every living creature within 50 blocks glows through walls for 6 seconds, red for hostiles and green for everything else — visible only to you, on a 5-second cooldown.

N dismisses every construct you have up; if you are carrying something on the Rescue Tether, the first press sets it down gently. Sneak + N opens the suit screen: pick your suit, switch the flight glow and trail on or off, or take the Power Ring off with its Remove Ring button (see Suits).
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.construc: Shapes of glowing, translucent hard light, not free building blocks. Each costs charge up front, and the lasting ones keep costing upkeep while they stand. They build themselves out in a few ticks as a beam of light traces from your ring, and dissolve in green sparks when they end. Constructs have no time limits: they last until you press N, run out of charge or get broken, except the Sentry Turret (5 at once, 12 seconds each). Cooldowns apply again to the Sentry Turret, Hard-Light Wall, Battering Ram, Rescue Tether, Buzzsaw, Anvil Drop, Chain Snare and Emerald Warrior. Aimed constructs form on the open space in front of whatever you point at. Walls and Sentry Turrets settle onto the ground there, and nothing ever forms inside a player, you included. There are 20 of them, in four groups on the wheel. ATTACK: Energy Blade, Sentry Turret (a spinning core of light that only fires at hostiles it can see), Battering Ram, Buzzsaw (a spinning saw that ricochets between up to 5 enemies and flies back to you), Anvil Drop (a giant anvil of light falls on the spot you aim at), the Emerald Warrior (a knight of hard light with sword and shield that fights beside you until dismissed) and the Sniper Rifle (see below). DEFENCE: Hard-Light Wall, Containment Cage, Chain Snare (chains burst from the ground and pin every hostile within 10 blocks until you let them go, 4 charge a second each), Atmosphere Bubble and Rescue Tether (carries what you grab inside a bubble of hard light, for as long as you like). MOBILITY: Platform (a raised floor where you aim, or under your feet if you are falling and look down), Bridge, Stair/Ramp (real steps), Carry Platform (anyone can ride; press again to make it follow or park) and the Launch Pad (a springboard that flings anything on it about 25 blocks up; you and your squad land safely; 3 at once). UTILITY: Mining Drill, Lantern Light (your ring itself shines, with light that follows you wherever you go plus Night Vision, until you press it again) and the Hard-Light Tool Kit. Mining Drill and Energy Blade deploy for free as an equipped stance: a second press switches them on (only then do they cost anything, and you can see them on your hand), a third turns them off. N dismisses everything.
projecthero.guide.green_lantern.sniper.b: Pick the Sniper Rifle on the construct wheel and press C: a long rifle of hard light forms round your ring fist, with a scope on top and a stock along your forearm (20 charge, then 1 charge a second while it is out). Hold right-click to scope in: the view zooms about 5x behind a green reticle of light. Hold attack to charge a shot; a ring of light round the reticle fills over 0.75 seconds. Let go to fire. The bolt hits instantly, up to 120 blocks away: 22 damage at full charge, about a third of that if you only tap, doubled during the Oath. Every shot costs 25 charge, with 1 second between shots. With too little charge the rifle will not fire. It works in Ring Flight too. While the rifle is out, attack and right-click belong to it, so press C again to put it away (free). N, death or an empty ring also end it.
Craft one (Lantern Core + 4 Emerald Blocks + 2 Amethyst Blocks + an Ender Eye + an Echo Shard): a green lantern with a glowing emblem behind glass. Carried in your hand, it hangs from its handle and swings as you move. To recharge, hold it in your OFF hand and Sneak + right-click. You hold the battery out, press your ring against it and recite the Oath, one line at a time on screen, while the battery glows brighter and brighter. You can look around but cannot move. Finish all four lines (6 seconds) and your ring is full, with a flash of light. Taking any damage, using an ability or letting go of the battery stops it, with nothing gained. This is the only way to recharge: the ring never regenerates charge on its own. A placed battery is just a lantern.
message.projecthero.green_lantern.batter: Hold the Power Battery in your off hand and Sneak + right-click to charge your ring
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.ener: A blade of light on your fist. First press equips it, the next switches it on (+13 melee, longer reach) and off.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.cont: Traps what you aim at in a closed box of light sized to fit it, until you let it go (N) or it breaks.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.sent: A spinning core of light that shoots hostiles it can see (7 per shot). Up to 5 at once.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.batt: A ram head of light shoots along your aim and smashes the first creature it meets for 20, or bursts a door open.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.hard: A 4-high wall of light that settles on the ground where you aim. Very tough.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.plat: A raised floor where you aim -- or right under your feet if you are falling and look down.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.brid: A 20-block, 3-wide bridge of light runs out from your feet.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.stai: A 3-wide flight of real steps you can walk straight up.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.mini: A spinning drill on your fist. Equip, then press again to switch it on: it bores a 2x2 hole every half-second.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.lant: Your ring shines: bright light that follows you, plus Night Vision. Press again to put it out.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.atmo: A bubble of air round you -- breathe anywhere, and so does your squad inside it.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.resc: Grab what you aim at in a bubble of hard light and carry it for as long as you like -- nothing inside can attack (creepers can't blow, skeletons can't shoot). Press again to throw it; N sets it down gently.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.carr: A bright 3x3 platform anyone can ride. Press again to make it follow your aim or park it.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.hard: A glowing pickaxe, axe, shovel, flint and steel and spyglass that never wear out. Drop one and the whole kit fades.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.buzz: A spinning saw of light that ricochets between up to 5 enemies (14 each), then flies back to you.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.anvi: A giant anvil of light falls on the spot you aim at: 34 in the middle, 18 around it, and everything hit is slowed.
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.chai: Chains of light burst from the ground and pin every hostile within 10 blocks in place until you press N (4 charge a second each).
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.laun: A springboard of light where you aim. Anything that steps on it is flung ~25 blocks up (you and your squad land safely).
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.emer: A knight of hard light fights at your side until you dismiss it, hunting down whatever threatens you (12 per blow).
projecthero.green_lantern.construct.snip: A long rifle of light in your ring hand. Right-click to scope in, hold attack to charge (0.75s) and let go to fire: up to 22 damage, 120 blocks, 25 charge a shot. C again puts it away.
message.projecthero.green_lantern.ring_r: Keep holding Sneak + N to take off the Power Ring...
You slide the Power Ring off your finger. Right-click it to put it back on -- or give it to someone worthy.

no evil shall escape my sight.
Let those who worship evil's might,
beware my power... Green Lantern's light!
