projecthero.guide.controls.utility2: N   Utility 2 - with a mutation selected, N is its Utility 2 ability and Sneak+N fires a power combo when you own a matching pair. Hero powers use N first: Max Steel's Go Turbo, the Symbiote's Predator Vision, Spider-Man's mode switch, Wolverine's sniff. Alt+N always fires your mutation's Utility 2.
message.projecthero.hammer_seer.title: Directions to Mjolnir
message.projecthero.hammer_seer.wrong_di: The villager only knows the lay of the overworld.
message.projecthero.hammer_seer.none: The villager shrugs. "I know of no free hammer anywhere near here."
message.projecthero.hammer_seer.bearing: The villager whispers: "Mjolnir lies to the %s. Walk that way and the storm will lead you to it."
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.prote: Protector -- if a single hit does more than 3 damage, if a hit would leave you under 5 hearts, or if it would be fatal, the Symbiote wraps you in the suit by itself. It also wraps you whenever you drop below 5 hearts. The suit stays on until you retract it. (Retract it by hand and it holds off for a few seconds; with its Biomass spent it cannot wrap you at all.)
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.resis: Living Armour -- the suit is diamond-grade armour and gives you Resistance I while it is on.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.growt: Suit-up -- the suit spreads over you in 2 seconds, pixel by pixel from the chest outward with the head last, and a normal host grows to 2.7 blocks tall (an Iron Golem) as it does. Retracting it runs backwards and shrinks them back. Symbiote Spider-Man keeps his own size.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.cloak: Camouflage -- crouch for 5 seconds in a row with the suit on and the Symbiote hides you completely, suit and all. Stand up (or retract the suit) and you reappear.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.preda: Predator Vision -- while bonded you see every living thing within 20 blocks outlined: hostile mobs red, other players dark purple, everything else dark blue. Only YOU see it -- nobody else's view changes. Press N (Utility 2) to switch it off and on.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.resur: Resurrection -- the Symbiote will not let its host die. When you take a fatal hit it brings you back at half health, erupts in massive tendrils that hurl everything within 20 blocks away from you (never your squadmates), and grants Resistance for 20 seconds. It costs no Biomass, but it can only do it once every 10 minutes -- 20 for Black Suit Spider-Man and Agent Venom -- (the wait survives relogging), and a sound attack stops it entirely.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.passive.vial: Symbiote Vial -- craft a vial from Iron Blocks and Glass. Sneak + use one to cut your bonded Symbiote out of you and bottle it; right-click a free Symbiote with an empty vial to bottle that one instead. Use a filled vial to bond with what is inside.
message.projecthero.symbiote_vial.hint: Sneak + use to draw your Symbiote into the vial, or right-click a free Symbiote with it.
message.projecthero.symbiote_vial.no_bon: You have no bonded Symbiote to draw out.
message.projecthero.symbiote_vial.extrac: The Symbiote pours out of you and into the vial.
message.projecthero.symbiote_vial.captur: The Symbiote is drawn into the vial.
item.projecthero.symbiote_vial.desc1: Sneak + use: draw your bonded Symbiote into the vial.
item.projecthero.symbiote_vial.desc2: Or right-click a free Symbiote to bottle it.
item.projecthero.symbiote_vial_filled.de: Use to release the Symbiote into yourself, or right-click your tamed wolf or cat to give it to them.
It bonds as if it had touched them.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.equip_: That hit will not land twice. We cover you.
You are bleeding out. Let us wrap you.
Not today. We will not let you die.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.resurr: DEATH DENIED. We pay in flesh -- stay on your feet.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.sonic_: THE SOUND. It tears us off you -- we cannot answer for five heartbeats.
That sound... we are deaf and powerless. Give us a moment.
The ringing fades. We are ours again.
screen.projecthero.symbiote_bond_game.hi: Stop the marker inside the green zone. SPACE or click. Three times. Esc to pull away.
message.projecthero.symbiote.bond_game.b: The organism reaches for you. Match its rhythm...
message.projecthero.symbiote.bond_game.f: The Symbiote recoils -- you could not match its rhythm. Your head swims.
message.projecthero.symbiote.bond_game.r: Your body is not ready to try again for %ss.
message.projecthero.symbiote.bond_game.l: The Symbiote is gone -- the bond slips away.
item.projecthero.adamantium_serum.desc1: Ascends a regenerative mutation into something far harder to kill.
item.projecthero.adamantium_serum.desc2: Useless to anyone who does not already own Super Regeneration.
message.projecthero.wolverine.evolved: Your healing factor tears itself apart and rebuilds harder -- bone, sinew, and something stronger than either.
message.projecthero.wolverine.acquired: You are WOLVERINE. Press H to deploy your claws.
message.projecthero.wolverine.rage_not_r: Your rage is only %s%% full. Fight -- take hits, deal hits.
message.projecthero.wolverine.rage_activ: You are already in a rage.
message.projecthero.wolverine.fall_survi: Your legs shatter -- the healing factor takes the fall!
hud.projecthero.wolverine.title: WOLVERINE
projecthero.guide.wolverine.tier: Primary Power - Ascension of Super Regeneration
projecthero.guide.wolverine.body: Your regenerative mutation, taken all the way: a healing factor that shrugs off almost anything, a stronger and faster body, and retractable adamantium claws. It is a fighter's power -- close range, brutal, and very hard to put down.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.step.prereq: 1. Own Super Regeneration (power 12). Wolverine cannot be obtained without it.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.step.serum: 2. Craft an Adamantium Serum (4 diamonds, 2 netherite ingots, 2 blaze powder, a golden apple) and use it. It consumes Super Regeneration and replaces your mutations, like any Primary power. Admins: /wolverine power grant.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.claws.body: Three curved blades in each hand, hidden until you want them. H deploys or retracts them: deploying, you raise both fists in front of your face, then throw your arms down to your sides as the blades snap out of the backs of your fists (claws an ability brings out just appear, with no flourish); retracting, they simply slide back in. While they are out they are your tools: they dig like an iron shovel and chop like an iron axe (the same speed and the same drops), cut like a sword (cobwebs give way at once and drop their string, plants and leaves 1.5x faster), and you mine 1.5x faster on top of that. Right-clicking a block with them does nothing a tool would -- no dirt paths, no stripped logs. With them out your bare-hand attack is 12 damage (1 + your +3 strength + the claws' +8). You cannot hold items in either hand while the claws are out (they are stowed in your inventory). Left-click chains a three-hit combo: a rising diagonal slash with the right claws, a horizontal slash with the left, then a finisher -- both arms raised high, raked down into an X across your chest -- the same damage every hit. Every claw strike leaves a thin slash trail behind the blade tips and throws adamantium sparks (in first person too). Hold right-click to block: both sets of claws cross in front of you and anything a shield could stop does 30% less damage (falls, fire, drowning and magic still get through), but -- like a raised shield -- you can't attack while guarding. Deploying the claws tears through your hands for 4 damage (never enough to kill you) -- but that is not a fight: it never fills your Rage bar and never tears your suit. Every claw move deploys them for you if they are away. Other players see your claws and every move.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.suit.body: A craftable yellow-and-blue suit (Cowl, Suit, Leggings, Boots) made from leather and yellow / blue dye, found in the Superheroes tab. It gets visibly torn and bloodied as your health drops (and stays torn, repairing itself over 20 seconds once you recover), with big chunks breaking away to bare your skin, and is almost torn off during the Death Surge (until your skin is 50% back). Chainmail-level protection, diamond-level durability, and it mends itself: once you have been out of combat for 30 seconds (no damage dealt or taken), every damaged piece regains 1 durability a second, worn or carried. Anyone can wear it.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.death.body: If a Wolverine dies, his body gives way to raw flesh and bone for the death animation, visible to everyone.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.sniff: Sniff: a few sharp sniffs of the air, and every living thing within 40 blocks is highlighted for 20 seconds. No cooldown; your own screen only.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.lmb: Claws out: combo -- rising slash, horizontal slash, X finisher
projecthero.guide.wolverine.rmb: Claws out: hold to block -- 30% less damage, no attacking
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.claw: A fast forward slash for 18 damage to everything in a box 3.5 blocks deep and 3 blocks wide in front of you. 1.5-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.cros: Two crossing cuts, 12 + 12 damage, to everything in a box 3 blocks deep and 3 blocks wide in front of you. 4-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.claw: Launch yourself 21 blocks along your aim, leaning into the lunge with both claws thrust forward -- both claw tips leave a trail through the whole leap. You cannot dash through blocks and you are knockback-immune mid-dash. Every enemy in a 3-block-wide path takes 12 damage (once each), and the first one you hit -- mob or player -- is grabbed and dragged along in front of you until you land. Your claw moves swing left and right hands in turn. 6-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.bers: Needs a full rage meter (it fills the C box on your HUD): every hit you land or take fills 1% of it, whatever the damage, and it drains 5% per second once you have gone 10 seconds without a fight. Then 30 seconds of fury: +50% damage, +30% speed, 20% extra damage reduction and near-total knockback immunity. The meter empties when it starts; no cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.fren: Five rapid strikes, 8 damage each (0.2 s apart), spread over the nearest enemies within 4 blocks -- each strike also cuts anyone within 2 blocks of its target for 3. Needs a target. 15-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.adam: Shift+Z (v0.16.1; it was plain Z): hold for 5 seconds to charge (you move slowly while charging), then release: whatever you are looking at within 10 blocks glows red for you and Wolverine launches straight at them for a 60-damage claw strike with heavy knockback. A whiff only costs 8 seconds. 30-second cooldown, its own.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.bers: Leap high, arms raised, then slam down claws-first where you land: 16 damage to everything within 3 blocks and they are knocked into the air, with a shockwave ring. 12-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.risi: A crouched, low-to-high slash: 14 damage to what is in front of you (3.5 blocks deep, 2.5 wide) and it is launched into the air, leaving a vertical trail. 4-second cooldown, separate from Claw Slash.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.whir: Arms flung wide, you spin a full turn twice: each spin hits everything within 3.5 blocks for 10, all the way round, leaving a ring of claw trails. 7-second cooldown, separate from Cross Slash.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.poun: Leap onto the enemy you are aiming at (up to 14 blocks): you land on it, pin it in place for 1.5 seconds and rake it 3 times for 6 each. Bosses are not pinned, only raked. No target, no cooldown. 10-second cooldown, separate from Claw Dash.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.blee: Six fast slashes into a cone in front of you, 5 damage each, and everything they cut is lacerated: 1 more damage a second for 4 seconds (steel-blue flecks, no blood). No target, no cooldown. 12-second cooldown, separate from Frenzy.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.ability.fera: A roar that throws back every enemy within 6 blocks and leaves them weakened (Weakness I, 5 s), with a shockwave ring. It does not need the rage bar. 20-second cooldown.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.toggle: Claw toggle: deploy / retract the claws
projecthero.guide.wolverine.passives.bod: Healing factor: 1.5 HP every 5 ticks (6 HP/s), but every HP it heals is paid from a Healing Factor pool of 250 HP (the green bar on your HUD, with its percentage). At 0 the healing factor is OFF until the pool has some charge again. The pool only refills once you have gone 5 seconds without TAKING damage, then 5 HP per second. 35% less physical damage, 75% knockback resistance, 75% less fall damage. Strong Poison and Wither resistance. Strength: +3 melee damage whatever is in your hand -- a bare fist hits for 4, an iron sword for 9, an axe or any weapon 3 more than usual -- and 12 with the claws out (the +3 is counted once; the claws add their own +8). Jump 2 blocks high (no passive speed bonus). Any mob hunting you glows orange, for you alone (enhanced senses). Fire still hurts, but you outheal it while the pool lasts. Lethal falls: a fall that would kill you leaves you at half a heart instead. The Healing Factor pool takes the damage (at most 100 -- anything beyond is not taken), your legs turn to raw flesh and you are slowed (Slowness VI) for 20 seconds, then your skin phases back in over the flesh across another 20 seconds. It needs some pool left: with the healing factor spent, a lethal fall still kills.
message.projecthero.wolverine.hands_full: No room to stow your items -- the claws retract.
message.projecthero.wolverine.claws_no_i: You cannot hold items with the claws out.
projecthero.guide.wolverine.emergency.bo: A lethal hit does not kill you: you burst in a spray of blood and rise at 30% health as a raw flesh-and-bone body. It fires on EVERY lethal hit (no cooldown), but each Death Surge costs 30 Healing Factor -- if you have less than 30 Healing Factor left it does NOT fire and you die normally. /kill and the void always work. For the first 5 seconds you cannot take any damage. Your skin only grows back while you are at FULL health: 20 seconds at full HP in total (dropping below full HP pauses it, it never resets). Until your skin is 50% back you are slowed (Slowness III), blinded and weakened (milk will not clear it) and a red shadow closes in on your screen; past 50% they lift. A Death Surge while you are still recovering starts the raw flesh over. The HUD shows 'Skin %' with a thin bar (and 'Full HP to heal' while it is paused). A 3-pixel marker to the left of the Healing Factor bar is ORANGE while you have the 30 Healing Factor a surge needs (the orange tick on the bar marks 30), dark grey when you do not.
message.projecthero.adamantium_serum.no_: Your body has no regenerative mutation for the serum to build on.
item.projecthero.titan_serum.desc1: Drink it, then pick your Titan: Attack, Armoured, Female or Beast. Drink another later to re-forge into a different one.
item.projecthero.titan_serum.desc2: Press H afterwards to transform (a full Steam bar, or hold H at 30%+ for a weaker emergency Titan).
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.unlock: The serum burns through you -- your body remembers being something enormous. You are a TITAN SHIFTER.

Press H to transform with a full Steam bar (or hold H for 5 s at 30%+ for a pale Emergency Titan). In human form R / G / X (and Shift) are Partial Shifting. Inside the Titan every key has a tap and a Shift move -- hold Left-Alt to see them; Shift+X is your Titan's signature, V roars.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.transf: You are a Titan. Press H to change back.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.no_roo: Not enough room to become a Titan here -- find open ground.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.invali: You must be in Titan form to do that.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.need_g: The Titan needs solid ground to leap from.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.full_h: The Titan is already at full health.
hud.projecthero.titan_shifter.title: Titan Shifter
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.tier: Hero Tier -- a Primary power. Gaining it replaces the one you had.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.body: Drink a Titan Serum, pick one of four Titans, and you gain the power to burst into a giant -- a real creature with its own health, armour and a huge body that everyone in the world sees and can fight. You steer it from inside, from the nape of its neck; while you are a Titan you cannot be hurt directly, the Titan takes the hits -- but a hit on the NAPE can cut you out. In human form you can still shift PART of your body (Partial Shifting).
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.step.ser: Craft a Titan Serum (4 Titanium-Gold Plates in the corners, 2 Netherite Ingots above and below, 2 Magma Blocks left and right, a Golden Apple in the middle) and drink it: a picker opens -- click the Titan you want (or press 1-4). Escape picks nothing and keeps the serum. It only UNLOCKS the power -- it does not transform you. Like every Primary power it replaces the power you had. Drink another serum later (in human form) to re-forge into a different Titan; shifters from before v0.16.7 are Attack Titans.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.transfor: Press H on open ground with a FULL Steam bar (the Titan needs room -- leaves and plants in the way are blown aside, solid blocks are not). Below a full bar "Not enough Steam" flashes in red above your hotbar; with 30% or more you can HOLD H for an Emergency Titan instead (see below). Lightning flashes without harm, bystanders are shoved back, and for about 3 seconds you are helpless while the Titan swells up around you. Press H again to change back: the Titan stops and steams for about 3 seconds (it cannot be hurt meanwhile) while you climb out through the back of its neck; then you drift down and its body slumps where it stood, steams and dissolves over one minute. Squad-mates can right-click the Titan to ride its shoulders (two seats, sneak to hop off). Hold Sprint while walking for 3 seconds and the Titan breaks into a run. Press N to grab the mob you are looking at, N again to EAT it (26 damage, 10 s recharge; it fills your hunger and the Titan heals 5 HP per second for 5 seconds), Shift+N to set it gently down.
R: the punch combo -- punch, punch (the other arm), then a Heavy Punch (35). 20 damage and strong knockback, about 0.8 s recharge (the Female Titan's Crystal Jabs are much faster, the Armoured Titan's punches slower, the Beast Titan's Long Swipe reaches 3 blocks further). The punch goes where you AIM: up at something on a ledge or in the air, straight ahead, or down at the ground -- anything right in front of the Titan is still hit too. A missing arm's swings come from the other arm. Shift+R is each Titan's own (see below).

G (Attack, Armoured, Beast): the Titan raises both fists (slowed while it charges), then brings them down: 50 damage in a small area with huge knockback and a shockwave. It lands where you AIM -- on the mob or block under your crosshair up to about 12 blocks past the Titan, even up on a ledge or in the air. With one arm gone it is a one-fisted smash (60%). 8 s recharge.
Z: lifts a foot and stamps: 25 damage and knockback to everything within 6 blocks, dust and a tremor. 6 s recharge.

X: a crouch, then a huge jump (about 20 blocks forward). Leap while SPRINTING (or running) and you launch roughly twice as far. The Armoured Titan leaps 70% as far, the Female Titan 125%. Landing hits everything within 5 blocks for 20. 5 s recharge. Not on one leg.

V: a deafening roar that reaches everything within 32 blocks -- ground level and up -- and hits it with Weakness II and Slowness III for 12 s, Nausea for 3 s, Blindness for 2 s and Mining Fatigue for 3 s. Weaker mobs are thrown back and flee. Bosses only take a quarter of the effect and are not knocked back. 15 s recharge. It also outlines everything within 50 blocks of the Titan in BLUE for 10 seconds -- on your screen only.

C: the Titan heals 10 HP per second for 10 seconds (steam pours off it) and severed limbs regrow twice as fast meanwhile. This is on top of the slow out-of-combat healing that burns Steam. 45 s recharge. Useless at full health.
Shift+C: the skin crystallises for 8 seconds -- 60% less damage, limbs cannot be severed and the nape cannot be cut out, and the Titan looks like hardened crystal. 30 s recharge.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.stats.bo: ATTACK TITAN: 15 blocks, 500 HP, 25 armour -- the balanced brawler. ARMOURED TITAN: 15 blocks, 800 HP, 35 armour, slow, crystal plates always take 35% off every hit, hits 10% harder. FEMALE TITAN: 12 blocks, 450 HP, 20 armour, fast and agile, kick-based. BEAST TITAN: 14 blocks, 600 HP, 22 armour, long arms, throws boulders. Every Titan takes no fall damage, a fifth of fire damage and half of explosions, and shrugs off tiny hits from players -- but ordinary mobs ignore its armour and hurt it normally, and mobs hunting you will attack the Titan. Its steps shake the ground; it tramples leaves and plants but never digs through solid terrain (except the Armoured Titan's Shoulder Charge, see below).
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.defeat.b: At 0 HP the Titan collapses in a cloud of steam and you drop out -- slowed and weakened for 5 seconds. A defeat, or being CUT OUT of the nape (see below), empties your Steam, drops you to 4 hearts and locks shifting for 60 seconds (the HUD counts it down). Logging out inside the Titan puts you back on the ground as a human, refunded like a normal change back; the Titan itself never persists or duplicates.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.commands: /projecthero power grant titan_shifter [player]  (op level 2). Every number above is in config/projecthero_titan_shifter.json.
projecthero.guide.thor.perks.body: Being bound to Mjolnir gives you, permanently and whether or not the hammer is in your hand: +11 melee damage bare-handed, +10 hearts, +18% speed, some knockback resistance, 80% less damage from every source (falls and lightning cannot hurt you at all) and healing of 1 health every 2.5 seconds at all times. Mjolnir itself hits for 11 swung, 18 thrown. Your ability bar stays on screen for as long as you are bound to a hammer, even when Mjolnir is not in your hands.
projecthero.guide.thor.armour.body: Press H while bound to Mjolnir: you raise the hammer to the sky, lightning strikes down on you and Thor's Armour forms piece by piece -- the boots, then the greaves, then the black-and-crimson chestplate and cape -- each one sweeping up your body behind a crackling edge of light as its own bolt lands. It is diamond-level armour: its three pieces add up to a full diamond set (20 armour, 8 toughness), and while you wear it your Storm Energy regenerates 50% faster. You are protected by the whole set from the first moment (anything you were wearing in those slots goes into your inventory). Press H again and it crackles away, chest first. The armour is conjured, not crafted, so it can never leave you: if it falls out of your inventory or you die, it simply despawns.
projecthero.guide.thor.stormbreaker.intr: Thor's second weapon (v0.14.19). Anyone can swing it -- 14 damage at 0.9 attacks a second, three more than Mjolnir -- but only the worthy can use its powers. In anyone else's hands a right-click just clangs.
projecthero.guide.thor.stormbreaker.reci: Recipe: craft an Unforged Stormbreaker. Top row: Netherite Ingot, Nether Star, Netherite Ingot. Middle row: Netherite Ingot, Blaze Rod, Netherite Ingot. Bottom row: a Blaze Rod in the middle. That is 4 netherite ingots and a Wither kill.
projecthero.guide.thor.stormbreaker.forg: Forging: the cold axe has to be forged in the Nether. Throw it into lava there and leave it for 10 seconds -- flames and smoke rise and the forge roars louder as it heats. Pull it out (or let it drift out) and the heat is lost. When it is done the lava bursts and throws the finished Stormbreaker up toward the nearest player. Lava anywhere else is not hot enough. Neither item ever burns, and a freshly forged Stormbreaker never despawns.
projecthero.guide.thor.stormbreaker.thro: Right-click: throw it. It flies about 40 blocks, cuts through up to 4 enemies for 20 damage each, calls lightning down on the first, then always flies back on its own -- no key needed. It lands in your empty main hand, else your inventory, else at your feet, and flies straight past your squadmates.
projecthero.guide.thor.stormbreaker.bifr: Shift + Right-click: open the Bifrost menu. Type X, Y and Z (it starts on where you stand) and press Open Bifrost, or use one of three waypoints: name a slot and press Save here to store where you are standing, Go to travel there, and the cross to clear it. Waypoints are yours for good -- they survive relogging, dying and losing the axe. The rainbow bridge carries you and every squadmate within 8 blocks of you (a squadmate can sneak to stay behind); each keeps their place around you and lands safely -- on solid ground with room to stand, never in a wall, lava or the void (aim at a column with nowhere safe and nothing happens). No distance limit inside the world border, but same dimension only: a waypoint saved in another dimension is greyed out. 1-minute cooldown of its own, shown in the menu -- it no longer holds the throw. Shift + Right-clicking a block within reach with something in your off hand is left alone, so you can still sneak-place blocks.
projecthero.guide.thor.stormbreaker.weap: In a worthy hand it counts as Thor's weapon: Lightning Strike, the Lightning Beam, God of Thunder's Wrath, Thunderclap, Chain Lightning and flight all work with Stormbreaker as well as Mjolnir. Throwing it uses its own right-click; Hammer Volley and Sneak + right-click binding stay Mjolnir's.
projecthero.guide.thor.combo.body: Mjolnir and Stormbreaker each have a 3-hit melee combo (v0.14.20). Land full-strength hits in a row: 1 is a flat swing, 2 a backhand on the other diagonal, 3 a heavy overhead slam. Each hit must land within 1.25 seconds of your swing recharging, or the combo starts over. A weak, spam-clicked hit never advances it, and a miss does not count.
projecthero.guide.thor.combo.finisher: The slam is the finisher: +50% damage on the target. With Mjolnir it cracks like thunder, a shockwave hitting everything within 3 blocks of the target. With Stormbreaker it cleaves through everything within 4.5 blocks in front of you. Neither touches you, your pets or your squad. Then the combo starts over.
projecthero.guide.thor.dual.body: With Mjolnir in one hand and Stormbreaker in the other, your left-click becomes a flowing 4-hit dual-weapon combo: 1, Mjolnir's overhead hammer blow; 2, Stormbreaker's flat axe sweep; 3, a cross-body double swing with both, cutting down in an X; 4, a leaping double slam -- you hop up with both weapons overhead and drive them down as you land. Each hit must land within 1 second of your swing recharging, or the combo starts over. Every hit deals your weapon's normal damage. The four pips above your ability keys show how far into it you are.
projecthero.guide.thor.dual.twin_thunder: Twin Thunder Strike: land the 4th hit in time and, as you come down, you raise both weapons to the sky -- lightning strikes both of them and arcs between them -- then slam them together into the ground. 20 damage to every enemy within 6 blocks, thrown up into the air, the ground cracking open, then a ring of lightning bolts around you that hits the hostile mobs out at the edge. It never hurts you, your squad or anyone's pets. 20-second cooldown (the pips go grey with the seconds left); only while you hold both weapons.
projecthero.guide.thor.storm.body: The god of thunder draws on the storm. While it is thundering where you stand -- anywhere it rains or snows, under a roof or not -- everything you hit hits 30% harder: Mjolnir and Stormbreaker, swung or thrown, every lightning bolt and shockwave, the Twin Thunder Strike and the Thunder Field. Lightning crackles over you while it lasts, and "Storm-Charged +30%" shows above your ability keys.
item.projecthero.thor_armor_chestplate.d: Conjured by pressing H while bound to Mjolnir. Vanishes if it leaves your inventory or you die.
message.projecthero.thor_armor.equipped: Lightning answers your call -- Thor's Armour forms around you, piece by piece.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.low_en: Not enough Steam -- a shift needs a full bar
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.emerge: Emergency shift in %ss -- keep holding H
Titan Form Exhausted -- still drained from the last Emergency Titan -- recharge Steam to 100% first.
projecthero.titan_shifter.type.generic_t: Balanced brawler. RAGE: hits harder and faster the more it is hurt; Shift+X sends it into a full rage.
projecthero.titan_shifter.type.armored_t: Slow, crystal-plated tank: every hit 35% softer. SHOULDER CHARGE ploughs through mobs and stone.
projecthero.titan_shifter.type.female_ti: Fast and agile, all kicks. CRYSTAL FISTS harden fists, shins and nape; her SCREAM drags mobs in.
projecthero.titan_shifter.type.beast_tit: A hunched brute with a pitcher's throw and long reach. BOULDER THROW rips up the ground and hurls it -- shrapnel on impact.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.reforg: The serum re-forges you -- you are now the %s.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.pick_n: Change back to human form first.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.no_arm: The Titan needs an arm for that -- wait for it to regrow.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.no_leg: The Titan needs both legs for that -- wait for them to regrow.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.emerge: Emergency shift cancelled -- you opened a screen.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.bite_s: Bite Shift needs a full Steam bar.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.wall_b: No room for a Crystal Wall there.
screen.projecthero.titan_picker.title: Choose Your Titan
screen.projecthero.titan_picker.hint: Click a Titan (or press 1-4). Esc: decide later, keep the serum.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.kit.gene: ATTACK TITAN -- R Punch combo (Shift: Titan Kick, 30, a wide low sweep). G Heavy Smash (Shift: Uppercut, 38, launches what it hits, 6 s). Z Stomp (25 in 6 blocks; Shift: Dropkick, 32 to everything in its path as it flies forward, 9 s). Shift+X RAGE (signature): passively it hits up to 50% harder and its combo recharges up to 40% faster the more HP it has lost; Shift+X sends it into a full rage for 10 s whatever its health (30 s recharge).
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.kit.armo: ARMOURED TITAN -- crystal plates always take 35% off every hit. R Plated Punch combo, slower (Shift: Plated Elbow, 30, a big shove, 3 s). G Heavy Smash (Shift: Ground Pound, 55 in 7 blocks after a long wind-up, 12 s). Z Stomp (Shift: Brace, 3 s rooted taking a quarter of all damage while every hostile within 24 blocks turns on the Titan, 15 s). Shift+X SHOULDER CHARGE (signature): 1.5 s shoulder-first sprint hitting everything in front for 40 with a huge shove, ploughing through blocks up to stone hardness (no drops) when the server allows ability terrain damage and the mobGriefing gamerule is on -- otherwise walls stop it. 12 s.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.kit.fema: FEMALE TITAN -- R Crystal Jab combo, very fast (Shift: Roundhouse, 34 across the whole front, 2.5 s). G Axe Kick (42 where you aim, 7 s; Shift: Sweep Kick, 24 and Slowness to everything low around her, 8 s). Z Stomp (Shift: SCREAM, every hostile within 48 blocks turns on her and the near ones are dragged in, 25 s). Shift+X CRYSTAL FISTS (signature): fists and shins crystallise for 12 s -- every hit +50% -- and so does the nape, so it cannot be cut out meanwhile. 30 s.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.kit.beas: BEAST TITAN -- R Long Swipe combo, 3 blocks more reach (Shift: PITCHER'S FASTBALL -- it scoops a handful of ground, crushes it to gravel in its fist and pitches it overarm at your crosshair: 14 fast stones in a tight shotgun spray, 9 each, at most 3 on one target, about 80 blocks of range, 8 s). G Heavy Smash (Shift: Rock Scatter, rakes up the ground and flings real tumbling rubble over a 12-block cone -- 18 to everything it hits, 8 s). Z Stomp (Shift: Boulder Volley, three boulders fanned round the crosshair, 20 each plus shrapnel, 14 s). Shift+X BOULDER THROW (signature): it rips a boulder out of the ground and pitches it at your crosshair -- 45 in 4 blocks where it lands, shrapnel for half out to 8. Boulders burst into real debris and a ring of dust. Ripping up the ground only removes blocks when terrain damage and mobGriefing are on. 10 s.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.nape.bod: You sit in the back of the Titan's neck. Hits that land on the NAPE -- from behind, at or above the shoulders -- deal 3x damage. A heavy nape hit (10% of its max HP or more), or any nape hit while it is under 20% HP, CUTS YOU OUT: you are thrown out of the neck, the body is left behind, your Steam empties, you drop to 4 hearts and cannot shift for 60 s. NAPE EXPOSED! flashes on the HUD when a hostile is behind the Titan. Shift+V (Nape Guard, every Titan) claps a hand over it for 4 s -- normal damage and no cut-out (20 s recharge); Hardening and the Female Titan's Crystal Fists also stop a cut-out.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.limbs.bo: One hit on an arm or leg taking 12% of the Titan's max HP or more (or an explosion taking 6%) severs it, in a burst of steam. A missing arm cannot punch -- the combo uses the other arm, and moves needing an arm wait for one. A missing leg drops the Titan to one knee: it drags itself at a third of its speed, cannot run, jump, leap or kick; with both gone it cannot walk. A severed limb regrows after 8 seconds (4 with Regeneration) for 5 Steam -- steam pours from the stump meanwhile. Hardening stops limbs being severed. The HUD silhouette shows what is missing.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.human.bo: In human form (with no mutation selected) R, G and X shift part of your body. R TITAN ARM: your arm swells into a Titan's for one punch down your look -- 16 and a huge shove, 6 blocks, 4 Steam, 3 s. Shift+R CRYSTAL BLADE: a hardened forearm blade slashes the front (12, 2 Steam, 1.5 s). G STEAM BURST: a scalding cloud knocks everything within 5 blocks away (4, 3 Steam, 6 s). Shift+G BITE SHIFT: bite your hand -- an instant shift (0.6 s) if the bar is full. X CRYSTAL WALL: a 4x4 crystal wall two blocks ahead for 25 s -- it stops mobs, players and arrows, never touches the blocks around it, and works on every server (8 Steam, 20 s). Shift+X CRYSTAL COCOON: encased for 5 s -- nothing can hurt you, you cannot move, and you heal fast (15 Steam, 45 s).
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.should: You climb onto the Titan's shoulder. Sneak to hop off.
message.projecthero.titan_shifter.nothin: No mob in reach to grab -- look at one.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.energy.b: A 100-point bar (yellow, with a percentage, on your HUD) -- it was called Titan Energy before v0.16.7. A normal shift needs all of it. It refills 1% a second outside the Titan. Leaving the Titan REFUNDS Steam by the Titan's remaining health: change back at full HP and you keep the whole bar, at half HP you keep half -- so a quick accidental shift costs almost nothing. Only a DEFEAT (0 HP) or being CUT OUT of the nape empties it. Inside the Titan, out of combat (no hit taken or dealt for 5 s), the Titan heals about 2 HP a second by burning Steam (0.1 per HP). Partial Shifting moves cost a little Steam each. Your human form heals itself with Regeneration II from its OWN small healing pool (the green bar under Steam), never from Steam: it drains while you heal and refills 1 a second otherwise. Shift+N in human form switches that healing off or on.
projecthero.guide.titan_shifter.emergenc: Below a full bar you are not stuck: with at least 30% Steam, press and HOLD H for 5 seconds (electricity crackles around you and a countdown shows above your hotbar; let go -- or open a chest or other screen -- and it is cancelled, with a message saying so). You then shift into an Emergency Titan of your type -- PALE, about 60% of its height and 40% weaker in everything (health, armour, speed and the damage of every hit). You can stay in it for at most 2 minutes: a thin pale bar above the title slowly drains, and when it empties you are forced out (H changes back earlier, as usual). Afterwards you are exhausted ("Titan Form Exhausted" shows on your HUD until you are back at 100%): Steam refills 3 times slower, there is no passive human healing until you are back at 50%, and you cannot shift again -- normally or in an emergency -- until the bar is back at 100%.
item.projecthero.one_for_all_vestige.des: A stockpile of power handed down through generations. Use it to inherit One For All.
Grants the One For All power. H transforms, R/G/X/Z/V/C are the Smashes, N leaps.

Plus Ultra (C) and the United States of Smash each cost a slice of it. Hold Left-Alt for the moves; N opens the costume locker.

hud.projecthero.all_might.title: One For All
projecthero.guide.all_might.tier: Hero Tier -- a Primary power (it replaces the one you had).
projecthero.guide.all_might.body: The strongest pure-strength hero in the pack. In his Base Form he is simply a regular player; press H and he swells to 2.7 blocks tall over a second, venting steam, into his Power Form: enormous punches that move air, shockwaves that flatten crowds, leaps that clear buildings and one ultimate Smash that levels a battlefield. His blue-and-white costume is craftable armour: leave it in the costume locker (N) and it goes on by itself every time you transform.
projecthero.guide.all_might.step.vestige: Craft a Vestige of One For All (4 Titanium-Gold Plates in the corners, 2 Enchanted Golden Apples above and below, 2 Diamond Blocks left and right, a Totem of Undying in the middle) and use it. Like every Primary power it replaces the power you had. Admins: /projecthero power grant all_might.
projecthero.guide.all_might.timer.body: One For All runs on a TIMER: 20:00 of Power Form, shown as minutes:seconds beside a draining bar in the One For All block of the Quirk HUD. Simply BEING in the Power Form drains it 1 second every second; when it reaches 0:00 you are forced back to your Base Form ("You are out of One For All") and cannot press H again until it has refilled to 0:04. Only the Base Form refills it, at half speed -- 0.5 seconds every second, so an empty timer takes 40 minutes to fill. The Smashes and the Leap cost nothing from it; only Plus Ultra (3:20 of it, paid when you press C) and the United States of Smash (6:40, paid when the punch is cast) take a one-off slice, and you cannot use them without it. Below 2:00 you vent steam and the bar turns amber; too low to transform, it blinks red. Dying refills it. The timer is the only limit: every Smash lands its full damage in the Power Form, and harder still during Plus Ultra. The timer's numbers are in config/projecthero_one_for_all.json.
projecthero.guide.all_might.forms.body: Base Form (default): a regular Minecraft player -- no abilities, no bonuses, no costume, and the only form that refills the One For All timer. Power Form (press H, again to change back): 13 melee damage and a 6-block hit range, 40 max HP (your health percentage carries over: 50% in one form is 50% in the other), 50% less damage from everything, NO fall damage, Speed III, slow self-healing (1 HP every 4 seconds), a 3-block jump and a 2.7-block body -- for as long as the timer lasts. Changing takes 1 second, during which you cannot be hurt, and steam pours off you both ways. Transforming shows "I am HERE"; changing back shows nothing. The Power Form can only wear the One For All armour: if you transform while wearing regular armour it tears off your body (each piece takes 50 durability damage, and is destroyed if that is more than it has left), unequips itself and drops on the ground; regular armour equipped afterwards is bounced back to your inventory. The Power Form's particles are gold.
projecthero.guide.all_might.costume.body: Nobody starts with it. Craft All Might's Costume (blue, white and yellow wool) and All Might's Trousers (blue and red wool). In the Power Form press N to open the costume locker -- two slots, one for the costume and one for the trousers -- and put the pieces in: from then on they are put on automatically whenever you transform and go back into the locker when you change back (closing the locker in the Power Form wears them at once). Your own head and hat layer stay visible -- the costume has no helmet. The locker keeps its contents through death.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.tran: H: switch between the Base Form and the Power Form. Persistent until you press H again.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.detr: R: a devastating close-range punch -- 18 damage, and the punch's air pressure carries 10 blocks forward (3.5 wide) so you can hit enemies without touching them, huge knockback, breaks a few weak blocks. Free, 3 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.texa: G: a wide travelling air blast -- 24 damage to everything in an 18-block-long wave that starts 4 blocks wide and widens to 10, very strong knockback. Free, 6 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.caro: V: a high-speed slide about 30 blocks along the ground, following wherever you're looking for the whole slide (not just the direction you started facing), hitting everything in your path for 20 with strong knockback and leaving a wind trail. It stops at walls. Free, 5 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.new_: Shift+R: launch 15 blocks up and forward, firing an air-pressure blast 20 blocks long, 6 wide and 8 tall (built for flyers and giants), striking whatever you fly through for 20, then crash down in a 6-block shockwave. Works from the air too. Free, 8 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.unit: Z: the ultimate. HOLD Z for 5 seconds (a growing aura and building wind, with a thin charge bar under the One For All timer; let go early and it is simply cancelled -- nothing is spent and no cooldown starts), then a gigantic punch that is an AoE: a 75-damage air blast tears 25 blocks straight ahead, then a shockwave bursts out from you in every direction to 35 blocks, with extreme knockback and a large crater. Bosses only take a fraction of their health per hit. Once it is cast it takes 6:40 off the One For All timer (you cannot start the hold with less) and starts a 75 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.all_: X: a huge leap launched in the direction you are looking (always with some lift), and a landing shockwave. Cannot hurt you. 1.5 s cooldown -- no cooldown at all while Plus Ultra is active.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.plus: C: Plus Ultra. Costs 3:20 of the One For All timer once (refused without it), then for exactly 22 seconds every Smash hits 30% harder and the Leap has no cooldown (the seconds left show in the C box). It cannot be switched off early; when it ends (or when you change back to your Base Form) a 20 s cooldown starts.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.dela: Shift+G: a flick of the fingers, three times -- three compressed-air bullets out to 30 blocks, 10 damage each with big knockback. 7 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.manc: Shift+X: spring up, flip head over heels and axe-kick straight down -- a 6-block crater shockwave for 22. Mid-air you flip and dive at once. 8 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.okla: Shift+Z: spin in place -- a 360-degree tornado of air 7 blocks round you, 16 damage, flinging everything outward. 10 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.miss: Shift+V: a dashing chop that cuts a 12-block line of air, 20 damage; a boss it cuts is staggered (slowed almost to a stop for 2 s). 8 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.ability.st_l: Shift+C: a spinning kick that throws a horizontal crescent of air 20 blocks, widening as it goes, 18 damage to everything it passes. 9 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.all_might.pass_on.body: Sneak and right-click another player with an empty hand (either form) to open a small screen. PASS ON hands One For All to them for good: they get a chat offer with [Accept] / [Refuse] and 30 seconds to answer, and if they accept they become the holder (it replaces any Primary power they had) while you become an ordinary person -- "Eat this." LEND (5 min) gives them a borrowed One For All instead: they cannot pass it on, and the loan carries whatever is left on your One For All timer (theirs drains and refills like yours); your own timer waits, untouched, until it comes back. The drawback is yours: for the whole loan you have no power at all and are exhausted (Weakness I, Slowness I). It comes back when the time runs out, if they die or either of you logs out, or when you sneak-right-click them again -- and then you must wait 60 seconds before lending again. Only someone with no power at all can borrow it.
projecthero.guide.all_might.passives.bod: Symbol of Peace: while you are in the Power Form, squadmates within 16 blocks take 15% less damage. In the Power Form you take no fall damage at all, ordinary punches knock enemies back with an air burst, and hard landings from a real fall release a shockwave: a small one (2 damage, 2 blocks), a medium one (8, 4 blocks) or a heavy one (20, 7 blocks). Bosses are never knocked back and lose at most 10% of their health to a single Smash. Block destruction (weak blocks only, never bedrock) can be switched off in AllMightConfig. The Base Form has none of this.
projecthero.guide.all_might.commands.bod: /projecthero power grant all_might [player]  (op level 2). Every number above lives in AllMightConfig.
message.projecthero.agent_venom.sonic: The Symbiote is reeling from the noise -- it will not answer.
message.projecthero.agent_venom.no_ancho: Nothing in reach for the tendril to grab.
message.projecthero.agent_venom.disarmed: The tendril tears the %s out of its hand.
message.projecthero.symbiote.talk.agent_: A soldier. Good. We can work with a soldier.
Keep the guns. We will be the armour.
Discipline... how strange. We like it.
No more orders. LET US OUT.
hud.projecthero.agent_venom.title: Agent Venom
projecthero.agent_venom.ability.suit.des: A bonded Punisher presses H and the Symbiote wraps him in the Agent Venom suit (H again retracts it). 22 armour and 2.5 toughness, +25% melee, +15% speed and jump, +15% knockback resistance, and the whole Punisher kit still works.
projecthero.agent_venom.ability.agent_ve: Sneak + X: a tendril snaps onto the block you are aiming at (up to 36 blocks) and hauls you to it. No fall damage for 3 seconds after. 3 s cooldown.

Sneak + Z: lash the mob you are aiming at (18 blocks) for 5 damage, drag it to you bound in tendrils (Slowness III), and rip whatever it is holding out of its hand. Bosses are held but not dragged or disarmed. 8 s cooldown.
Sneak + V: let the Symbiote off the leash for 10 seconds -- +50% melee, +20% speed, and every punch heals you for 20% of the damage it deals. 45 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.agent_venom.body: The Symbiote no longer purges the Punisher. Bond with one as the Punisher (or become the Punisher while bonded) and you are Agent Venom: press H to let the suit take hold, H again to retract it. You keep the Punisher kit; the suit adds three Symbiote extras on Sneak + X, Z and V (while suited they replace Tactical Advance and Warzone), shown in their own three boxes above the Punisher HUD.
projecthero.guide.agent_venom.passives.b: Symbiote Rounds: +20% firearm damage, and every bullet that lands lashes the target with tendrils (a moment of Slowness). Living Ammunition: the suit feeds your guns -- the reserve regenerates three times as fast and reloads are 25% quicker. The Symbiote is still a Symbiote: fire, lava and loud sounds (explosions, bells, the Warden) drive it off, it wraps you on its own when you are badly hurt, and it drags you back from death once every 20 minutes. The HUD shows your three extras above the Punisher row, with the revive timer beside them.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.host.agent_ve: A player who holds the Punisher becomes Agent Venom -- the Agent Venom suit on top of the whole Punisher kit, with three sneak-modified Symbiote extras (see the Punisher chapter).
projecthero.guide.symbiote.creatures.wil: A Symbiote that takes over an animal -- a cow, pig, sheep, chicken, rabbit, fox, ocelot, wild wolf or stray cat -- turns it black with white eyes, makes it tougher, faster and harder-hitting, and sends it hunting players (even a cow bites, for 2.5 hearts). A sheep's wool turns black. Kill it and the Symbiote crawls back out.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.creatures.for: Out of a fight it looks like its normal self -- a few black blotches and the odd black drip give it away. The moment it fights (it picks a target, it is hurt, or you are fighting or badly hurt nearby) it transforms: the black skin spreads over it pixel by pixel, it grows 30%, white eyes open, and it gains +20 max health, +4 attack damage, +8 armour, 25% speed, knockback resistance and regeneration (three quarters of a heart a second). About 9 seconds after the fight ends the skin recedes and it shrinks back (it still heals slowly, a quarter heart a second).
projecthero.guide.symbiote.creatures.pow: Transformed, it has powers of its own: Latching Bite (a lunging bite whose tendrils pin the target -- slowed and weakened -- while the Symbiote feeds and heals it), Tendril Lash (a tendril yanks a target 4-14 blocks away in), Pounce (a leap onto a target up to 9 blocks away), Spike Burst (spikes erupt all round it when it is crowded or badly hurt) and Guardian Shroud (when you drop under 40% health it throws a tendril to you and wraps you in the Symbiote -- Absorption II and Resistance -- hurling attackers back; every 45 seconds). Even a cat fights now.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.creatures.pet: Your own tamed wolf or cat can become a Symbiote's host and stay loyal. A free Symbiote goes looking for tamed pets before anything else, and springs onto one it reaches; you can also share yours (sneak and right-click your pet with an empty hand while your suit is on -- a Normal host pays 40 Biomass; Black Suit Spider-Man and Agent Venom pay nothing), or tame an infested wolf or stray cat. You are told when it happens. A Symbiote Pet still sits, stands, follows you and teleports to you, attacks what you attack and defends you, and never targets or hurts you, your squadmates or their pets.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.creatures.rel: To take it back, repeat the sneak + empty-hand right-click while suited. A bell, a goat horn or a sonic boom shakes the Symbiote out of a pet, and fire burns a Symbiote Pet 50% harder. A pet's Symbiote that came from the wild crawls free when it leaves (or the pet dies); one you shared simply dissolves.
message.projecthero.hulk.acquired: Gamma radiation floods your blood. Something huge and angry is waiting inside you.
message.projecthero.hulk.acquired_hint: Hold H to let the Hulk out -- and if you die, he comes out on his own, every time. As the Hulk: R Super Punch (Shift: Ground Smash), G Thunderclap (Shift: Fault-line Stomp), Z Bulldozer Charge (Shift: Launch Uppercut), X Super Leap (hold to charge), C Gamma Burst (Shift: Earth Wall), V Grab / Throw (Shift: Loki Slam or Debris), N Roar. Every minute he tries to take over: match the arrows to stop him.
message.projecthero.hulk.not_angry: Not angry enough (%s / %s rage). Hold H to force it.
message.projecthero.hulk.transform_force: YOU WOULDN'T LIKE HIM WHEN HE'S ANGRY -- HULK SMASH!
message.projecthero.hulk.reverted: You change back, drained. Weakness and Slowness for a while.
message.projecthero.hulk.revert_unwillin: The Hulk won't let go -- his rage must be under %s (now %s). Try Calm Down (N).
message.projecthero.hulk.revert_rampage: You can't change back while he's rampaging!
message.projecthero.hulk.tamed: The Hulk settles down. He's yours now -- tap H to change back.
message.projecthero.hulk.strain_start: You fight to let it out... keep holding H.
message.projecthero.hulk.strain_hungry: You need a full hunger bar to force the change.
message.projecthero.hulk.strain_done: You FORCE the Hulk out! It leaves you starving.
message.projecthero.hulk.fists_only: Hulk does not need tools. HULK SMASH WITH FISTS.
projecthero.guide.hulk.tier: Hero Tier -- a Primary power. Gaining it replaces the one you had.
projecthero.guide.hulk.body: The Gamma power turns you into the Hulk when you get angry enough: a huge green brute who fights with his fists, shrugs off hits and flattens everything around him.
projecthero.guide.hulk.rage.body: Your Rage bar (0-100) sits in the bottom-right HUD. Every point of damage you take is 1% rage. As Banner, the damage you deal builds nothing. Go 5 seconds without being hurt and Banner cools off at 2% a second. The white mark on the bar is 50: from there H lets the Hulk out. Past 75 Banner gives off green gamma and the bar throbs -- a warning that 100 is close. After an exhausting change back the bar reads "Exhausted 8s" and runs down with the timer.
projecthero.guide.hulk.change.body:
By choice: at 50 Rage press H for a quick change (a second and a half). Below 50, hold H for 2.5 seconds to force it -- it needs a full hunger bar, empties it completely, and the Hulk comes out on only 20 health. Let go early and nothing happens. Against your will: at 100 Rage (or when the Hulk refuses to die) Banner doubles over, clutching his head, and the change takes him slowly, about five seconds. You can't move, fight or be hurt while it happens, and an unwilling Hulk fights you for control (see Keeping control).

As the Hulk, every point of damage you take adds 1% and every hit you land adds 2%. After 5 seconds out of combat his rage burns down at 0.75% a second -- but never below 15. Running low no longer changes you back.

Changing back is up to you: tap H and you shrink back to Banner (an unwilling Hulk only once his rage is under 50). Hold N to calm down works too. Changing back is only exhausting after 10 minutes as the Hulk in one go, or from 80+ rage: Weakness and Slowness for 8 seconds, and no Rage builds until it passes. Calming down never exhausts you.
projecthero.guide.hulk.stats.body:
1.8x size (grown over a second and a half), +120% speed, punches land 20 with extra knockback, +40 max health (your health percentage carries over, plus a 20 HP burst when he comes out), diamond-level armour of his own (20 armour, 8 toughness), 90% knockback resistance, regeneration (0.75 HP every quarter second), a longer reach and a 4-block step. Fire, arrows and falls don't hurt him; lava does a quarter and explosions half. His hands dig like stone tools.

Rage makes him stronger. The HUD shows his tier beside the rage. Calm (under 40): the stats above. Angry (40-79): +15% melee damage and +20% speed. Enraged (80+): +35% melee damage, +40% speed, and green gamma pours off him.
projecthero.guide.hulk.fists.body: The Hulk cannot use tools, weapons, bows, crossbows, tridents or guns -- he fights with his fists, and his bare hands mine like stone tools (so iron ore still drops). Any armour you are wearing when he comes out bursts off (50 durability lost, dropped on the ground), and armour won't stay on him while he is out.
projecthero.guide.hulk.gladiator_moves.b: With the full gladiator gear on, the Hulk fights with his axe (left hand) and hammer (right hand): R, G, Z, X, C and V become the twelve moves below -- tap the key, or hold Shift for the second move. Rage, control, the death save, Calm Down, riding and his passives stay the same; take a piece of the gear off and the bare-handed kit is back. Hold Shift (or Alt) to see the names above the HUD boxes; the strip under each box is the other move on that key. A thrown weapon leaves that hand empty -- moves that swing it wait until it is back. Plain left-click hits alternate hands, hammer then axe then hammer, and in first person you see both fists with the hammer in the right and the axe in the left.
projecthero.guide.hulk.controls.body: H: let the Hulk out (hold it below 50 rage). As the Hulk, H changes back.
projecthero.guide.hulk.commands.body: /projecthero power grant hulk [player] (op). Testing helpers, op level 2: /hulk grant|revoke [players], /hulk setrage <0-100> [players]. Numbers for the abilities and the block-breaking rules are in config/projecthero_hulk.json.
item.projecthero.gamma_serum.desc1: Drink it, then right-click a Gamma Reactor. Its flash pours gamma into you before it explodes -- and something inside you wakes up.
item.projecthero.gamma_serum.desc2: Recovered from the wreck of a Gamma Lab.
item.projecthero.gladiator_gear.tooltip: Hulk gear from the arenas of Sakaar. Tap N as Banner to put it in your Gladiator Gear.
item.projecthero.gladiator_gear.tooltip2: All seven pieces: the Hulk comes out as Gladiator Hulk and takes 10% less damage.
message.projecthero.gamma_serum.already: Gamma radiation already runs in your blood.
message.projecthero.hulk.banner_cannot: Banner can't do that. Get angry first (H at 50 rage).
message.projecthero.hulk.cannot_now: The Hulk can't come out right now.
projecthero.hulk.ability.transform: Let the Hulk out / change back
projecthero.hulk.ability.transform.desc: At 50+ rage: the quick, willing change. Below 50, hold H for 2.5 s to force it -- it needs a full hunger bar, empties it completely, and the Hulk comes out on only 20 health. At 100 he comes out on his own: the slow, unwilling change. As the Hulk, tap H to change back.
projecthero.hulk.ability.thunderclap.des: G: a clap that sends a sonic shockwave rolling forward in a 12-block cone -- up to 9 damage, a big shove and a stagger (slowed and reeling for 2 s), and glass, ice, leaves and plants in its path shatter. 8 s cooldown. In the air it goes off at once: the clap stops you dead and throws you the way you are looking (up, down, anywhere) -- change course mid-leap -- with a slightly smaller cone in front.
projecthero.hulk.ability.ground_smash.de: Shift+R: both fists into the ground -- 22.5 damage to everything within 7 blocks, thrown away and up, a crater in front of him and the ground cracked open for 9 blocks around. 5 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.super_leap.desc: X: hold to charge (up to two seconds -- the leap bar above your ability keys shows how far), release to jump along your look: a tap goes 25 blocks, half charge 100, full charge 500. He keeps his speed all the way -- no slowing in the air -- until he lands. Take-off and landing crack the ground; the landing shockwave grows with the jump (6-30 damage, 4-12 blocks). No fall damage. 2 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.hulk.origin.body: Find a Gamma Lab -- a rare ruin in the overworld where a gamma experiment went wrong -- and drink the Gamma Serum from its chest (every Gamma Lab has one). The serum alone is not enough: with it in your blood, right-click the lab's glowing Gamma Reactor. It floods everything near it with a blinding green flash for ten seconds. You brace where you stand and the radiation pours into your body. Then the reactor explodes -- a blast many times bigger than TNT that leaves a crater -- and you wake up inside your own mind: a dark room with a mirror, and the Hulk staring back at you, copying every move you make. Your body stays standing where you were, hunched and clutching its head, so others can still see you. Walk up to the mirror and right-click it. The Hulk smashes through and grabs you, and you are back in the world, slowly changing into the Hulk. Like every hero power it replaces the power you had (Thor included). If you die or log out during the flash, the reactor still explodes but the serum stays in your blood. A Gamma Reactor also feeds a Gamma player's rage (3 a second) while he stands within 4 blocks of it.
projecthero.guide.hulk.abilities.body: Only the Hulk in control can use them -- not Banner, not during a rampage.
projecthero.guide.hulk.looks.body: While he is out you are drawn as the Hulk model, 1.8 times your size, with his own idle, walk, run, clap, smash, leap and transformation animations. The change is seamless: the Hulk phases onto you as you grow and back off you as you shrink. The unwilling change has its own animation -- doubled over, clutching your head and shaking, then up into a roar. Your armour, cape and held items are hidden, and your first-person arm is green. Changing roars and shakes the ground.
projecthero.guide.hulk.limits.body: The Hulk cannot lift Mjolnir. He can't come out inside a Titan or while One For All's Power Form is on (and neither can be used while he is out). Respawning starts a calm Banner; logging out ends the Hulk but keeps your rage.
projecthero.guide.structure.gamma_lab.de: A rare overworld ruin of blown-out concrete and green glass with a still-glowing Gamma Reactor at its centre. Its chest always holds a Gamma Serum. Drink it, then right-click the reactor -- the only way to get the Hulk's power.

message.projecthero.hulk.acquired_hint_v: Hold H to let the Hulk out. Dying also brings him out, every time. As the Hulk: tap H to change back (not in the first 3 minutes), N to roar -- and at 100% rage, H unleashes World Breaker.

projecthero.hulk.ability.transform_v0164: Let the Hulk out / change back
Hold H for 2 seconds to let the Hulk out. As the Hulk, tap H to change back -- not in the first 3 minutes. If you let him out yourself, holding H is locked for a minute after you change back.
projecthero.hulk.ability.roar.desc: N as the Hulk: a huge roar and a shockwave of dust. Weak mobs (20 hearts or less, never bosses or players) within 20 blocks drop what they were doing and run for 6 seconds. 15 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.hulk.origin_v0164.body: Find a Gamma Lab -- a rare ruin in the overworld where a gamma experiment went wrong -- and drink the Gamma Serum from its chest. With it in your blood, right-click the lab's glowing Gamma Reactor. It floods everything near it with a green flash for ten seconds while the radiation pours into you. Then it explodes and you wake up inside your own mind: a dark room with a mirror, and the Hulk in it, staring straight at you. Your body stays where you were, hunched and clutching its head. Press H. The Hulk smashes through the mirror and grabs you, and you are back in the world, slowly changing into the Hulk. Like every hero power it replaces the power you had. If you die or log out during the flash, the reactor still explodes but the serum stays in your blood.
projecthero.guide.hulk.rage_v0164.body: Only the Hulk has rage -- Banner has none, and no bar. As the Hulk the bar sits in the bottom-right HUD. Every point of damage he takes adds 1% and every hit he lands adds 2%. After 5 seconds out of combat it burns down slowly, all the way to 0 -- running out never changes him back. Rage sets his size and his strength: at 0 he is 3.5 blocks tall and hits normally; at 100 he is 6 blocks tall and every hit does 50% more. In between, both grow smoothly. Angry (40+) and Enraged (80+) also make him faster.
projecthero.guide.hulk.change_v0164.body:
Only two things bring the Hulk out. Hold H for 2 seconds -- by choice. Or die as Banner -- every time, with no cooldown: the death is cancelled and the Hulk comes out at full health, straight into a rampage. Nothing else changes you, except the Hulk himself winning the fight to get out (see The rampage). Every change plays one of six transformations at random. You can't move, fight or be hurt while it happens.

Once he is out, he stays as long as you like. For the first 3 minutes the Hulk won't let you go. After that, tap H. If you let him out yourself (hold H), for a minute after you change back he won't answer your call -- but dying in that minute still brings him out.
projecthero.guide.hulk.stats_v0164.body: 3.5 to 6 blocks tall (with his rage), +120% speed (+20% more when Angry, +40% when Enraged), punches land 15 at no rage and 25 at full rage (every move gains the same +67%) with extra knockback, 2 bars of health (40) at no rage up to 3 bars (60) at full rage (your health percentage carries over, plus a 20 HP burst when he comes out), diamond-level armour of his own (20 armour, 8 toughness), 90% knockback resistance and regeneration. His reach grows with him, and he steps straight up 4 blocks. Fire, arrows and falls don't hurt him; lava does a quarter and explosions half. His hands dig like stone tools. He doesn't fit through doors -- he goes round, or through the wall.
Banner cannot be killed: a hit that would kill him brings the Hulk out instead, every time. The Hulk can be beaten, though. When he takes a killing blow he falls flat on his back, slowly changes back into you, and two seconds later you die for real -- you drop your things and see the death screen. /kill and the void still kill at once, and so does dying inside a Titan or in One For All's Power Form.
projecthero.guide.hulk.rampage_v0164.bod:
Every minute as the Hulk -- however he came out -- he tries to take over. A warning shows a string of 6 to 8 arrows: type them in order with the arrow keys within 6 seconds. A wrong arrow starts it over. Make it and the next minute starts. Miss it and he RAMPAGES.

During a rampage the Hulk has the body. Your view pulls out to third person and shrinks into a black frame, as if you were watching him. He hunts every living thing within 100 blocks -- squad-mates and other players too -- always the nearest. He turns to face it, closes in with a run, a Super Leap or the Bulldozer Charge, pounds it with aimed punches and throws his whole kit at it: Super Punch, Ground Smash, Thunderclap, Fault-line Stomp, Launch Uppercut, and grabbing it to throw. He only smashes blocks when he is stuck. Anyone riding him is thrown off. A rampaging Hulk no longer knows friend from foe: squad protection between him and his squad is off both ways until it ends.

To win control back, play the game in the black strip at the bottom: a ring closes in on a circle, over and over. Press Space as the ring meets the circle. Five in a row ends the rampage; a miss starts the count again.

Dying as Banner brings the Hulk out straight into a rampage -- but not the ring. You wake up back in the dark of your own mind, at the end of a long hall. Far away, a giant screen shows the Hulk tearing through the world. Walk (sprint) the 100 blocks to it, look at it and right-click it to take the body back. Nothing else you press does anything in there. If you never reach it, he lets go on his own after 4 minutes.

Lose three warnings in a row (passing one resets the count) and THE HULK TAKES OVER completely, for 5 minutes, with no ring and no way out. He smashes everything near, then leaps off to find a mountain, tears a cave into its side and sits in the dark. At the end he runs off, and you wake up as Banner wherever he ended up.

Stay Banner for 10 minutes and the Hulk fights to get out: the same arrow warning. Win and he tries again 2 minutes later, then every 2 minutes. Lose and he forces the change and rampages for 3 minutes with no ring, then hands the Hulk back to you. Changing resets that clock, and it stops while you are dead or offline. These fights don't count toward the takeover.
projecthero.guide.hulk.looks_v0164.body: While he is out you are drawn as the Hulk model, exactly as tall as he is (3.5 to 6 blocks with his rage), with his own animations. The change is seamless: the Hulk phases onto you as you grow and back off you as you shrink. Your armour, cape and held items are hidden, and your first-person arm is green.
projecthero.guide.hulk.limits_v0164.body: The Hulk cannot lift Mjolnir. He can't come out inside a Titan or while One For All's Power Form is on. Respawning starts Banner fresh; logging out ends the Hulk.
projecthero.guide.hulk.gladiator_moves_v: With the full gladiator gear on, the Hulk fights with his axe (left hand) and hammer (right hand): R, G, Z, X, C and V become the twelve moves below -- tap the key, or hold Shift for the second move. The change, rage, the rampage, dying, riding and his passives work just the same. Take a piece of the gear off and the bare-handed kit is back. Hold Shift (or Alt) to see the names above the HUD boxes; the strip under each box is the other move on that key. A thrown weapon leaves that hand empty -- moves that swing it wait until it is back.
message.projecthero.hulk.changing: Not yet -- the change is not over.
screen.projecthero.hulk_calm.hint: Keep your ring on the guide ring. Esc to stop.
projecthero.hulk.ability.power_punch.des: A huge wound-up punch that hits everything in a 3-block-wide lane 6 blocks long for 30 damage and hurls it away. 5 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.hulk_smash.desc: Hold Shift+Z for 5 seconds while the gamma boils off him (let go early and it fizzles, no cooldown). Then he roars and brings everything down: 100 damage to everything 25 blocks ahead and in a 30-block shockwave all round, and a great crater. 60 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.charge.desc: He puts his head down and runs for 8 seconds straight -- steer by looking. Everything he runs through takes 20 and is knocked aside, and soft blocks in his way are smashed. 12 s cooldown once the run ends.
projecthero.hulk.ability.grab.desc: V picks up the mob you are looking at (6 blocks) and holds it overhead. Then HOLD V to wind up the throw -- a bar over your ability boxes fills in under 2 seconds -- and let go to throw it along your look: a tap tosses it 20 blocks, a full charge sends it 300. It flies the whole way and smashes into whatever it hits (18 to it and everything round it). Thrown 100 blocks or more, it lands like a meteor: a crater, cracked ground and a shockwave -- the further past 100, the bigger (up to a 7-block crater and +50% damage at 300). Squad-mates can be picked up too: carried safely overhead, set down with Shift+V (or they sneak to get down), or thrown -- they land without fall damage. Bosses and anything too big can't be picked up. 8 s cooldown from the throw.
projecthero.hulk.ability.earth_chunk.des: Shift+V with empty hands tears a chunk of earth out of the ground in front of him; V throws it and it explodes where it lands (30 damage in 4 blocks, a small crater).
projecthero.hulk.ability.calm.desc: Hold N for 2 seconds after 3 seconds out of combat: a breathing exercise opens. Hold Space as the guide ring swells and let go as it shrinks. In rhythm, the rage drains fast; out of rhythm, he gets angrier. Getting hurt breaks it. Calming the Hulk to 0 changes him back with no exhaustion.
projecthero.hulk.gladiator.ability.axe_c: A wide sweep of the axe in front of him: 25.5 to everything in a 160-degree arc out to 5.5 blocks, heavy knockback, and the cut bleeds (1.5 a second for 4 seconds). 5 s.
projecthero.hulk.gladiator.ability.hamme: Shift+R: the hammer swung up from the ground into the one enemy in front of him (5 blocks): 27 damage and launched high into the air. 6 s.

Both hands on the hammer, overhead, into the ground: a fissure tears forward 14 blocks in a 60-degree cone, 27 damage, everything thrown back and up. It cracks soft ground (dirt, sand, gravel) along the way. 7 s.
projecthero.hulk.gladiator.ability.earth: Shift+G: the axe driven blade-first into the ground. The earth erupts in a straight line 18 blocks ahead, 3 wide: 22.5 damage and everything on the line launched into the air. 9 s.
projecthero.hulk.gladiator.ability.champ: Weapons raised, a roar for the crowd: +4.5 attack and full knockback resistance for 8 seconds, +15 rage, and everything within 12 blocks is staggered (weakened, slowed); mobs with 20 hearts or less turn and run from him for 6 seconds. 20 s.
projecthero.hulk.gladiator.ability.weapo: Shift+Z: axe and hammer smashed together. The ringing shockwave hits everything within 7 blocks for 13.5 and stuns it for 1.5 seconds. 12 s.
projecthero.hulk.gladiator.ability.arena: A huge leap (about 28 blocks along your look) that lands weapons-first: 24 damage within 6 blocks and a crater. From the ground. 8 s.
projecthero.hulk.gladiator.ability.meteo: Shift+X: straight up, then a burning dive at wherever you are looking -- steer it on the way down. Smaller blast, much harder: 41 damage within 3.5 blocks and a crater. 15 s.
projecthero.hulk.gladiator.ability.axe_t: The axe spins out 24 blocks along your look, cutting through everything in its way (19.5 each), and flies back to your hand, cutting again. Your left hand is empty until it is back. 5 s.
projecthero.hulk.gladiator.ability.hamme: Shift+C: the hammer thrown in an arc. It lands with a shockwave (22.5 within 4.5 blocks) and stays stuck in the ground. Press C to call it back -- it flies home and hits everything on the way (15). It comes back by itself after 30 seconds. 8 s.
projecthero.hulk.gladiator.ability.whirl: Three seconds spinning with both weapons out -- you can still move. 6 damage to everything close every quarter second, enemies within 7 blocks are dragged into the blades, and it ends with a hammer slam (19.5 within 5 blocks). 12 s after.
projecthero.hulk.gladiator.ability.arena: Shift+V: grabs the enemy in front of him, pins it to the ground and pounds it with the hammer -- five blows of 6.75. Shift+V again throws it (10.5 more). No bosses or anything too big. 10 s after.
message.projecthero.hulk.gladiator.hamme: Your hammer is out -- C calls it back.
projecthero.guide.hulk.death_save.body: Banner cannot be killed: every hit that would kill a Gamma player as Banner brings the Hulk bursting out instead, at full health with a full rage bar -- no cooldown, every time. It counts as the unwilling change, so you will have to keep him under control. To kill a Gamma player you have to beat the Hulk: a Hulk who takes a killing blow dies. The small dot beside the rage bar is bright while you are protected (Banner) and dark as the Hulk. /kill and the void still kill, and so does dying inside a Titan or in One For All's Power Form (the Hulk can't come out there).
projecthero.guide.hulk.sprint_smash.body: Sprinting as the Hulk into soft blocks (dirt, wood, stone, ores -- anything up to hardness 3, and cobwebs) smashes straight through them. Webs never slow the Hulk down, and sprinting tears them apart. Never chests or other block entities. The server can turn it off in config/projecthero_hulk.json.
projecthero.guide.hulk.control.body: Only a Hulk who came out on his own (Rage hit 100, or he refused to die) fights you for control -- one you let out with H never does. You can't change him back with H until his rage is under 50; once it is, he is tamed and yours like any other Hulk. Calm Down (hold N) still works. You control him as long as he keeps hitting things. Go 8 seconds without landing a hit and control starts to slip: a key prompt appears (forward, left, back or right) -- press it in time to claw control back; the wrong key or none loses more. At 0 control the Hulk RAMPAGES on his own for 15 seconds: he hunts down the nearest living thing out in the open up to 100 blocks away (never anything down in caves), leaps to it, pounds it, and smashes the ground and anything soft in his way, and your abilities and H are locked out. A rampaging Hulk no longer knows friend from foe: squad protection between him and his squad-mates is off both ways until the rampage ends. His blows hurt them like anyone else's, and they can fight back with weapons and powers, every ability that normally spares a squad-mate included (PvP permitting). The rest of the squad still can't hurt each other. Then you wrestle back control. Anyone riding him is thrown off.
projecthero.guide.hulk.riding.body: A squad-mate can right-click the Hulk to climb onto his back -- one at a time. The rider holds on piggyback-style round his shoulders, faces the way he does and turns with him (and can still look around), and never takes fall damage while on him (or for 8 s after hopping off). His HUD shows who is riding him. Sneak to hop off. The rider is thrown off when he changes back or starts to rampage. The Hulk can also pick a squad-mate up with V (see Grab).
projecthero.guide.hulk.gladiator.body: Dress the Hulk for the arenas of Sakaar. Craft the seven pieces of gladiator gear on a crafting table: the Gladiator Helmet, Pauldron, Chest Harness, Bracers and War Kilt (iron, gold, leather and red wool), and the end-game Gladiator Hammer and Gladiator Axe (netherite and blocks of iron). As Banner, tap N to open the Gladiator Gear screen and put each piece in its own slot (each slot takes only its piece; the screen shows how many of the 7 you have on). With all seven in, the Hulk comes out as Gladiator Hulk: a Sakaaran helmet with a red crest, war paint, a big pauldron on his left shoulder, a chest harness, bracers and a war kilt, the hammer in his right hand and the axe in his left. Gladiator Hulk takes 10% less damage, on top of everything the Hulk already shrugs off. The gear is locked on while you are the Hulk -- change back to Banner to take any of it off -- and it stays with you when you die.
