sentinel.projecthero.master_mold.say.int: I AM MASTER MOLD. THE SENTINEL PROGRAM IS ETERNAL.
sentinel.projecthero.master_mold.say.pha: THREAT LEVEL REVISED. ALL UNITS: PURGE.
projecthero.guide.sentinel_purge.body: Bolivar Trask's Sentinel Program hunts the world's superhumans. Giant magenta-and-blue robots come down out of the sky in waves, then the Sentinel factory itself, Master Mold.
projecthero.guide.sentinel_purge.trigger: On Overworld nights, from day 3, the Sentinels may detect a player with powers. Mutants (the mutation powers) are found twice as often as other superhumans; ordinary players never are. Using a Trask Signal starts a purge on purpose. Everyone within 48 blocks is drawn in, and anyone who walks in later joins.
projecthero.guide.sentinel_purge.waves.b: Ten seconds after detection the first wave lands: four waves in all, half again bigger for each extra fighter. Wave 1 is all Drones; Sentinels join from wave 2. Every robot goes for mutants first, then other superhumans, then everyone else. A fighter who dies is down until they come back; if every fighter is down at once, the purge has won.
projecthero.guide.sentinel_purge.drone.b: A small flying scout: 16 health. It circles above its prey and aims a thin red laser every two seconds -- the line locks just before it fires, so keep moving. Cover blocks it.
projecthero.guide.sentinel_purge.sentine: Three and a half blocks of armour: 90 health, 10 armour. It lands on boot thrusters, fires magenta chest beams and palm blasts (an aiming line trails you, then flashes as it locks: sidestep then and the beam misses), and grabs anything in reach to lift it overhead and slam it down. It flies after prey that takes to the air. Some carry Drones on their backs and release them in pairs.
projecthero.guide.sentinel_purge.master_: The eleven-block Sentinel factory: 1,400 health, plus 400 per extra fighter. It stomps out shockwaves, sweeps its arm across everything in front, charges a long Purge Beam that slowly tracks you (outrun it sideways or break line of sight!), and fabricates new Sentinels from its chest hatch. At two thirds and one third health it roars, looses a swarm of Drones and fights faster.
projecthero.guide.sentinel_purge.rewards: Every fighter still standing gets a Master Mold Core, 2-5 Sentinel Circuitry, a pile of salvage (iron, redstone, gold, diamonds, emeralds, a book), 600 experience and a small chance of a Mutagenic Serum. Sentinels also drop circuitry. Eight Sentinel Circuitry around a redstone block craft a new Trask Signal.
projecthero.guide.sentinel_purge.command: /projecthero raid start sentinel_purge starts one where you stand; end stops every purge; advancetimer skips to the next stage. Tuning lives in config/projecthero_sentinel.json.

projecthero.guide.iron_man.sentry.body: On the Hulkbuster I, HOLD C for 1 second for Sentry Mode (a tap is the Hydraulic Brace). Do it in the full suit and the back of the armour opens; you walk out of it and it stands there with its own integrity. Right-click it to open or close the back; Sneak + right-click the open suit to step back in (you can't be hurt meanwhile). Sneak + right-click the closed suit to cycle its mode: Regular, Defensive (fights for you with repulsor blasts and punches) and Follow. Modes and shots cost nothing -- a sentry runs until its integrity is gone (hits take it 1:1; it never repairs itself), then powers down where it stands. If a mob or player hurts you within 64 blocks it switches to Defensive by itself. Called with the Stark Glasses, the whole Hulkbuster drops in from orbit and lands 2 blocks in front of you in Regular mode. Hold Shift+C on the worn suit to fold it into its drop crate.

boss.projecthero.ultron.name: Ultron
boss.projecthero.ultron.say.intro: You built a guardian and gave it no one to guard. I chose.
boss.projecthero.ultron.say.swarm: I am never just one of me.
boss.projecthero.ultron.say.pull: All that metal. You came dressed as my parts.
boss.projecthero.ultron.say.jump: A body is a coat. I have spares.
boss.projecthero.ultron.say.fall: This frame was never the point...
boss.projecthero.ultron.say.sentry_intro: You wanted to see the real thing. Here I stand.
boss.projecthero.ultron.say.cannon: Hold still. This is the merciful part.
boss.projecthero.ultron.say.shield: Let my children hold the line.
boss.projecthero.ultron.say.sentry_enrag: I will rewrite you out of the world!
boss.projecthero.ultron.contagion.say.re: Did you really think deleting a body would delete me?

boss.projecthero.ultron.contagion.say.so: You found me. Good. You can watch.

boss.projecthero.ultron.contagion.say.so: Gravity agrees with me. Try again. I'll be here.
boss.projecthero.ultron_omega.say.intro: No more borrowed bodies. This one I built for you.
boss.projecthero.ultron_omega.say.intro_: Version %s. I learned from every one of you.
boss.projecthero.ultron_omega.say.lattic: Find the gap. There usually isn't one.
boss.projecthero.ultron_omega.say.siphon: Excuse me. I need to top up the sky.
boss.projecthero.ultron_omega.say.split: Which one of me do you trust?

projecthero.guide.ultron.body: Stark tech turned on its makers. Ultron is a network, not one body: cut the network first, then finish him. Nothing he has adapts: your attacks always do what they say.
projecthero.guide.ultron.trigger.body: Craft an Ultron Beacon: a Master Mold Core (from the Sentinel Purge) in the centre, an Arc Reactor above, a redstone block below, netherite scrap in the corners and iron blocks at the sides. Place it and right-click it in Survival (never on Peaceful). It becomes the uplink: it glows red and can't be mined until the fight ends. Servers can also turn on a natural trigger: a Tony Stark with three marks built may get a JARVIS warning and a beacon.
projecthero.guide.ultron.arena.body: Everything happens within 40 blocks of the uplink, its edge a red and cyan ring. Everyone inside is a fighter and can't leave; anyone who walks in joins. A fighter who dies is down until they come back; if every fighter is down at once, Ultron wins and the uplink burns out.
projecthero.guide.ultron.pylons.body: Four pylons rise 24 blocks out (450 health, +150 per extra fighter). While any stands, Ultron's units within 16 blocks repair 3 health a second, and Ultron himself won't come. A pylon with three or more of his units within 8 blocks is shielded (a red shell): clear the guards first. A destroyed pylon bursts in an EMP that stuns nearby robots for 3 s. Iron Man's targeting locks onto them.
projecthero.guide.ultron.waves.body: Seven waves, half again bigger per extra fighter, at most 36 units at once. Drones (40 health) hover and fire red bolts. Sentinel Drones (60) sprint in to claw and explode when destroyed -- step away at the beeps. The Heavy (180 health, 10 armour, from wave 3) fires four red missiles after raising its arms, and stamps up close. Sniper Frames (from wave 4) perch on the pylons and paint you with a laser for 1.5 s before a 16-damage shot, then jump to another pylon -- break line of sight. Lancers join at wave 4, Hijackers at wave 5.
projecthero.guide.ultron.prime.body: Once every relay is down Ultron Prime flies in (1,600 health, +450 per extra fighter, up to 5,000; 12 armour) and rebuilds two reserve pylons (300 health) -- spare bodies, shielded while he is above half health. Repulsor barrage: five quick beams. Encephalo-beam: a red line shows where it starts, then it sweeps -- below a third it sweeps there and back. Drone swarm. Network Override: a red reticle appears over whoever is hurting him most, and a second later their ability keys go dead for 4 s -- break line of sight before it lands. Below two-thirds he Overclocks (6 s, half again as fast, an 8-beam barrage) and magnetically pulls anyone in iron, chainmail, netherite or Iron Man armour in for a punch; below one-third he dive-bombs. Destroy him while a pylon stands and he uploads to it: the pylon is consumed and he rebuilds there at half health. He turns on whoever is hurting him most: every hit builds threat that fades over about 10 seconds.
projecthero.guide.ultron.sentry.body: With no body left to jump to, the giant Sentry rises from the uplink (6 blocks tall, 2,600 health, +600 per extra fighter, up to 7,000). Arm slam up close; a chest cannon that charges for 2 s then fires a beam that slowly turns after you (20 degrees a second) -- keep moving sideways; missile rain; and the Fist Rocket: his forearm flies at you and bursts for 18 -- shoot it down (60 health). At half health he Reconstructs: for 6 s every drone in the arena flies into him, each one healing 2% -- kill them on the way. Then he shields himself and four drones hold the shield; kill them and he staggers, taking half again as much damage. At a quarter he does it all once more. He turns on whoever is hurting him most.
projecthero.guide.ultron.weakness.body: Every robot takes 50% more from lightning and electricity (Thor, Electrokinesis) and 25% more from Hulk or any heavy melee hit, and shrugs off poison and wither. Nothing adapts: hit them the same way all day and it does the same damage. Every Ultron hit lands 30% harder than its listed number, and wears an Iron Man suit's hull 10% harder.
projecthero.guide.ultron.rewards.body: The uplink becomes a chest: Vibranium Plating (2 + the number of fighters), the Ultron Core trophy, netherite scrap, diamonds, redstone, gold, emeralds, a book and experience bottles. Each fighter's first ever clear also hands them the Mind Stone. Vibranium Plating goes on Iron Man armour at a smithing table (no template): +2 armour, +1 toughness per piece.
projecthero.guide.ultron.commands.body: Operators: /projecthero raid start ultron (where you stand), /projecthero raid end ultron, /projecthero raid advancetimer ultron (skip to the next stage). Tuning: config/projecthero_ultron.json (v0.16.1 rewrites the old easy numbers in an existing file).
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.body: You can't kill an idea. A few days after Ultron's first defeat in a world he comes back -- not as a raid, but as an infection that spreads through the world. Never on Peaceful; only in the Overworld.
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.start: Three to six in-game days after the first Ultron Uprising clear, patient zero flickers red for 20 seconds: a placed Ultron Core trophy, else a Stark machine, else a spot near someone who fought him. Then the first Ultron Nexus grows there. JARVIS glitches; everyone else gets the title.
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.satur: A red Hairline at the top of the screen: one value for the whole world. +1% per standing Nexus every 2 minutes (only in loaded chunks), -5% when one falls, -1% per fuelled Firewall Beacon every 2 minutes. At 25% new spires come every 15 minutes instead of 25; at 50% Ultron Golems appear and Assimilated mobs get tougher; at 75% Hunter-Killer squads (3 drones + a Heavy) come for you. At 100% the Sokovia Protocol starts whether you are ready or not.
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.nexus: A 9-block spire of black metal and red veins that grows out of the ground over 2 minutes (a red beam to the clouds marks it), 64-160 blocks from a player, up to 4 at once. Never inside a Firewall Beacon's radius or the spawn protection.
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.corru: Each Nexus turns natural surface blocks (grass, dirt, stone, sand, gravel, natural logs and leaves) into glowing Corrupted Circuitry, out to 32 blocks. It never touches anything placed by a player, a block entity, or anything near your chests and furnaces, and every block is recorded: when the Nexus falls it all goes back exactly. Inside: zombies, skeletons, spiders, creepers and pillagers become Assimilated (plating, red eyes, +4 armour, a red bolt; creepers become Proximity Mines whose EMP drains suit power); iron golems turn into Ultron Golems; Stark machines are Compromised (they stop and build drones); villagers hide and won't trade.
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.hijac: In the corruption the suit's HUD glitches and JARVIS sometimes speaks with Ultron's voice. Once per visit he tries a Hijack: a red OVERRIDE ATTEMPT Hairline fills over 4 seconds. Leave the corruption or press your suit keys 6 times to break it. If it fills, the suit locks for 5 seconds -- no flight, no abilities. A Firewall Chip (smithing table, on the helmet) or a Firewall Beacon makes you immune.
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.captu: A Nexus is shielded: you can't just shoot it. Use an Override Spike on it and stand in the 10-block circle for 60 seconds -- the timer only runs while someone is inside, twice as fast with two or more, and 40% faster with a Mind Stone in someone's off hand. Ultron throws waves the whole time, a Heavy at 50% and an Ultron Prime echo at 80%. Then the shield turns blue: break the spire (800 health). It drops Ultron Scrap and a Nanite Sample, and JARVIS gets a Trace.
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.items: Purge Charge (scrap, copper, redstone, a sculk sensor): a thrown blue EMP that puts corrupted ground back, stuns robots and frees machines, golems and hijacked suits. Firewall Beacon (2 Nanite Samples, an Arc Reactor, Vibranium Plating, iron blocks): fuel it with redstone blocks, one a day, and 48 blocks around it are safe. Override Spike (a Nanite Sample, 4 scrap, a lightning rod and a Reactor Core or redstone block). Firewall Chip (a Nanite Sample, a Stark Circuit, 2 scrap, quartz).
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.final: Three Traces (or 100% Saturation) and JARVIS finds him: a red beam marks a spot 300-600 blocks away (a red diamond on your HUD). Get within 64 blocks (or wait a day) and a sky-citadel rises 90 blocks up around the Vibranium Core. Fly up, climb the rising-rock path, or right-click the beam's base once for the Stark Lift. Fall off and the safety net catches you (6 damage). The Core charges to 100% in 12 minutes -- then the citadel drops and you lose. Each of the four Lift Engines (guarded by a Heavy) you destroy takes 15% off.
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.omega: 4 blocks tall, 4,000 health (+900 per extra fighter), and he turns on whoever is hurting him most. Phase 1: a 3-hit Vibranium Strike, a Concussive Blast that throws you toward the edge, and a Lattice of three rotating beams (find the gap); every minute he siphons the Core -- hit him hard to stop it. 75%: he splits into four. Hitting a decoy heals him; the Mind Stone shows the real one in gold, an Iron Man scanner reads the decoys as Signal Echoes, and only the real one's eyes pulse with the Core. 50%: the Iron Legion -- empty Iron Man suits glowing red; he is shielded while three stand. 25%: he tries to upload. Cut the three antennae in 35 seconds or he escapes.
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.visio: At 0 health he kneels and the screen turns gold. Anyone holding the Mind Stone can hold right-click for 3 seconds to fire the Mind Stone Beam -- he disintegrates. With no Mind Stone he self-destructs after 10 seconds (step out of the red ring). Either way he is gone.
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.rewar: A chest below the citadel: Vibranium Ingots (2 + the number of fighters), the Omega Core trophy, scrap, netherite scrap, diamonds, emeralds and books. Vibranium makes the Vibranium Shield and Vibranium Plating II. Your first win empowers your Mind Stone (Sneak + hold right-click: a golden beam) and gives JARVIS the Firewall protocol. The infection is wiped from the world.
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.resur: After Omega falls there is a 15% chance every 20 days that Ultron resurfaces as a new version (v2, v3... up to v5): tougher robots, one more Nexus, a stronger Omega. A fuelled Firewall Beacon anywhere in the world stops it.
projecthero.guide.ultron_contagion.comma: Operators: /projecthero contagion start | stop | status | saturation <0-100> | trace | nexus | finale | resurge. Stop puts every recorded block back and removes the citadel. Tuning: config/projecthero_contagion.json (terrainCorruption false = particles only).
projecthero.guide.ultron.lancer.body: A heavy silver-and-red frame (90 health, 8 armour) behind a red hex energy shield. The shield stops projectiles and beams that come at it from the front: go round it, hit it from above, or close in -- melee gets through. Lancers advance shoulder to shoulder and lunge with an energy lance (10 damage, 4 blocks). After every lunge the shield is down for 2 s: that is your opening.
projecthero.guide.ultron.hijacker.body: Lean, dark and fast (50 health). It runs cloaked -- only a shimmer -- until it is 6 blocks away, then latches onto you for up to 4 s: one of your ability keys goes dead for 6 s, and a worn Iron Man suit loses 15% of its energy. Hit it to break the latch. The Mind Stone and the Iron Man highlight show it while it is cloaked.

projecthero.nova.ability.nova_blast.desc: Hold: a golden beam from your hand (32 blocks) that burns whatever it touches the instant it lands -- 5 damage four times a second, 20 a second -- for as long as you hold R, until the Nova Force runs out. 6 Force a second, 1.5 s cooldown after.
projecthero.nova.ability.bolt_volley.des: Five homing golden bolts, 8 damage each; they seek the enemies nearest your crosshair. 20 Force, 6 s cooldown.
projecthero.nova.ability.gravimetric_pul: A 6-block shockwave all around you: 20 damage and everything is thrown into the air. 20 Force, 8 s cooldown.
projecthero.nova.ability.gravity_slam.de: From the air (2+ blocks up): dive straight down into an 8-block crater shockwave -- 10 to 30 damage, 1 more for every block you fell (full at 20). No blocks are broken. 25 Force, 12 s cooldown.
projecthero.nova.ability.force_shield.de: Hold: a golden bubble that absorbs every arrow, projectile and melee blow for as long as you hold Z. Drains 8 Force a second (needs 8 to raise), 1 s cooldown after.
projecthero.nova.ability.nova_overload.d: The ultimate. Needs a full bar and takes all of it: for 15 s every move deals double damage, the Nova Force is infinite and cooldowns are halved -- then a 30-damage nova burst 10 blocks round. Afterwards the bar is empty and refills at half speed for 60 s. 75 s cooldown.
projecthero.nova.ability.comet_dash.desc: Ram 20 blocks along your look, 20 damage to everything in the way (flying: any direction). 15 Force, 6 s cooldown.
Grab the nearest enemy within 8 blocks, rocket 30 blocks up with it and spike it into the ground: 20 damage on impact, plus the fall. 30 Force, 20 s cooldown.
projecthero.nova.ability.gravity_well.de: Open a singularity where you aim (up to 24 blocks): for 3 s it drags every mob within 8 blocks in, then collapses for 35 damage. 25 Force, 25 s cooldown.
projecthero.nova.ability.gravity_lock.de: Every mob within 10 blocks is lifted 3 blocks and frozen in the air for 4 s, then dropped. 35 Force, 20 s cooldown.
A 48-block pulse: every creature is outlined for 10 s (only you see it) and the strongest is marked red -- it takes +25% damage from everything. 15 Force, 20 s cooldown.
Heal yourself and every squadmate within 8 blocks for 6 hearts. 40 Force (40% of the bar), 20 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.nova.body: Richard Rider, Nova of the Nova Corps. The Nova Force lets you fly at 45 blocks a second, fire golden beams and bend gravity, and the Worldmind in your helmet senses every creature around you.
projecthero.guide.nova.origin.body: Somewhere in the world a Nova Corps pod has crashed: a small scorched crater with a gold-and-blue pod nose-down in it and a dying Centurion slumped against the hull. Right-click him and he hands you the Nova Corps Helmet, then fades away; use the helmet to take up the Nova Force. It is a Primary power, so it replaces the hero power you had. Crash sites are rare (about as rare as the Kryptonite crater); /locate structure projecthero:nova_pod_site finds the nearest.
projecthero.guide.nova.suit.body: H puts the Nova Corps uniform on or takes it off. Suiting up, you raise the Nova Corps Helmet in both hands and lower it onto your head, then the rest of the uniform materialises in gold from the neck down. Suiting down, the uniform fades from the feet up and you lift the helmet off. Your moves, flight and passives only work while it is on. Shift+H still opens the power wheel. Hold Shift + N for 5 seconds to take the Nova Corps Helmet off for good: the Nova Force leaves you (your Primary slot frees up) and the helmet comes back to your inventory, ready to be put on again -- or handed to someone else. The uniform is not an item: it can never be dropped or lost, and armour you wear is hidden under it (it still protects you).
projecthero.guide.nova.force.body: A 100-point bar that refills 3 a second -- half that (1.5) while you fly. Every move spends some of it, flying fast (sprinting) drains 2 a second, and NOVA OVERLOAD needs it completely full. The bar outline turns cyan when it is full. After an Overload the bar is empty, dimmed, and refills at half speed for 60 s (a quarter speed while flying).
projecthero.guide.nova.flight.body: Double-tap jump in the air while suited. 20 blocks a second, 45 sprinting: look where you want to go, Space and Sneak to rise and sink, let go to hover. While you fly, a faint skin of golden light hugs your uniform, and a streamer of gold light with two cyan strands twisting round it trails from your feet. Both grow brighter when you sprint. Touching the ground lands you.
projecthero.guide.nova.passives.body: +8 melee damage, the suit counts as full diamond armour (20 armour, 8 toughness) and cuts 20% off everything on top, no fall damage, and the Worldmind outlines every mob within 32 blocks in gold -- through walls, and only you see it.
projecthero.nova.ability.remove_helmet.d: Hold for 5 seconds: the Nova Force leaves you and the Nova Corps Helmet comes back to your inventory. Let go to cancel.
message.projecthero.nova.helmet_remove_h: Taking the helmet off... keep holding Shift + N (%s s)
message.projecthero.nova.helmet_removed: You take off the Nova Corps Helmet. The Nova Force leaves you.
projecthero.guide.nova.commands.body: /projecthero power grant nova [player] -- give the power. /projecthero power tune nova force <0-100> -- set your Nova Force. /projecthero power tune nova site -- build a crashed pod (with its Centurion) in front of you.

projecthero.guide.frost_giants.body: A rift to Jotunheim tears open above your base during a blizzard, and King Laufey's Frost Giants march through it. It's a fight against the cold as much as the giants: keep the Rune Braziers lit, or freeze.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.ladder.bo: A Hero-tier siege raid: after the Ultron Uprising, alongside the Apokolips Invasion. Few enemies, each one huge, slow and dangerous -- the opposite of Ultron's swarms. Thor players get the most out of it, but anyone can run it.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.trigger.b: Craft a Jotunheim Rune Stone: blue ice in the top corners, packed ice at the top centre and both sides, a Heart of the Sea (or a Rime Shard) in the middle, chiseled stone bricks in the bottom corners and a lodestone at the bottom centre. Place it and right-click it at night, in Survival (never on Peaceful). It becomes the Rift Anchor: it glows blue-white and can't be mined until the fight ends. Servers can turn on a natural trigger: a worthy Thor in a snowy thunderstorm at night may hear Heimdall's warning and find a Rune Stone in their pack.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.arena.bod: Everything happens within 56 blocks of the anchor, its edge a ring of pale blue snow. Everyone inside is a fighter and can't leave; anyone who walks in joins. A fighter who dies is down until they walk back in; if every fighter is down at once, the anchor shatters and you lose. The rift swirls 40 blocks overhead, the sky pales, fog closes in and snow builds up on the ground -- it all melts away when the fight ends.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.cold.body: Away from a lit brazier you slowly freeze: slowness, the frosted screen, then 1 damage a second at full frost. Fire Resistance, being on fire, lava, Pyrokinesis, the Casket of Ancient Winters in your off hand or a full Rimed netherite set keep the cold off. With every brazier out -- or once Laufey opens the Casket -- the cold bites twice as fast.
Four braziers burn 20 blocks out from the anchor. Within 7 blocks of one you thaw fast and regenerate. The giants go for them whenever no fighter is within 8 blocks (Ice Brutes love them). A brazier at 0 health goes out; hold right-click on it for 3 s to relight it (flint and steel, a fire charge or Pyrokinesis: instantly). It comes back at half health.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.waves.bod: Five waves come down a beam of frost light from the rift, half again bigger per extra fighter, never more than 16 giants at once: Rime Hounds, then Jotun Raiders, Frost Shamans, an Ice Brute, and the Frost Giant Warlord leading the final wave 5. 10 s between waves; horns sound from the rift.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.laufey.bo: A 14-block king with an ice crown and the Casket of Ancient Winters (2,500 health, +600 per extra fighter). Phase 1: three spears in a fan, two Raiders as a Royal Guard, and Frozen Grasp -- a ring under the fighter hurting him most, then an ice prison (allies break it fast; the prisoner mashes attack). Phase 2 (below two-thirds): he opens the Casket -- the blizzard doubles and every brazier loses 30%. Winter's Breath sprays a 3 s cone that freezes water and puts out braziers (hide behind ice), six Ice Pillars burst up and block sight for 20 s, and Avalanche Slam shakes 10 blocks round him.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.ymir.body: Below a third, Ymir -- the first Frost Giant -- reaches an arm through the rift. He can't be hurt. Palm Slam: his hand's shadow grows on the ground for 2 s, then 30 damage in 7 blocks -- move. Glacial Sweep: a dark line across the arena for 3 s, then his hand drags along it (20 damage and a launch). Laufey's moves come faster and the Casket floats above him.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.casket.bo: You win by breaking the floating Casket, and it can only be hurt while Laufey staggers (5 s): hit him with lightning (Thor, Electrokinesis), break a Frozen Grasp prison within 1.5 s, or take 15% of his health inside 6 s. Broken, Ymir is torn back through the rift, the blizzard ends and Laufey takes double damage. Until then he refuses to fall -- at 1 health he kneels and the Casket stays open to attack.
Every giant takes 50% more from fire, lava, burning attackers and Pyrokinesis, and 25% more from lightning (Thor is Jotunheim's old enemy). They shrug off freezing, slowness and falls, and never hurt each other.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.rewards.b: The anchor becomes a chest: Rime Shards (4 + 2 per fighter), the Jotun Skull trophy, diamonds, blue and packed ice, emeralds, bottles o' enchanting and a level-30 book. Each fighter's first ever clear also hands them the Casket of Ancient Winters.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.gear.body: At a smithing table (no template), a netherite armour piece + a Rime Shard becomes Rimed: +1 toughness and a frost trim; the full set makes you immune to freezing and lets you walk on powder snow. The Casket in your off hand does the same; right-click for Winter's Breath (a 2 s frost cone, 20 s cooldown), sneak + right-click for an Ice Prison on a mob (5 s, bosses resist, 40 s cooldown).
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.thor.body: Lightning staggers Laufey and hits every giant 25% harder. A Rime Shard on Mjolnir or Stormbreaker at a smithing table makes it Rime-touched: its thrown hits freeze. And a worthy Thor's lightning near a Casket holder becomes frost-lightning (Jotunheim Storm).
Operators: /projecthero raid start frost_giants (where you stand, any time of day), /projecthero raid end frost_giants, /projecthero raid advancetimer frost_giants (next stage: wave, Laufey's next phase, the Casket, the fall). Tuning: config/projecthero_frost_giants.json.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.unit.rime: A frost wolf, 1.6 blocks tall, in packs of 3-5 (40 health). Fast: it circles, then darts in to bite (5 damage + frost) or pounces. The first to spot you howls and the whole pack rushes in.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.unit.jotu: 4.5 blocks tall with an ice spear (140 health, 6 armour). They arrive in pairs and war-cry before charging. Spear thrust up close (10, reach 4); from 8-24 blocks a one-second wind-up, then an ice javelin (9 + frost). With nobody near, they go for the braziers.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.unit.fros: A robed caster, 5 blocks tall (160 health) -- kill her first. She keeps 14+ blocks away, raises 5 x 3 Ice Walls in front of you (8 s, breakable), encases wounded giants in a Rime Ward (4 s, then heals 25% -- break the ice!) and blasts a Frost Nova if you get within 4 blocks.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.unit.ice_: A 7-block brute with ice gauntlets (450 health, 12 armour) that smashes braziers first. It paws the ground for 1.2 s, then charges (16 + launch); or slams its fists and a line of ice spikes erupts toward you after a second of cracking frost (12 each). Fire hurts it badly.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.unit.fros: Wave 5's mini-boss, 11 blocks tall with a horned helm and a greatsword (1,200 health, +300 per extra fighter). Cleave: a wide telegraphed arc (18). Sword Plant: a ring of ice spikes runs outward -- jump it. Rally: every giant within 24 blocks hits 20% harder for 8 s. At 30% he drops to one knee for 3 s and takes half again as much damage.
projecthero.guide.frost_giants.unit.king: The King of Jotunheim. Three phases: the King's Court, the Casket Opens and Ymir's Wrath. Stagger him (lightning, a quick prison break, or a burst of damage) to expose the floating Casket, break it, then finish him. Dying, he kneels, his crown cracks and he turns to ice before he shatters.

projecthero.guide.galactus.body: The endgame event. A cosmic signal reaches the Devourer of Worlds: his Herald comes first, then his Worldship, then Galactus himself -- sixty blocks tall and impossible to kill. The only way to win is the Ultimate Nullifier.
projecthero.guide.galactus.ladder.body: The top of the threat ladder: after the Frost Giant Assault and the Ultron Contagion. Bring a full party, flight, and ranged damage. One Galactus at a time per area.
projecthero.guide.galactus.start.body: Craft a Herald's Beacon (end crystals, a netherite ingot, a nether star, amethyst blocks, crying obsidian and a beacon), place it and right-click it at night in Survival. Once your world has beaten the Ultron Contagion finale or a Frost Giant Assault, a cosmic signal may also bring him on its own (a small chance each in-game day, never on Peaceful).
projecthero.guide.galactus.arena.body: An 80-block ring round the beacon, edged in violet and silver. The sky turns deep purple and the stars shine at noon. Fighters are kept in; anyone who walks in joins; a fallen fighter is back in the fight by walking back inside. Everyone down at once is a loss.
projecthero.guide.galactus.herald.body: The Silver Surfer duels you from the air: Power Cosmic bolts (dodge them), a light-speed dash along a silver line (step off it), a reflective shield (projectiles bounce back -- use melee) and a cosmic lift that throws you into the sky. After a dash he sinks to the ground, winded, for a few seconds -- get your sword in then. At 10% health he stops and turns: from then on he fights beside you and cannot be hurt.
projecthero.guide.galactus.worldship.bod: The Worldship hangs overhead and three Element Converters (one more per two extra fighters, at most five) crash down. Each eats the land round it -- grass, dirt, stone and sand turn to grey Consumed Ground out to 16 blocks -- and fills the World Consumption bar. Each is shielded while its two Punisher guards live. Destroy it and it drops an Ultimate Nullifier part and the land comes back. Nothing near a chest or furnace is ever touched, and every block is put back.
projecthero.guide.galactus.consumption.b: Each landed converter adds 5% a minute; in Act 3 each standing Power Pylon adds 1.5%. At 100% the planet is consumed: a loss. Everything he changed is put back either way.
projecthero.guide.galactus.galactus.body: He walks slowly round the arena's edge, stopping to strike. Four Power Pylons shield and feed him: while any stands nothing gets through to him (blue sparks and a ring of metal say so) and he regenerates -- break them first. Then hit him anywhere: his body takes full damage from swords, arrows and powers, and his weak points take double -- the Chest Emblem and Helmet Crest (shoot or fly up to them) and both Gauntlets (the left comes down to the ground with Matter Transmutation, the right with the Hand Grab). Breaking one takes a chunk more. He cannot drop below 1 health.
projecthero.guide.galactus.moves.body: Eye Beams: a violet line glows on the ground for 2 s, then the beam sweeps it -- get off the line. Hand Grab: a shadow grows for 1.5 s; caught, you are lifted to his face and flung -- allies, hit the hand to break the grip. Matter Transmutation: the ground under you is marked, then turns to burning cosmic hazard -- move. Disintegration Wave: a ring races out from his feet -- jump or fly over it. Punisher Summons: two more robots drop.
projecthero.guide.galactus.punishers.bod: 8-block war robots: a heavy punch up close, a blaster-gauntlet bolt at range, and a ground slam telegraphed by a violet ring. Guards never stray far from their converter.
projecthero.guide.galactus.nullifier.bod: When every weak point is broken -- or his health is worn down to a fifth -- the Surfer calls for the parts. Once fighters hold every part, he assembles the Nullifier and hands it over. Aim at Galactus and hold right-click for 3 seconds: he raises a hand, speaks, and is gone in a burst of Power Cosmic. The Worldship leaves and the land is restored.
projecthero.guide.galactus.rewards.body: The beacon becomes a reward chest: Galactus' Helmet Crest, diamonds, netherite scrap, emeralds, amethyst and enchanted books, scaled for the party. Your first clear also gives you the Silver Surfer's Board (a fast flying mount: fly where you look, sprint to boost) and the Power Cosmic (a cosmic blast; sneak for a short shield).
projecthero.guide.galactus.commands.body: Operators: /projecthero raid start galactus (here, any time), /projecthero raid end galactus (everything is put back), /projecthero raid advance galactus (on to the next stage). Settings live in config/projecthero_galactus.json.

projecthero.guide.symbiote.s.move.symbio: Replaces Web Strike. A tendril whips out up to 8 blocks: 7 damage and a short pull towards you.
Replaces Uppercut. Spikes erupt from your whole body: 8 damage and a shove to everything within 3 blocks.
Replaces Grab & Hurl. Hold on a target within 6 blocks to squeeze it: 5 damage a second for up to 2 seconds, and you heal for 30% of what it deals. Let go to release it.
Replaces Web Pin. A cloud of black ink: enemies within 5 blocks are blinded and slowed for 4 seconds, and lose track of you.

Replaces Web Blossom. Only at a full Hunger meter: for 10 seconds you grow into a bigger, monstrous form -- +80% melee, 40% less damage taken, every punch splashes half its damage onto everything near the target. Then you crash: Weakness and Slowness for 8 seconds, and the meter cannot refill until it passes.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.hunger.body: The black suit feeds on fighting. Every hit you land feeds its Hunger meter, and so does every hit you take; after 5 seconds out of combat it drains away. The suit's strength grows with the meter -- see the bar above your Spider-Man boxes.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.hunger.tier.b: Bonded (30-80): +25% melee, +12% speed, +15% jump, a little knockback resistance, faster swinging.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.hunger.tier.o: Overdrive (80+): +40% melee, +18% speed, +20% jump, a better Spider-Sense dodge -- but it eats your food, fire and sound hurt twice as much, and H will not take the suit off.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.hunger.tier.t: Let It Take Over (hold V at a full meter): 10 seconds of the monstrous form, then an 8-second crash.
projecthero.guide.symbiote.black_suit.in: With the suit on, six of Spider-Man's moves become the Symbiote's (purple-bordered in the HUD). The other twelve stay as they are.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.s: Stealth: mobs notice you from 85% as far when walking, 60% sneaking and 40% wall-crawling, perched or hanging -- less again in the dark. Fighting, getting hit or swinging gives you away for 5 seconds. Your first hit on a mob that hasn't noticed you is an ambush: +50% damage and a 1.5-second stun (every 10 seconds). Break line of sight and stay hidden for 4 seconds and a chasing mob loses track of you. Bosses and the Warden aren't fooled. The eye left of your web boxes shows how hidden you are.
projecthero.guide.spider_man.traversal.d: Fall a long way (about 8 blocks, not swinging or gliding) and you tip over into a head-first dive, arms swept back and legs together. Fire a web, open your Web Wings or land and you come straight out of it. Just a look -- your fall is unchanged.
message.projecthero.gamma_reactor.absorb: You can't move. The radiation is pouring into you...
message.projecthero.hulk_mind.enter: Darkness. The blast is gone -- and so is everything else. You are inside your own head.
message.projecthero.hulk_mind.hint: Something is staring back at you from the mirror. Right-click it.
projecthero.hulk.ability.super_punch.des: R: one huge punch that blasts an 8-block cone in front of him -- up to 21 damage and a heavy knockback to everything in it, and the blocks in the cone are smashed (never bedrock, chests or anything harder than the Hulk's block limit). 6 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.fault_stomp.des: Shift+G: he stomps and a fissure races 16 blocks along the ground the way he is facing, cracking it open -- everything standing on it takes 12 and is launched into the air. 10 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.bulldoze.desc: Z: he barrels 12 blocks straight ahead. Everything in his path takes 12, is carried along on his shoulders and flung aside when he stops; soft blocks (dirt, wood, stone) in the way are smashed. 10 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.uppercut.desc: Shift+Z: an uppercut that sends the mob you are looking at (or the nearest one in front, within 4 blocks) high into the air -- 16.5 damage. Bosses take the hit but stay put. 7 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.gamma_burst.des: C: spends 25 rage to let the gamma out all at once -- a green blast of energy all round him, 22.5 damage within 10 blocks (less at the edge) and a heavy shove. Needs 25 rage. 10 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.earth_wall.desc: Shift+C: he tears a wall of earth up out of the ground in front of him -- 7 wide and 4 high, made of the ground it came from. Cover from arrows and charges; after 10 s it crumbles and the ground is as it was. 15 s cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.debris_throw.de: Shift+V (with no mob in front of you): he rips a chunk of the ground he is standing on out -- grass, sand, stone, whatever it is -- and holds it overhead; hold V to wind up the throw and let go (20 blocks for a tap, 300 at full charge). It explodes where it lands (22.5 damage in 4 blocks, a small crater) -- and thrown 100 blocks or more it craters like a thrown mob, bigger the further past 100. Shares Grab's cooldown.
projecthero.hulk.ability.loki_slam.desc: Shift+V while looking at a mob within 10 blocks (or while holding one): he grabs it and smashes it into the floor four times -- overhead, left, right, left, right -- 9 damage and a cracked floor every time. Bosses and anything too big are refused. 15 s cooldown.

Every clean alternation fills the struggle bar under your crosshair, it drains quickly if you slow down, and the same key twice slips. A Spider-Man can still cut you free with sneak + right-click.

projecthero.hulk.ability.world_breaker.d: H at 100% rage (the HUD flashes "H: WORLD BREAKER"): he roars "HULK IS STRONGEST THERE IS!!!" for everyone within 64 blocks to see, and for 30 seconds he grows to 10 blocks tall, glowing green veins burst out over his body, rage stays at 100, and everything he does is doubled -- damage (on top of his rage bonus), the size of every move, and the blocks and craters it smashes. Then Burnout: for a minute he shrinks back with no rage at all, slowed, weakened and tired (Slowness II, Weakness II, Mining Fatigue), and his rage can't build. World Breaker can't be used again for 5 minutes after it ends.
projecthero.guide.hulk.world_breaker_v01:
When his rage hits 100%, the HUD flashes "H: WORLD BREAKER". Press H (it won't change you back while it is up) and the Hulk lets everything out: "HULK IS STRONGEST THERE IS!!!" fills the screen of everyone within 64 blocks, and a roar that shakes the ground and throws everything near him away, and he grows to 10 blocks tall -- as tall as there is room for -- with glowing green veins pulsing over his body. For 30 seconds his rage stays at 100 and everything is doubled: every hit does twice the damage on top of his rage bonus, every move covers twice the area, and it smashes twice the blocks and leaves craters twice the size. H does nothing while it runs, and the rage bar counts it down.

It costs him. When it ends he burns out for a minute: he shrinks back down with no rage at all, Slowness II, Weakness II and Mining Fatigue, and his rage can't build until the Burnout passes. World Breaker can't be used again for 5 minutes after it ends -- the HUD just says it is burned out. It can't be started mid-change or during a rampage. Dying, changing back or logging out ends it at once.

projecthero.miraculous.ability.ladybug_y: Whip the Yo-yo out 12 blocks along your look: the first creature in the way takes 10 damage and it snaps back. 0.8 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.ladybug_r: The Yo-yo bounces between up to 4 threats, each within 8 blocks of the last, for 7 damage each, then returns. 3 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.ladybug_y: The string wraps a creature or player up to 16 blocks away and roots it for 3 s (bosses 1 s). Press G again within the 3 s to yank it to you. 6 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.ladybug_l: Throw the bound target (or bind and throw one at once) the way you look; it takes 8 damage when it lands or hits a wall, plus any fall damage. Not bosses. 7 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.ladybug_y: Hold to hook a block up to 45 blocks away and swing on the string like Spider-Man; Jump reels in, Sneak lets out. Let go to fling yourself off with the arc's speed.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.ladybug_z: Hook a block up to 75 blocks away and reel straight to it fast, no swing. 2 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.ladybug_s: Hold: the Yo-yo spins in front of you as a red disc. Arrows shatter on it, other shots bounce back, and melee from the front does a quarter damage and throws the attacker back. Up to 6 s; 2 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.ladybug_l: A spotted object drops from the sky that suits the moment: an apple when hurt (Regeneration II 1 min, Absorption V, full hunger), TNT when surrounded (as strong as 10 TNT), a parachute when falling, otherwise a Sharpness V netherite-strength sword or a Power V bow. 10 s of Ladybug Vision; starts the 3-minute countdown. Again while holding it: Miraculous Ladybug -- broken blocks within 64 come back and you and your squad heal to full.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.ladybug_p: Plant the string and vault about 10 blocks up and 10 forward. 3 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.ladybug_t: String a wire from where you stand to the block you look at (up to 10 blocks) for 20 s; anything hostile that crosses it is rooted for 2 s. 10 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.ladybug_y: Open the Yo-yo like a compact: every threat within 40 blocks glows red through walls for 10 s, for you alone. 15 s cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.ladybug_r: Lasso the squadmate you aim at (up to 50 blocks, in sight) with the Yo-yo string and reel them to your side. They land safely with Resistance II for 4 s. 15 s cooldown.

message.projecthero.ghost_rider.revert_l: The Spirit won't let go until dawn
message.projecthero.ghost_rider.revert_c: Still in the fight: the Spirit lets go %ss after the last blow
message.projecthero.ghost_rider.revert_h: The Spirit won't let go with monsters within 20 blocks
message.projecthero.ghost_rider.death_ch: Death can't take the Spirit. It holds on until dawn.
The Spirit keeps you alive, but it can't rise in daylight
message.projecthero.ghost_rider.death_ta: The Spirit takes over. It holds on until dawn.
message.projecthero.ghost_rider.lock_lif: Dawn: the Spirit loosens its grip (H to let it go)
message.projecthero.ghost_rider.no_stare: Look a creature in the eye to judge it
message.projecthero.ghost_rider.stared_a: The Penance Stare: feel every pain you have caused
message.projecthero.ghost_rider.wrath: Rider's Wrath: %s riders burn with you
hud.projecthero.ghost_rider.title: Ghost Rider
projecthero.ghost_rider.ability.hellfire: Hold to throw balls of skull fire, 2 a second: 20 damage each, and the target burns for 5s. 10 Hellfire a bolt.
A wall of fire rolls 10 blocks along the ground in front of you: 30 damage, a lift and 4s of burning. 25 Hellfire, 8s cooldown.
projecthero.ghost_rider.ability.chain_wh: Lash the burning chain up to 8 blocks: 18 damage and fire. Small creatures are yanked to you. 5 Hellfire, 1.5s cooldown.
projecthero.ghost_rider.ability.chain_sp: Whirl the chain round you for 3s, hitting everything within 4 blocks for 13 twice a second. 25 Hellfire, 10s cooldown.
projecthero.ghost_rider.ability.hell_cyc: Summon the bike under you: 15 blocks a second, 30 sprinting, 4-block steps, slides along walls, drives up taller ones (hold forward) and skims over lava. Under the Spirit it burns and leaves a fire trail that burns enemies; ridden as a human it doesn't burn. Shift+X sends it back. Shift does not get you off.
projecthero.ghost_rider.ability.cycle_ju: X while riding the Hell Cycle: leap 15 blocks and land in a ring of fire (10 damage within 4 blocks). 20 Hellfire, 6s cooldown.
projecthero.ghost_rider.ability.judgemen: Every guilty creature within 30 blocks glows red (only you see it) and takes +25% damage from you for 15s. 20 Hellfire, 20s cooldown.
projecthero.ghost_rider.ability.penance_: Lock eyes with a creature for 2s (it can not move), then burn its soul: 10 + your Vengeance + 4 per point of its guilt (up to 60), all your Vengeance spent. Undead and bosses take 15; players take 3 per player they have killed. 15 Hellfire, 20s cooldown.
projecthero.ghost_rider.ability.hellfire: Charge 12 blocks forward wreathed in hellfire, smashing through everything in your path: 18 damage, heavy knockback and burning. 30 Hellfire, 8s cooldown.
Slam the ground: pillars of hellfire burst up within 6 blocks for 25 damage, launching enemies, and the ground burns for 4s. 50 Hellfire, 20s cooldown.
projecthero.ghost_rider.ability.soul_shi: A ring of hellfire for 4s: every hit on you is halved and close attackers are set alight. 25 Hellfire, 14s cooldown.
projecthero.ghost_rider.ability.riders_w: You and every squadmate within 6 blocks get Strength II and Fire Resistance for 10s. 40 Hellfire, 45s cooldown.
item.projecthero.miraculous_box.tooltip: The Guardian's box. One Miraculous rests inside.
item.projecthero.miraculous_jewel.toolti: Right-click to wake the Kwami. It replaces any other Primary power you hold.
message.projecthero.miraculous.hungry: %s is too tired to transform you. Feed them %s first (or 10 of any other food).
message.projecthero.miraculous.time_up: Time's up: your Miraculous lets go
message.projecthero.miraculous.not_trans: Transform first: say your phrase in chat
message.projecthero.miraculous.feed_tran: %s is inside your Miraculous: change back first
message.projecthero.miraculous.snack: %s munches happily (you feel a little better)
message.projecthero.miraculous.fed.tikki: Mmm, thank you! I'm ready whenever you are.
message.projecthero.miraculous.fed.plagg: Ahh, Camembert. Okay, okay, I'm back in business.
message.projecthero.miraculous.fed.nooro: Thank you, Master. Honey always helps.
message.projecthero.miraculous.tired.tik: Phew... I need a cookie before we go again.
message.projecthero.miraculous.tired.tri: That was fun! But I need a macaron now.
message.projecthero.miraculous.tired.noo: I... I am so tired. A little honey, please?
message.projecthero.miraculous.intro.tik: Hello! I'm Tikki, your Kwami. Don't be scared, you've been chosen!
With these Earrings you can become Ladybug. Just say "Tikki, spots on!" in chat.
Say "Spots off!" to change back. Transforming tires me out, so keep cookies handy!
message.projecthero.miraculous.intro.pla: Ugh, finally, someone opened the box. Name's Plagg. Got any cheese?
That's the Ring. Say "Plagg, claws out!" in chat and you're Cat Noir. Whatever.
"Claws in!" turns you back. Then I want Camembert. The smelly kind. Every time.
message.projecthero.miraculous.intro.tri: Ta-da! You found me! I'm Trixx, Kwami of Illusion. Nice to meet you!
Wear the Necklace and say "Trixx, let's pounce!" in chat to become Rena Rouge.
Say "Let's rest!" to change back. I'll be starving by then, so save me a macaron!
message.projecthero.miraculous.intro.noo: Oh! H-hello. I am Nooroo, Kwami of Transmission. You found my Brooch.
Say "Nooroo, dark wings rise!" in chat and you will become Hawk Moth.
Say "Dark wings fall!" to change back. I will need honey after. Please use it kindly.
hud.projecthero.miraculous.hungry.tikki: Tikki is hungry: cookies, or 10 of any food
hud.projecthero.miraculous.hungry.plagg: Plagg is hungry: Camembert, or 10 of any food

projecthero.guide.ladybug.tier: Hero-Tier power (Primary): the Miraculous of the Ladybug
projecthero.guide.cat_noir.tier: Hero-Tier power (Primary): the Miraculous of the Black Cat
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.tier: Hero-Tier power (Primary): the Miraculous of the Fox
projecthero.guide.hawk_moth.tier: Hero-Tier power (Primary): the Miraculous of the Butterfly
projecthero.guide.ladybug.body: Tikki, the Kwami of Creation, lives in the Ladybug Earrings. Say her phrase in chat and she turns you into Ladybug, the hero of good luck, with a yo-yo and six moves on R, G, X, Z, V and C (each with a Shift version).
projecthero.guide.cat_noir.body: Plagg, the Kwami of Destruction, lives in the Cat Ring. Say his phrase in chat and he turns you into Cat Noir, the black cat with an extending baton, with six moves on R, G, X, Z, V and C (each with a Shift version).
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.body: Trixx, the Kwami of Illusion, lives in the Fox Necklace. Say the phrase in chat and Trixx turns you into Rena Rouge, the fox hero of illusions, with a flute and six moves on R, G, X, Z, V and C (each with a Shift version).
projecthero.guide.hawk_moth.body: Nooroo, the Kwami of Transmission, lives in the Butterfly Brooch. Say his phrase in chat and he turns you into Hawk Moth, master of the butterflies, with a cane and six moves on R, G, X, Z, V and C (each with a Shift version).
projecthero.guide.miraculous.box.body: The Guardian's hexagonal black-and-red box turns up in jungle temple chests (about 1 in 8) and woodland mansion chests (about 1 in 6). Right-click it to open it: inside is one random jewel. With the projectheroUniquePowers gamerule on, it prefers a jewel whose Kwami nobody holds.
projecthero.guide.ladybug.jewel.body: Right-click the Ladybug Earrings: Tikki pops out, says hello and Ladybug becomes your Primary power, replacing any other. The jewel is used up. From then on you wear the earrings: black studs, red with black spots while you are transformed.
projecthero.guide.cat_noir.jewel.body: Right-click the Cat Ring: Plagg pops out, grumbles hello and Cat Noir becomes your Primary power, replacing any other. The jewel is used up. From then on you wear the ring on your right hand: silver, black with a green paw while you are transformed.
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.jewel.body: Right-click the Fox Necklace: Trixx pops out, says hello and Rena Rouge becomes your Primary power, replacing any other. The jewel is used up. From then on you wear the necklace, its orange fox-tail pendant on your chest.
projecthero.guide.hawk_moth.jewel.body: The Butterfly Brooch is never in the Miraculous Box: it hides in stronghold library chests (about 1 in 6) and ancient city chests (about 1 in 10). Right-click it: Nooroo pops out, says hello and Hawk Moth becomes your Primary power, replacing any other. The jewel is used up. From then on you wear the brooch at your collar: purple and silver, deep violet while transformed.
projecthero.guide.ladybug.kwami.body: While you are not transformed, Tikki floats over your shoulder and goes wherever you go: caves, water, flying, riding. She looks where you look and drifts round you when you stand still. Nothing can hurt her, and if she is ever left behind she comes straight back to you. Press N to tuck Tikki away out of sight (N again calls them back out); you can only transform while Tikki is out. Hold Shift+N for 5 seconds to take the Miraculous off: the Kwami goes back into its jewel, which lands in your inventory (not while transformed or while the Kwami is hungry).
projecthero.guide.cat_noir.kwami.body: While you are not transformed, Plagg floats over your shoulder and goes wherever you go: caves, water, flying, riding. He looks where you look and drifts round you when you stand still. Nothing can hurt him, and if he is ever left behind he comes straight back to you. Press N to tuck Plagg away out of sight (N again calls them back out); you can only transform while Plagg is out. Hold Shift+N for 5 seconds to take the Miraculous off: the Kwami goes back into its jewel, which lands in your inventory (not while transformed or while the Kwami is hungry).
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.kwami.body: While you are not transformed, Trixx floats over your shoulder and goes wherever you go: caves, water, flying, riding. Trixx looks where you look and drifts round you when you stand still. Nothing can hurt Trixx, and a Kwami left behind comes straight back to you. Press N to tuck Trixx away out of sight (N again calls them back out); you can only transform while Trixx is out. Hold Shift+N for 5 seconds to take the Miraculous off: the Kwami goes back into its jewel, which lands in your inventory (not while transformed or while the Kwami is hungry).
projecthero.guide.hawk_moth.kwami.body: While you are not transformed, Nooroo flutters over your shoulder and goes wherever you go: caves, water, flying, riding. He looks where you look and drifts round you when you stand still. Nothing can hurt him, and if he is ever left behind he comes straight back to you. Press N to tuck Nooroo away out of sight (N again calls them back out); you can only transform while Nooroo is out. Hold Shift+N for 5 seconds to take the Miraculous off: the Kwami goes back into its jewel, which lands in your inventory (not while transformed or while the Kwami is hungry).
projecthero.guide.ladybug.transform.body: Type "Tikki, spots on!" -- or just "Spots on!" -- in chat to transform (capitals and punctuation don't matter). Tikki spins into the Earrings, ribbons of red light wrap round you and, with a flash, you are Ladybug. Type "Spots off!" (or "Tikki, spots off!") to change back. H does not transform. Chat shows the phrase as the hero saying it ("<Ladybug> Spots on!"), never under your own name, so nobody learns who you are.
projecthero.guide.cat_noir.transform.bod: Type "Plagg, claws out!" -- or just "Claws out!" -- in chat to transform (capitals and punctuation don't matter). Plagg spins into the Ring, ribbons of green light wrap round you and, with a flash, you are Cat Noir. Type "Claws in!" (or "Plagg, claws in!") to change back. H does not transform. Chat shows the phrase as the hero saying it ("<Cat Noir> Claws out!"), never under your own name, so nobody learns who you are.
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.transform.b: Type "Trixx, let's pounce!" -- or just "Let's pounce!" -- in chat to transform (capitals, punctuation and the apostrophe don't matter). Trixx spins into the Necklace, ribbons of orange light wrap round you and, with a flash, you are Rena Rouge. Type "Let's rest!" (or "Trixx, let's rest!") to change back. H does not transform. Chat shows the phrase as the hero saying it ("<Rena Rouge> Let's pounce!"), never under your own name, so nobody learns who you are.
projecthero.guide.hawk_moth.transform.bo: Type "Nooroo, dark wings rise!" -- or just "Dark wings rise!" -- in chat to transform (capitals and punctuation don't matter). Nooroo spins into the Brooch, ribbons of violet light wrap round you and, with a flash, you are Hawk Moth. Type "Dark wings fall!" (or "Nooroo, dark wings fall!") to change back. H does not transform. Chat shows the phrase as the hero saying it ("<Hawk Moth> Dark wings rise!"), never under your own name, so nobody learns who you are.
projecthero.guide.miraculous.countdown.b: Your Shift+Z special starts a 3-minute countdown. The five spots on the HUD jewel go out one every 36 seconds, with a soft beep as each goes out and every second of the last ten. At zero you change back, whatever you are doing.

projecthero.guide.quirks.tier: My Hero Academia: seven Quirks, each a Primary power
projecthero.guide.quirks.body: A Quirk is a superpower you are born with. Eight can awaken in you: Hellflame, Overhaul, Engine, Dark Shadow, Erasure, Explosion, Zero Gravity and One For All. Each is a Primary power (you hold one at a time). The first seven are always on; One For All has a Base Form and a Power Form (H).
projecthero.guide.quirks.get.body: The first time you spawn into a world, if neither a Green Lantern ring nor a Miraculous chose you, there is a 5% chance that a random Quirk awakens in you. Otherwise drink a Quirk Serum. A new Quirk replaces whatever Primary power you had.
projecthero.guide.quirks.get.short: A 5% chance when you first spawn into a world (after the Green Lantern ring and the Miraculous miss), or drink its Quirk Serum. It replaces your Primary power.
projecthero.guide.quirks.serums.body: Every Quirk has its own serum (quirk_serum_<quirk>), and the Quirk Trigger (quirk_serum_random) awakens a random one. Craft them, or find them in dungeon loot chests.
projecthero.guide.quirks.suit.body: Getting a Quirk never changes your look. Each hero has a suit you craft and wear like armour (iron-level): helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots, in the vanilla armour shapes from iron and two themed items. Anyone can wear one.
projecthero.guide.quirks.suit.short: Craft it and wear it like armour. Anyone can wear it; a Quirk alone never changes your look.
projecthero.guide.quirks.meter.body: Every Quirk has its own meter on the HUD (Heat, Focus, Engine, Shadow, Dry Eyes, Sweat or Nausea). Push it to the limit and the Quirk overloads for a few seconds. Each Quirk's chapter says how, and which move still works.
projecthero.guide.quirks.controls.body: 12 moves on R, G, X, Z, V and C, each with a Shift version, shown on the HUD. Some are held, some toggle. H is still the power selector.
projecthero.guide.quirks.moves.none: (The move list appears once the Quirk's kit has loaded.)
projecthero.guide.quirks.erasure.body: While Eraser Head stares at someone, ALL their powers stop: mutations, Hero-Tier powers, Miraculous and Quirks, players included. Tech gear such as Iron Man suits keeps working.
projecthero.guide.quirks.erased.body: If Eraser Head stares at you, your Quirk (and every other power) stops until they blink or look away. Tech gear such as Iron Man suits still works.
projecthero.guide.quirks.erased.self: Your stare stops every power, other Erasure users' included. Tech gear such as Iron Man suits keeps working: it is not a power.
projecthero.guide.quirks.one_for_all: One For All runs on its own engine -- two forms and a 20-minute One For All timer instead of a meter. Its chapter is in this section.
projecthero.guide.quirk.hellflame.tier: Quirk (Primary power): Hellflame, the Quirk of Endeavor
projecthero.guide.quirk.hellflame.body: The Number One Hero's fire, held back only by his own body. Cutting strings, a wall of flame, jet flight and the huge Prominence Burn beam all raise your Body Heat. X is your movement key (flight and the Jet Burn dash), V your utility key (Cool Down and Plus Ultra).
Body Heat rises with every flame, and every tick while you fly, wear the Flame Cloak or fire Prominence Burn. Stop burning and it vents about 4 a second, faster in water or rain.
projecthero.guide.quirk.hellflame.overlo: At 100 Heat you overheat: every move ends, you burn from the inside and can't use fire moves until the Heat drains to 40 (6 s). V Cool Down still works and ends it. After Plus Ultra you are burnt out: Heat pinned at 100 for 10 s and nothing works.
projecthero.guide.quirk.hellflame.passiv: Ordinary fire doesn't hurt you (lava still does), except while overheated. Your squad is never burned. Bosses take at most 10% of their health per hit and are never trapped. Fire you light is always temporary and never placed next to anything that burns.
projecthero.guide.quirk.overhaul.tier: Quirk (Primary power): Overhaul, the Quirk of Kai Chisaki
projecthero.guide.quirk.overhaul.body: Take apart and put back anything you touch: burst enemies apart, make the ground erupt in spikes, walls and pits, reassemble the wounded, rebuild broken ground and fuse with the earth into a spiked stone giant.
projecthero.guide.quirk.overhaul.meter.b: Focus: every touch spends it, and it comes back on its own a second later (twice as fast with your gloves on).
projecthero.guide.quirk.overhaul.overloa: Run Focus dry and your moves stop for a few seconds. The gloves (Shift+C) still work.
projecthero.guide.quirk.overhaul.passive: Shift+C puts your gloves on or off. Gloves on, nothing you touch comes apart, so melee is safe. Gloves off, your moves work and a bare-handed punch disassembles a little too. Spikes, walls and pits are temporary: the ground always goes back.
projecthero.guide.quirk.engine.tier: Quirk (Primary power): Engine, the Quirk of Tenya Iida
projecthero.guide.quirk.engine.body: Engines in your calves. Gear up (V) for a sustained run that builds speed the longer you go, then kick: every other key is an engine-driven kick.
projecthero.guide.quirk.engine.meter.bod: Heat rises while you sprint in gear (faster in higher gears and Recipro) and with every kick. It cools on its own when you walk or stand, fastest in neutral.
At 100 heat, and when Recipro Extend or Recipro Turbo ends, your engines stall: Slowness III, no moves and back to neutral.
projecthero.guide.quirk.engine.passive.b: Step assist always. In gear: sharp turns slide, and at Gear 2+ you bowl over mobs you run into.
projecthero.guide.quirk.dark_shadow.tier: Quirk (Primary power): Dark Shadow, the Quirk of Fumikage Tokoyami
projecthero.guide.quirk.dark_shadow.body: A living shadow-bird grows out of your back and fights for you. In daylight it is small and timid, at night big and fierce, and in the pitch dark it can break loose.
projecthero.guide.quirk.dark_shadow.mete: Shadow climbs fast in the pitch dark (light 3 or less), slowly in dim light (to 85 at most) and falls in bright light. Every move pushes it up. Its strength follows the light at it: x0.4 in daylight, x1.7 in the pitch dark.
projecthero.guide.quirk.dark_shadow.over: At 100 Shadow it goes berserk: huge, spiked and red-eyed, it attacks everything near you, you included (never below 1 heart), until light falls on it. A light source in your hand, daylight or the Light Flare (Shift+C, which still works) calms it.
projecthero.guide.quirk.dark_shadow.pass: X is movement and V the mode. A torch or other light source held in either hand counts as light on it. In Black Ankh it is close to you and its Shadow rises half as fast.
projecthero.guide.quirk.dark_shadow.bird: Your head becomes a bird's while you hold Dark Shadow, suit or not.
projecthero.guide.quirk.erasure.tier: Quirk (Primary power): Erasure, the Quirk of Shota Aizawa
projecthero.guide.quirk.erasure.body: Stare at someone and their power stops. Fight with the capture scarf -- bind, pull, swing, spin a foe into others, rip weapons away -- and with close-quarters martial arts.
projecthero.guide.quirk.erasure.meter.bo: Dry Eyes fills while you stare (V) and drains when you blink (let go). The goggles slow it.
projecthero.guide.quirk.erasure.overload: At 100 your eyes shut: the stare ends and can't start again until they recover (about 3 s). Your other moves still work. Eye Drops (Shift+V, uses the item) open them at once.
The stare cancels EVERY power while it holds, players included: keys, flight (hero, Thor, Kryptonian, Nova, Lantern, Max Steel), wall-crawling and passives. On mobs: creepers can't swell, skeletons and pillagers can't shoot, endermen can't teleport, blazes and ghasts can't fire. Bosses lose their special moves but still fight. Tech (Iron Man, the Punisher) keeps working.
projecthero.guide.quirk.explosion.tier: Quirk (Primary power): Explosion, the Quirk of Katsuki Bakugo
projecthero.guide.quirk.explosion.body: Your sweat is like nitroglycerin: hold X to fly on palm blasts, and blow things up with AP Shots, Howitzer Impact and the Gauntlet Grenade.
Sweat builds while you fight and move, faster where it is hot. Moves spend it: the more Sweat, the bigger the blast.
projecthero.guide.quirk.explosion.overlo: Every blast strains your arms (the Arms gauge). Fully strained: 5 s of Weakness II and no moves. Shift+V Cool Off eases it.
projecthero.guide.quirk.explosion.passiv: Your explosions never hurt you or your squad, and only break blocks (a little) when mobGriefing is on.
projecthero.guide.quirk.zero_gravity.tie: Quirk (Primary power): Zero Gravity, the Quirk of Ochaco Uraraka
projecthero.guide.quirk.zero_gravity.bod: Touch something with all five fingertips and it becomes weightless: mobs, players, dropped items, even blocks. Bring your fingertips together to Release, and everything you floated comes crashing down. V is your utility key (Touch and Release), X your movement key (Float Self and the Zero-G Leap).
projecthero.guide.quirk.zero_gravity.met: Nausea rises with how much you float and for how long: mobs, blocks, items and your own body. It falls when nothing floats, and fast while you Settle.
projecthero.guide.quirk.zero_gravity.ove: At 100 everything you float drops, you get Nausea for 5 s and can't use moves, except Shift+C Settle.
projecthero.guide.quirk.zero_gravity.pas: Up to 5 creatures and 6 blocks float by touch at once. Bosses can't be floated. A lifted block's hole is filled back in exactly as it was the moment the block lands, and blocks are only taken with terrain damage and mobGriefing on.
projecthero.guide.ladybug.food.body: Every time you change back (by the phrase, the countdown or dying), Tikki is worn out and hungry, and won't transform you again until she has eaten a cookie. Right-click her with one, or just eat one while she is hungry and she eats it instead. A cookie when she isn't hungry gives you a little Regeneration. No favourite food on you? Right-click the Kwami with 10 pieces of any other food instead (hand them over a few at a time if you like). The favourite takes 10 seconds to eat, the 10 other pieces 22 seconds, and you can transform once the meal is finished.
projecthero.guide.cat_noir.food.body: Every time you change back (by the phrase, the countdown or dying), Plagg is worn out and hungry, and won't transform you again until he has eaten Camembert. Right-click him with it, or eat it while he is hungry and he eats it instead. Camembert: a milk bucket, wheat and a brown mushroom, shapeless (the bucket comes back). No favourite food on you? Right-click the Kwami with 10 pieces of any other food instead (hand them over a few at a time if you like). The favourite takes 10 seconds to eat, the 10 other pieces 22 seconds, and you can transform once the meal is finished.
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.food.body: Every time you change back (by the phrase, the countdown or dying), Trixx is worn out and hungry, and won't transform you again until Trixx has eaten a macaron. Right-click Trixx with one, or eat one while Trixx is hungry. Macarons: 2 sugar, an egg and a wheat (the flour) make 4, shapeless. No favourite food on you? Right-click the Kwami with 10 pieces of any other food instead (hand them over a few at a time if you like). The favourite takes 10 seconds to eat, the 10 other pieces 22 seconds, and you can transform once the meal is finished.
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.mirage.body: Shift+Z opens a round wheel of eight illusions. Point the mouse at one and click (or let go of Z over it): you play the Flute, the orange bubble floats off and pops, and the illusion runs for 30 seconds. The first one starts the 3-minute countdown. The cooldown is 2 minutes from the pick, so you can cast it twice a transformation. Escape, or closing the wheel, spends nothing. Bosses are fooled too; one that can't really move just stops attacking while it lasts. When an illusion ends it shatters in an orange flash and the mobs it fooled stay dazed (slow, no attacks) for 3 seconds.
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.mirage_foxe: The classic Mirage: five copies of you that swing when you swing, a wall of fake blocks, and the monsters within 20 blocks confused into fighting each other. A copy that is hit bursts into orange mist that blinds and confuses whoever hit it. Eight illusory foxes leap out too: they chase the nearest enemies, bite for 6, pull the bitten onto themselves, take 3 hits before popping and never touch you or your squad.
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.mirage_mons: A huge orange fox-beast rears up beside you, for everyone to see. Every mob within 24 blocks panics: it drops its target and runs from it.
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.mirage_vani: You and your squad vanish for the mobs: they lose you and can't pick you again unless you hit them. Three copies of you sprint off in other directions to lead them away.
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.mirage_zone: Where you aim, 12 blocks round, the ground seems to crack and burn. Mobs inside try to get out; mobs outside won't walk or chase into it. Nothing really burns.
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.mirage_lure: A dazzling heap of treasure appears where you aim. Every mob within 30 blocks drops its target and crowds round it, staring.
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.mirage_pitf: A real 4x4 pit, 3 deep, opens where you aim, covered by a fake floor. Mobs near it walk straight across and fall in. It only digs natural ground (never chests, other block entities or bedrock), respects build protection, never opens under you or a squadmate (and lifts you out if you fall in), and fills back exactly when it ends.
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.mirage_ecli: A dome of night 20 blocks across follows you. Enemies inside are almost blind: they lose track of anything farther than 4 blocks, and their arrows and fireballs fly wide. You and your squad see normally.
projecthero.guide.rena_rouge.mirage_mirr: A ring of mirrors turns round you. Every enemy within 20 blocks sees the others as you: they turn on each other the whole time and won't go for you or your squad.
projecthero.guide.hawk_moth.food.body: Every time you change back (by the phrase, the countdown or dying), Nooroo is worn out and hungry, and won't transform you again until he has had a honey bottle. Right-click him with one, or drink one while he is hungry and he has it instead. No favourite food on you? Right-click the Kwami with 10 pieces of any other food instead (hand them over a few at a time if you like). The favourite takes 10 seconds to eat, the 10 other pieces 22 seconds, and you can transform once the meal is finished.
projecthero.guide.miraculous.passives.bo: +12 armour, +6 toughness, +10 max health, +7 melee damage, Regeneration I, 25% faster, higher jumps and half fall damage -- and no fall damage at all on the landing after a movement move (a dash, vault, leap, swing, zip line, surf, roll or portal hop).
projecthero.guide.miraculous.commands.bo: Operators: /projecthero power grant <player> ladybug, cat_noir, rena_rouge, hawk_moth, carapace, pegasus or viperion, and /projecthero power tune miraculous kwami, feed, toggle or countdown <seconds>.
projecthero.guide.ghost_rider.body: A flaming-skull judge on a hell bike. Ghost Rider is a tough fire brawler who hunts the guilty.
projecthero.guide.ghost_rider.origin.bod: Mephisto's Contract is rare loot in Nether fortress chests and bastion chests. Right-click it, read the terms and Sign in Blood. It replaces any other Primary power. The price is 5 hearts of max health, given back the first time you change.
projecthero.guide.ghost_rider.change.bod: Press H at night. The leathers fold round you from the back, your face slowly burns away and the skull erupts in flame. The Spirit can't rise in daylight, and sunrise drives it back. Press H again to let it go, but only out of combat (5s since you last hit or were hit) with no monster within 20 blocks. As a human you can still use every move, at 60% strength.
projecthero.guide.ghost_rider.hellfire.b: The orange bar (0-100) pays for every move. It refills 6 a second, always (Superman's sun rate). While changed, your Regeneration III costs 2 of that a second, and stops if the Hellfire runs out.
Monsters are born guilty. Anything that hurts you, a villager or a player gains guilt, and killing one gains a lot. Hitting the guilty fills the red Vengeance bar, and the Penance Stare burns all of it at once. Vengeance fades after 10s without a guilty hit.
projecthero.guide.ghost_rider.cycle.body: X summons the bike under you (human or Ghost Rider), X while riding is the Cycle Jump and Shift+X sends it back (Shift does not get you off). 15 blocks a second, 30 while you sprint. It steers where you look, climbs 4-block steps, slides along walls it meets at an angle, drives up taller walls when you hold forward against them and skims over lava. Only under the Spirit does it burn and leave a fire trail.
projecthero.guide.ghost_rider.passives.b: Changed: +11 melee damage, Regeneration III, diamond-level armour built in (but you can't wear any: it goes back into your bag), immune to fire and lava, +6 max health (3 hearts), no drowning, and undead lose their nerve (wither skeletons run). You burn through food twice as fast. You look like a demon: iron and snow golems attack you, villagers and traders run and won't trade, animals bolt, other people's cats and wolves hiss and keep away (your own pets stay loyal), and anything under your Judgement Mark cowers, slowed. Human: fire still cannot hurt you.
projecthero.guide.ghost_rider.rules.body: You cannot die while you carry the Spirit. A killing blow leaves you on 3 hearts instead. At night, if you were human, the Spirit takes over and you change on the spot, and it then holds on until dawn: H can't turn you back until the next sunrise. In daylight it still keeps you alive, but you stay human. /kill and the void still kill.
projecthero.guide.ghost_rider.commands.b: /projecthero power grant ghost_rider [player], /projecthero power tune ghost_rider hellfire <0-100>, /projecthero power tune ghost_rider vengeance <0-100>, /projecthero power tune ghost_rider guilt <targets> <points>.

message.projecthero.cyborg.subtitle: The Mother Box fuses with you
message.projecthero.cyborg.acquired: The Mother Box rebuilds you. You are Cyborg.
message.projecthero.cyborg.acquired_hint: Press H to project a hologram of your old self over the plates. Double-tap jump in the air to fly.
message.projecthero.cyborg.fusing: The Mother Box is rebuilding you... %s s

message.projecthero.cyborg.grapple_miss: Nothing in reach of the claw
message.projecthero.cyborg.link_nothing: Nothing in reach to link to
message.projecthero.cyborg.link_no_room: No room beside that block for the signal
