message.projecthero.cyborg.boom.low_core: Not enough Power Core for a Boom Tube (10 needed)
hud.projecthero.cyborg.title: Cyborg
projecthero.miraculous.ability.cat_noir_: Baton Strike
The baton snaps out to a staff for a fast three-hit combo -- forehand, backhand, overhead smash -- 9 damage each to everything in front. 1.5s cooldown.
Low Sweep
Drop low and sweep the staff round at the legs: 6 damage in a 3-block arc, and everything hit is tripped (knocked off its feet, Slowness IV for 3s). 3s cooldown.
Baton Extend
The baton shoots out up to 15 blocks along your look and slams the first thing it meets: 14 damage and a big knockback. 4s cooldown.
Baton Throw
Hurl the baton, spinning, up to 22 blocks: 12 damage to the first thing it hits, then it flies back to your hand. 5s cooldown.
Pole Vault

HOLD X: plant the baton (ground within 4 blocks below) and it keeps extending under you for as long as you hold X, with no limit, carrying you the way you were looking when it started extending (always at least a little upward; turning no longer steers it). Let go to be flung off the end in that direction. A wall or ceiling in the way ends it. A quick tap still gives a short vault. 6s cooldown after the fling.
Rooftop Run
Toggle: sprint 35% faster on all fours like a cat, step up 2 blocks, and hold Space against a wall to climb it, right over the top (Sneak to cling).
Baton Spin
Spin the baton like a propeller for 2s: 8 damage to everything within 4 blocks (again every 0.75s), and arrows and other projectiles are batted back. 5s cooldown.
CATACLYSM

Your hand crackles with destruction for 10s and the 3-minute countdown starts. One touch: a block and everything joined to it within 8 blocks crumbles to dust, or a creature takes 100 damage and Wither V for 7 s and its armour shatters. Once per transformation.
Cat Leap
A long pounce, 12 blocks along your look. 3s cooldown.
Pounce Strike
Leap onto the creature you are looking at (up to 24 blocks) and land on it for 12 damage. 5s cooldown.
Night Vision
Toggle cat eyes: full night vision, and every creature within 20 blocks is outlined green (only you see it).
Cat Reflexes
For 5s you sidestep the next 3 hits that come at you (blows, arrows, blasts). 15s cooldown.
message.projecthero.cat_noir.no_ground: Nothing below to plant the baton on
message.projecthero.cat_noir.cataclysm_s: Cataclysm is spent until you transform again
Hold to charge (up to 1.5s) as a blaster builds round your forearm, release to fire a blue beam: 15 damage, more knockback the longer you charge, 40 blocks. 5 Power Core.
projecthero.cyborg.ability.sonic_burst.d: The arm blaster builds and fires a 6-block cone of sound in front of you: 24 damage and a big push. 10 Power Core, 6s cooldown.
projecthero.cyborg.ability.hydraulic_pun: A piston-driven punch for 24 that breaks a raised shield. 5 Power Core, 6s cooldown.
Fire a cable up to 50 blocks: a block pulls you to it, a creature is pulled to you (no bosses). 2 Power Core, 5s cooldown.
projecthero.cyborg.ability.jet_dash.desc: The jetpack builds on your back and blasts you 20 blocks the way you are looking (up and down too), then folds away. 4s cooldown.
projecthero.cyborg.ability.hover.desc: Double-tap jump in the air: the jetpack builds on your back and you fly on energy jets from it and your boots. 18 blocks a second, 33 sprinting. Land or double-tap again to stop. 4 Power Core a second.
projecthero.cyborg.ability.arm_saw.desc: A buzzsaw builds on your forearm for 8s: +10 melee damage, and every hit knocks a raised shield aside. 5 Power Core, 15s cooldown.
projecthero.cyborg.ability.missile_barra: A launcher pops up on your shoulder and fires 8 homing micro-missiles at the creatures in front of you, 5 damage each in a small blast (no block damage). 10 Power Core, 8s cooldown.
Reach into the redstone you aim at, up to 32 blocks away. Levers flip, buttons press, doors, trapdoors and gates (iron too) open or shut, bells ring. Anything else gets full redstone power: pistons push, dispensers fire, lamps light, TNT primes, rails and dust carry it on. Tap for a 1.5s pulse, hold V to keep it powered (1 Power Core a second). 2 Power Core.
projecthero.cyborg.ability.scan.desc: For 10s, creatures within 32 blocks glow cyan and ores show through walls (only you see them), and the creature you aim at shows its health and armour. 15s cooldown.
projecthero.cyborg.ability.boom_tube.des: Opens the Boom Tube menu, like the Bifrost: type coordinates to go there in this world, or save up to 3 waypoints and travel to them from any dimension. Squadmates within 6 blocks come too. 10 Power Core, 60s cooldown.
projecthero.cyborg.ability.defense_matri: Hold C: a blue energy shield in front of you soaks up to 100 damage from the front. Let go and it drops (3s cooldown); run it dry and it breaks (15s cooldown).
projecthero.cyborg.ability.self_repair.d: Spend 3 iron ingots to heal 8 health over 4s. 30s cooldown.
message.projecthero.miraculous.fed.wayzz: Mmm, thank you. Patience and a little kelp: that is all a turtle needs.
message.projecthero.miraculous.fed.kaalk: Sugar. Adequate. I am restored, and ready to gallop once more.
message.projecthero.miraculous.tired.way: Phew... even a shell gets heavy. Some dried kelp, please?
message.projecthero.miraculous.tired.kaa: I am utterly spent. Sugar, if you please. At once.
message.projecthero.miraculous.intro.way: Hello, friend. I am Wayzz, Kwami of Protection. You have found the Turtle Bracelet.
Say "Wayzz, shell on!" in chat and you will become Carapace, the shield of your friends.
Say "Shell off!" to change back. I will be hungry after: dried kelp, please. Take your time; it is the turtle way.
message.projecthero.miraculous.intro.kaa: At last. I am Kaalki, Kwami of Teleportation, and you hold my Horseshoe Glasses.
Speak "Kaalki, full gallop!" in chat and you shall be Pegasus.
"Dismount!" returns you to yourself. Afterwards I shall require sugar. Every time, without fail.
hud.projecthero.miraculous.hungry.wayzz: Wayzz is hungry: dried kelp, or 10 of any food
hud.projecthero.miraculous.hungry.kaalki: Kaalki is hungry: sugar, or 10 of any food
projecthero.guide.carapace.tier: Hero-Tier power (Primary): the Miraculous of the Turtle
projecthero.guide.carapace.body: Wayzz, the Kwami of Protection, lives in the Turtle Bracelet. Say his phrase in chat and he turns you into Carapace, the green-shelled guardian with a great shield, with six moves on R, G, X, Z, V and C (each with a Shift version).
projecthero.guide.carapace.jewel.body: The Turtle Bracelet is one of the jewels in the Miraculous Box. Right-click it: Wayzz pops out, says hello and Carapace becomes your Primary power, replacing any other. The jewel is used up. From then on you wear the bracelet on your left wrist: dark green beads round a little turtle-shell bead, bright green while you are transformed.
projecthero.guide.carapace.kwami.body: While you are not transformed, Wayzz floats over your shoulder and goes wherever you go: caves, water, flying, riding. He looks where you look and drifts round you when you stand still. Nothing can hurt him, and if he is ever left behind he comes straight back to you. Press N to tuck Wayzz away out of sight (N again calls them back out); you can only transform while Wayzz is out. Hold Shift+N for 5 seconds to take the Miraculous off: the Kwami goes back into its jewel, which lands in your inventory (not while transformed or while the Kwami is hungry).
projecthero.guide.carapace.transform.bod: Type "Wayzz, shell on!" -- or just "Shell on!" -- in chat to transform (capitals and punctuation don't matter). Wayzz spins into the Bracelet, ribbons of green light wrap round you and, with a flash, you are Carapace. Type "Shell off!" (or "Wayzz, shell off!") to change back. H does not transform. Chat shows the phrase as the hero saying it ("<Carapace> Shell on!"), never under your own name, so nobody learns who you are.
projecthero.guide.carapace.food.body: Every time you change back (by the phrase, the countdown or dying), Wayzz is worn out and hungry, and won't transform you again until he has eaten dried kelp. Right-click him with it, or eat it while he is hungry and he eats it instead. No favourite food on you? Right-click the Kwami with 10 pieces of any other food instead (hand them over a few at a time if you like). The favourite takes 10 seconds to eat, the 10 other pieces 22 seconds, and you can transform once the meal is finished.
projecthero.guide.pegasus.tier: Hero-Tier power (Primary): the Miraculous of the Horse
projecthero.guide.pegasus.body: Kaalki, the Kwami of Teleportation, lives in the Horseshoe Glasses. Say her phrase in chat and she turns you into Pegasus, the golden rider of portals with a horseshoe, with six moves on R, G, X, Z, V and C (each with a Shift version).
projecthero.guide.pegasus.jewel.body: The Horseshoe Glasses are one of the jewels in the Miraculous Box. Right-click them: Kaalki pops out, introduces herself and Pegasus becomes your Primary power, replacing any other. The jewel is used up. From then on you wear the glasses on your face: silver-grey frames shaped like two horseshoes. Transformed, Pegasus wears his suit's turquoise goggles instead.
projecthero.guide.pegasus.kwami.body: While you are not transformed, Kaalki floats over your shoulder and goes wherever you go: caves, water, flying, riding. She looks where you look and drifts round you when you stand still. Nothing can hurt her, and if she is ever left behind she comes straight back to you. Press N to tuck Kaalki away out of sight (N again calls them back out); you can only transform while Kaalki is out. Hold Shift+N for 5 seconds to take the Miraculous off: the Kwami goes back into its jewel, which lands in your inventory (not while transformed or while the Kwami is hungry).
projecthero.guide.pegasus.transform.body: Type "Kaalki, full gallop!" -- or just "Full gallop!" -- in chat to transform (capitals and punctuation don't matter). Kaalki spins into the Glasses, ribbons of golden light wrap round you and, with a flash, you are Pegasus. Type "Dismount!" (or "Kaalki, dismount!") to change back. H does not transform. Chat shows the phrase as the hero saying it ("<Pegasus> Full gallop!"), never under your own name, so nobody learns who you are.
projecthero.guide.pegasus.food.body: Every time you change back (by the phrase, the countdown or dying), Kaalki is worn out and hungry, and won't transform you again until she has had sugar. Right-click her with it, or right-click with it in your hand while she is hungry and she has it instead. No favourite food on you? Right-click the Kwami with 10 pieces of any other food instead (hand them over a few at a time if you like). The favourite takes 10 seconds to eat, the 10 other pieces 22 seconds, and you can transform once the meal is finished.
message.projecthero.miraculous.fed.sass: Thank you. An egg, and patience: the rest follows in its own time.
message.projecthero.miraculous.tired.sas: Even a snake must rest. An egg, when you are ready... no hurry.
message.projecthero.miraculous.intro.sas: Hello. I am Sass, Kwami of Intuition. The Snake Bracelet chose you, and so do I.
Say "Sass, scales slither!" in chat and you will become Viperion, who is given a second chance.
"Scales rest!" brings you back. Afterwards I will be hungry: an egg, please. Choose wisely; time is precious.
hud.projecthero.miraculous.hungry.sass: Sass is hungry: an egg, or 10 of any food
projecthero.guide.viperion.tier: Hero-Tier power (Primary): the Miraculous of the Snake
projecthero.guide.viperion.body: Sass, the Kwami of Intuition, lives in the Snake Bracelet. Say his phrase in chat and he turns you into Viperion, the teal musician-hero with a Lyre that is a harp and a club, with six moves on R, G, X, Z, V and C (each with a Shift version) -- and Second Chance, the power to turn time back.
projecthero.guide.viperion.jewel.body: The Snake Bracelet is one of the jewels in the Miraculous Box. Right-click it: Sass pops out, says hello and Viperion becomes your Primary power, replacing any other. The jewel is used up. From then on you wear the bracelet on your right wrist: a band of green and black scales, the snake's head biting its tail, brighter while you are transformed.
projecthero.guide.viperion.kwami.body: While you are not transformed, Sass floats over your shoulder and goes wherever you go: caves, water, flying, riding. He looks where you look and drifts round you when you stand still, his tail swaying. Nothing can hurt him, and if he is ever left behind he comes straight back to you. Press N to tuck Sass away out of sight (N again calls them back out); you can only transform while Sass is out. Hold Shift+N for 5 seconds to take the Miraculous off: the Kwami goes back into its jewel, which lands in your inventory (not while transformed or while the Kwami is hungry).
projecthero.guide.viperion.transform.bod: Type "Sass, scales slither!" -- or just "Scales slither!" -- in chat to transform (capitals and punctuation don't matter). Sass spins into the Bracelet, ribbons of teal light wrap round you and, with a flash, you are Viperion: the suit coils on from the bracelet, the Lyre across your back. Type "Scales rest!" (or "Sass, scales rest!") to change back. H does not transform. Chat shows the phrase as the hero saying it ("<Viperion> Scales slither!"), never under your own name, so nobody learns who you are.
projecthero.guide.viperion.food.body: Every time you change back (by the phrase, the countdown or dying), Sass is worn out and hungry, and won't transform you again until he has eaten an egg. Right-click him with it, or right-click with it in your hand while he is hungry and he eats it instead (it is not thrown). No favourite food on you? Right-click the Kwami with 10 pieces of any other food instead (hand them over a few at a time if you like). The favourite takes 10 seconds to eat, the 10 other pieces 22 seconds, and you can transform once the meal is finished.
projecthero.guide.viperion.second_chance: Transformed, poison does not take on you. Shift+Z sets a checkpoint where you stand (a green flash, a ring on your HUD) and starts the Miraculous countdown. For the next 90 seconds Shift+Z again turns time back: you go back to the checkpoint with your health, hunger, effects, fire and air as they were then; and this reaches the WHOLE world, every dimension: your squadmates are put back the same way wherever they are; every mob returns to where it was with its health and effects then; anything killed anywhere comes back as it was (never bosses), even in a chunk that has since unloaded (it returns when the chunk loads); new hostile mobs, new drops, XP and arrows vanish; and every block broken, placed or changed is put back, chests and other containers with what was in them. Time itself goes back too: your Miraculous countdown, every move's cooldown, your moves' timers and Sass's hunger are as they were at the checkpoint, and the same for your squadmates' countdowns, cooldowns and Quirk timers. Each rewind starts the 90 seconds again. Other players are never moved, and your inventory stays as it is. Three rewinds, then it is spent. If a killing blow lands while the checkpoint is live, it rewinds by itself instead (using one). The HUD shows the rewinds left and the time left.
projecthero.guide.cyborg.body: Victor Stone, rebuilt by a Mother Box: a walking tech arsenal that builds his weapons out of his own body, works redstone from afar and travels by Boom Tube. Strong at range and in melee.
projecthero.guide.cyborg.origin.body: Use a Mother Box (the Apokolips Invasion's rare reward, or crafted from an Omega Core and Omega Shards) while you are on 4 hearts or less. It goes off in your hands -- a blast that throws and hurts the mobs round you, never you -- and leaves you raw flesh, all but part of your face, slow and weak for 20 seconds. Then it builds the Cyborg plates round you from the chest core. It replaces any other Primary power. At higher health a Mother Box still works as a personal Boom Tube.
projecthero.guide.cyborg.forms.body: You are always Cyborg: the plates, the armour and all six keys, all the time. H projects a hologram of your old skin from the light on your forehead, built over you a pixel at a time from the head down, so you look like your old self. It is only a disguise: using any move (or H again) drops it.
projecthero.guide.cyborg.core.body: The blue bar (0-100) charges 2 a second, 6 next to a block of redstone, and not at all in water. A lightning strike fills it (and does no harm).
projecthero.guide.cyborg.passives.body: Diamond-level armour with nothing worn (20 armour, 8 toughness) and +9 melee damage. No fall damage, no drowning, hunger drains at half speed, always (the hologram too). Jet Flight: double-tap jump in the air to build a jetpack and fly; land or double-tap again to stop.
projecthero.guide.cyborg.commands.body: /projecthero power grant cyborg [player], /projecthero power tune cyborg core <0-100>.
item.projecthero.scarab.tooltip: Khaji-Da. It hums when you hold it.
item.projecthero.scarab.tooltip2: Right-click to let it bond with you.
message.projecthero.scarab.already: Khaji-Da is already part of you.
message.projecthero.blue_beetle.title: BLUE BEETLE
message.projecthero.blue_beetle.subtitle: The Scarab has chosen you
message.projecthero.blue_beetle.acquired: The Scarab latches onto your spine. Khaji-Da is bonded to you.
Press H to put the armour on or take it off. Double-tap jump in the air to fly.
message.projecthero.blue_beetle.not_suit: Press H for the armour first
message.projecthero.blue_beetle.low_ener: Not enough Scarab Energy (%s needed, %s left)
message.projecthero.blue_beetle.grab_not: Nothing for the tentacles to strike there
message.projecthero.blue_beetle.camo_fly: Land first: the camouflage cannot hold while you fly
message.projecthero.blue_beetle.unleash_: Khaji-Da needs a full bar to be unleashed
hud.projecthero.blue_beetle.title: Blue Beetle
message.projecthero.khaji_da.bond.1: Do not resist. Integration in progress.
message.projecthero.khaji_da.bond.2: Neural link established. We are one now.
message.projecthero.khaji_da.suit_up.3: I am ready when you are.
Host damage critical. Retreat is advised.
You are hurt. I can only do so much.
message.projecthero.khaji_da.unleashed.1: Let me take over. Hold on.
message.projecthero.khaji_da.takeover_cl: Area secured. The body is yours again.
message.projecthero.khaji_da.warn.1: Threat nearby. Shall I deploy the armour?
projecthero.miraculous.ability.rena_roug: Flute Strike
A three-hit staff combo with the Flute: forehand, backhand, overhead. 9 damage a hit; the third knocks back.
Flute Sweep
A full 360 spin with the staff: 7 damage and a hard knockback to everything within 4 blocks. 3 s cooldown.
Flute Throw
Spin the Flute like a boomerang along a curving path up to 16 blocks out. 10 damage to everything it passes, out and back, then it returns to your hand.
Melody Lure
Play a few notes: every mob within 15 blocks walks to where you are looking for 5 s and attacks no one. 15 s cooldown.
Fox Dash
Dart 10 blocks along your look. An illusion of you stays behind for 1 s and the mobs keep attacking it. 5 s cooldown.
Illusion Swap
Trade places with your Illusion Double (or your nearest other illusion) within 48 blocks. 3 s cooldown.
Illusion Double
A copy of you fights at your side for 15 s at half your damage, and the mobs go for it. It takes 6 mob hits. 30 s cooldown.
MIRAGE
Opens a wheel of 8 illusions: pick one and play the Flute. The bubble pops into it for 30 s. Starts the 3-minute countdown. 2-minute cooldown, so twice a transformation.
Fox Camouflage
Vanish completely (armour and held items too) for up to 20 s; mobs lose you. Attacking ends it, or press again. 15 s cooldown after.
Fake Wall
Conjure a 5 x 3 wall of illusion blocks, made of the ground's own material, 3 blocks ahead. Mobs can't see through it for 10 s.
Fox Pounce
A high leap; the landing stuns every mob within 3 blocks for 2 s. 7 s cooldown.
Fox Feint
For 3 s every attack on you hits an illusion instead: it pops in where you stood and dissolves while you slip aside. 12 s cooldown.
message.projecthero.rena_rouge.pit_refus: The ground there won't give: only natural ground you may build on can open.
screen.projecthero.rena_mirage.title: Mirage
screen.projecthero.rena_mirage.hint: Move the mouse to one and click, or let go of Z. Esc: nothing spent.
screen.projecthero.rena_mirage.foxes.hin: Copies of you, a fake wall and 8 foxes that bite for you.
screen.projecthero.rena_mirage.monster.h: A giant beast rears up: everything near panics and runs.
screen.projecthero.rena_mirage.vanish.hi: Mobs lose you and your squad; copies run off to lead them away.
screen.projecthero.rena_mirage.zone.hint: Fake fire and cracks where you aim: mobs leave and won't come in.
screen.projecthero.rena_mirage.lure.hint: A heap of treasure where you aim: every mob near crowds round it.
screen.projecthero.rena_mirage.pitfall.h: A real pit where you aim, hidden by a fake floor. Mobs walk in.
screen.projecthero.rena_mirage.eclipse.h: Night round you: enemies inside can't see past 4 blocks.
screen.projecthero.rena_mirage.mirrors.h: Every enemy near sees the others as you, and they fight.
projecthero.blue_beetle.ability.plasma_b: Hold: a blaster builds itself on your arm and fires glowing plasma bolts, 3 a second, 15 damage each. 4 Scarab Energy a bolt.
projecthero.blue_beetle.ability.mega_can: Put your arms together: a big twin cannon forms over both, charges for 2s, then a huge beam pierces everything in a 30-block line for 30 damage. 50 energy, 20s cooldown.
projecthero.blue_beetle.ability.scarab_h: Your arm forms a hammer of energy and smashes it down: 20 damage to everything in a short arc in front, knocked into the air. 25 energy, 6s cooldown.
projecthero.blue_beetle.ability.scarab_g: Two tentacles shoot out of your back at what you aim at (14 blocks), strike it once each for 10 and knock it far back. 25 energy, 10s cooldown.
projecthero.blue_beetle.ability.energy_b: Toggle: your arm forms a blue energy blade (+7 melee damage while it is out); press again to fold it away. 10 energy to form.
projecthero.blue_beetle.ability.energy_s: Hold to raise a round shield on your arm: it soaks every hit and arrow from the front out of a 100-point pool (shown on the HUD) and breaks when that runs dry. No energy cost; 8s cooldown after you let go or it breaks.
projecthero.blue_beetle.ability.shield_p: The shield blasts out: everything within 6 blocks is pushed away and arrows fly back at their shooters. 30 energy, 12s cooldown.
projecthero.blue_beetle.ability.plasma_s: Slam a fist into the ground: a line of energy spikes erupts along it for 14 blocks, 18 damage each and launching what they hit. 30 energy, 8s cooldown.
projecthero.blue_beetle.ability.scarab_s: Three small scarab drones attack what you aim at (or the nearest threat) for 10s, 3 damage a bite. 35 energy, 25s cooldown.
projecthero.blue_beetle.ability.bubble_p: Traps the creature you aim at in an energy bubble for 5s: it can not move, attack or be hurt (no bosses). 30 energy, 18s cooldown.
projecthero.blue_beetle.ability.camoufla: The armour bends light: invisible, with no time limit, and mobs lose track of you. Touching, hitting or using anything, flying or using a move ends it (so does pressing it again). 30 energy; 15s cooldown after it ends.
projecthero.blue_beetle.ability.khaji_da: Needs a full bar. For 15s Khaji-Da takes over your body: it hunts down every mob hostile to you nearby (never squadmates or pets), paths to them, flies when it has to and fights with the whole kit at +50% damage, every move free and cooldowns halved. Your keys do nothing until it ends, or until nothing hostile is left. Then the bar refills at half speed for 30s. 2 minute cooldown.
projecthero.miraculous.ability.carapace_: Shield Bash
Charge 6 blocks behind the Shield. The first thing you hit takes 12 damage and is thrown back hard. 5 s cooldown.
Shield Throw
Throw the Shield spinning at what you aim at. It ricochets between up to 3 targets (10 damage each) and flies back to your arm. 6 s cooldown after the catch.
Shield Slam
Slam the Shield into the ground: a 5-block shockwave deals 10 damage and stuns for 1.5 s (bosses are only slowed). 8 s cooldown.
Taunt
Bang the Shield: every mob within 16 blocks comes for you for 6 s (not bosses), and you take 30% less damage meanwhile. 20 s cooldown.
Shield Surf
Toggle: ride the Shield like a sled. Hold forward to glide where you look, fast over ground, snow, ice and water (it floats). Steps up blocks. Press again to get off.
Shell Roll
Tuck into your shell and roll 10 blocks along your look, taking no damage at all while rolling. 8 s cooldown.
Shell Guard
Hold: the Shield up in front blocks all damage from the front and sends projectiles back at whoever fired them. Up to 10 s; 3 s cooldown after.
SHELTER
A green energy dome (radius 6) stands round you for 30 s. Nothing gets in: mobs are pushed out and projectiles stop at it. You and your squad inside regenerate. Starts the 3-minute countdown.
Shell Barrier
Raise a 5 x 3 green energy wall 3 blocks ahead for 10 s. Mobs cannot cross it and projectiles stop at it. 20 s cooldown.
Protect
A shield bubble on the player you look at (within 24 blocks), else on you: it soaks 10 hearts of damage for 15 s. 30 s cooldown.
Steadfast
Plant your feet: 8 s of knockback immunity and Resistance II. 20 s cooldown.
Tidal Swim
Swim like a turtle for 60 s: water breathing, Dolphin's Grace and much faster swimming. 90 s cooldown.
projecthero.guide.blue_beetle.body: Jaime Reyes and Khaji-Da, an alien scarab that builds weapons out of his armour on the fly. A flying all-rounder: blasters, a hammer, tentacles, spikes, a blade, a shield and tricks.
projecthero.guide.blue_beetle.origin.bod: The Scarab turns up when you brush suspicious sand: about 1 in 9 in a desert pyramid's few sands, and about 1 in 18 at an archaeologists' Dig Site (deserts and badlands -- an excavation pit with tents, a rope line and a buried blue beetle mosaic, holding 42 suspicious sand, so a fully brushed site nearly always gives one; its finds chest can hold one too). It is also rare in pyramid chests. Right-click it and it bonds with you over 5 seconds as the armour builds itself across you. It replaces any other Primary power.
projecthero.guide.blue_beetle.suit.body: H puts the armour on or takes it off: it builds itself pixel by pixel outward from the Scarab on your back, and comes apart the same way. Suited, double-tap jump in the air to fly (the glowing wings spread); land or double-tap again to stop.
projecthero.guide.blue_beetle.energy.bod: The blue bar (0-100) pays for the moves. It refills 3 a second, twice as fast standing still. Flying drains 2 a second.
projecthero.guide.blue_beetle.adaptation: Take the same kind of damage 3 times within 10 seconds and the armour adapts: that kind does 40% less to you for 60 seconds. One kind at a time; the HUD shows which.
projecthero.guide.blue_beetle.khaji_da.b: The scarab talks to you in chat now and then. Even with the armour off it warns you about monsters nearby. Unleashed (Shift+C, full bar) it takes your body over for 15 seconds and fights for you: you watch from behind until it is done.
projecthero.guide.blue_beetle.passives.b: Armoured: diamond-level armour, +9 melee damage, no fall damage, night vision, flight and Adaptation.
projecthero.guide.blue_beetle.commands.b: /projecthero power grant blue_beetle [player], /projecthero power tune blue_beetle energy <0-100>.
projecthero.quirk.hellflame.intro: Your body burns hotter than any flame. Every blast builds Body Heat: vent it, or you overheat and burn from the inside.
projecthero.quirk.overhaul.intro: Touch to take apart, touch to put back together. Moves spend Focus; take your gloves off (Shift+C) to use them.
projecthero.quirk.engine.intro: Engines in your calves. V shifts up through 3 gears (and into Recipro), Shift+V shifts down. Every other key is a kick.
projecthero.quirk.dark_shadow.intro: A living shadow at your back: small in the light, fierce in the dark. Full Shadow in the dark and it goes Berserk until light calms it.
projecthero.quirk.erasure.intro: Hold V and stare to cancel a power, any power: players, mobs, a boss's special moves. Fight with the capture scarf. Dry Eyes fills while you stare.
projecthero.quirk.explosion.intro: Your sweat is like nitroglycerin. Hold X to fly; more Sweat, bigger blasts; overdo it and your arms strain.
projecthero.quirk.zero_gravity.intro: Touch to make things weightless, Release to bring them down. Floating weight builds Nausea; at full you get sick and everything drops.
projecthero.quirk.one_for_all.intro: The stockpiled power of eight users. Twenty minutes of Power Form on the One For All timer; rest in your Base Form to fill it again.
item.projecthero.quirk_serum_random.hint: Awakens a random Quirk you don't have.
item.projecthero.quirk_suit.tooltip: Hero suit. Anyone can wear it.
message.projecthero.quirk.costume_is_sui: The hero costume is a craftable suit now: wear its pieces like armour.
message.projecthero.quirk.serum_nothing: Nothing happens. You already have that Quirk.
screen.projecthero.power_info.quirk.cost: Your hero suit is craftable: wear it like armour.
message.projecthero.calling.quirk_body: Your %s Quirk stirs. Will you rise as %s?
message.projecthero.calling.quirk_refuse: The feeling fades. Your Quirk stays dormant.
message.projecthero.calling.quirk_left: The feeling faded. Your Quirk stays dormant.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_hellflam: Hell Spider
Five thin cutting strings flick from your fingertips and sweep across your aim, 18 blocks: 9 damage to all they cross, set alight. +10 Heat.
Hell Spider: Mesh
A dome of burning strings over the aimed spot: all inside are trapped for 3 s and burn. +18 Heat.
Flashfire Fist: Jet Burn
Rocket along your aim on flame into a burning punch: 16 damage, knocked flying. Works in flight. +12 Heat.
Flashfire Fist: Prominence Burn
Hold: draw back your fist, then a huge 48-block beam of flame for as long as you hold, about 28 damage a second. Heat climbs very fast.
Flame Cloak
Toggle: you burn. Anything within 2.5 blocks takes fire damage, punches ignite, attackers burn. Heat rises slowly.
Fire Jet Flight
Hold: fly on jets from your feet and palms. Fly where you look; Space up, Sneak down, Sprint faster. Heat builds every second you fly.
Fire Wall
A 7-block wall of fire rises in front of you for 6 s: it burns all who cross it and stops arrows. +15 Heat.
Hellflame Barrage
Eight rapid fire jabs from alternating fists, each a short burst of flame: 3.5 damage a jab. +2 Heat a jab.
Fire Pillar
The ground under your target glows, then a 9-block pillar of fire erupts: 14 damage, launched and burning. +18 Heat.
Vanishing Fist
Leave a burning decoy behind (hunters lose you), reappear behind your target and strike: 16 damage. +20 Heat.
Cool Down
Dump all your Body Heat in a burst of flame and steam: up to 22 damage, 7 blocks. Works while overheated and ends it.
Plus Ultra: Full Power
For 15 s every fire move does double damage, is bigger and recharges twice as fast, and no Heat builds. Then you burn out: Heat pinned at max for 10 s.
message.projecthero.hellflame.burnt_out: Burnt out... your body can't cool yet.
message.projecthero.hellflame.burnout: Full power spent. You're burnt out.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_overhaul: Disassemble
A bare-hand touch: 18 damage as the body bursts apart. A body it kills bursts on everything near it (6). 14 Focus.
Disarm
Touch what a mob holds (or, empty-handed, its armour) and it comes apart for good. A player's is knocked from their grip instead. 20 Focus.
Ground Spikes
Palm to the floor: a jagged line of stone spikes erupts toward the target, 14 blocks: 10 damage and a toss. 18 Focus.
Spike Field
Both palms down: two rings of spikes erupt around you, 9 damage to all within 5 blocks. 28 Focus.
Terrain Surf
The ground under you breaks and reforms a step ahead: ride the wave the way you look for about 2 s, throwing aside what it runs over (5). X again: off. No fall damage. 14 Focus.
Pillar Launch
A stone pillar shoots up under you and flings you high. No fall damage for 5 s. 12 Focus.
Overhaul Strike
A low dash, bare hand out: the first enemy you touch takes 14 and is thrown. 16 Focus.
Disassemble Terrain
The floor breaks out from under everything near where you aim: each drops into a pit that closes over it, then opens again 4 s later. Not bosses. 30 Focus.
Wall Burst
The ground ahead bursts up into a 5x3 stone wall for 10 s, throwing back whatever stood there (5). 18 Focus.
Gloves
Gloves on or off (works while your focus is spent). On: no touch triggers (safe melee) and Focus refills twice as fast. Off: your moves work, and bare-handed punches disassemble (+4, 3 Focus).
Chronostasis Fusion
Absorb the ground for 20 s: bigger, stone-plated, spiked limbs and two extra arms. +8 damage, +12 armour, +2.5 reach. Again: end. 45 Focus.
Reassemble
Put back what is broken: you (or the ally you look at) to full health, debuffs gone, and the blocks blown up within 12 blocks in the last 5 minutes rebuild. Once a minute. 30 Focus.
message.projecthero.overhaul.gloved: Your gloves are on. Take them off (Shift+C) to touch.
message.projecthero.overhaul.no_ground: The ground here will not reshape.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_engine_s: Shift up a gear (1-3): faster the longer you run, hotter too. At Gear 3: Recipro Burst. Again: Recipro Extend.
Shift down a gear. In Recipro it ends it (Extend still stalls you).
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_engine_r: Gear Up at Gear 3: 10 s at double speed with blue exhaust flames.
Gear Up in Burst: 15 s even faster, then your engines stall for 6 s.
One burst dash the way you look: 7 blocks, +2 a gear.
A flip kick that launches the target straight up: 10, more at speed.
One engine-driven kick: 5 standing, up to 28 the faster you run.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_engine_s: A 360 kick: 7+ to everything within 3.5 blocks, big knockback.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_engine_k: Six rapid kicks on what is in front of you; the last knocks it back.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_engine_r: Charge the engines for half a second, then one heavy kick: 14, up to 32 at speed.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_engine_a: The heel comes crashing down: 12, slams the target down and slows it.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_engine_s: A low spinning sweep: 7 to everything in front, tripped up and slowed.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_engine_r: The ultimate: a blinding 28-block straight-line strike, 18 to all in the path. Maxes your heat.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_engine_f: A three-part combo: a kick, a spin kick, then an afterburner kick that launches the target.
message.projecthero.quirk.overloaded.dar: Dark Shadow has gone berserk! Bring it light!
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_dark_sha: Shadow Strike
It lunges out 5 to 10 blocks (further in the dark) and rakes the target for 8 x strength. In Black Ankh: a clawed dash instead.
Shadow Shield
Hold: it wraps round you, soaking 55% (daylight) to 95% (dark) of every hit from any side and every projectile. Up to 8 s.
Shadow Grab
It wraps a creature 6 to 12 blocks away in shadow, hoists it and slams it down: 9 x strength, splashing those nearby. Bosses are only struck.
Black Ankh
Toggle: it coats you as armour with a bird-skull helm and claws. +4 to +10 armour, +3 toughness, +1 reach, 3 x strength attack damage. Shadow rises half as fast.
Light Flare
Needs a light source in hand or daylight: a flash that blinds mobs in 8 blocks, ends Berserk and drops Shadow to 15. Works while berserk.
projecthero.quirk.dark_shadow.passive: Small and weak in the light, big and strong in the dark (x0.4 to x1.7). Full Shadow in the dark: Berserk until light calms it.
message.projecthero.dark_shadow.no_targe: Dark Shadow finds nothing to reach.
message.projecthero.dark_shadow.too_brig: Too bright: Dark Shadow won't break loose in the light.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_dark_sha: Dark Fang
It lunges at a target 4 to 8 blocks away and bites 4 times, 3.5 x strength each; the last bite flings it.
Abyssal Black Ankh
Toggle: Black Ankh plus great shadow wings. Glide like an elytra; in the dark the wings drive you on. No fall damage.
Fetch
Items where you look fly to you; otherwise it carries you to the block you look at (10 to 20 blocks).
Shadow Scout
It flies out up to 12 to 28 blocks along your look and marks every creature near its path with Glowing for 10 s.
Sunshine Ankh
A burst of shadow feathers all round you: 10 x strength in 4 to 8 blocks, hurling them back.
Recall
Toggle: tuck it away. No moves; Shadow drains fast and it can't go berserk. Press again to call it back.
Berserk
Darkness only: let it loose on purpose. It attacks everything near you, you included, and only light stops it.
message.projecthero.dark_shadow.recalled: Dark Shadow is recalled (Shift+V calls it back).
message.projecthero.dark_shadow.nothing_: Nothing there for Dark Shadow to fetch.
message.projecthero.dark_shadow.no_light: The flare needs a light source in your hand, or daylight.
message.projecthero.quirk.overloaded.era: Your eyes are too dry -- they won't open!
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_erasure_: Capture Bind
Whip the capture scarf round the target and tie it up: rooted 4 s. Bosses break free.
Capture Pull
Yank the bound target (or the one you look at) in to you: 3 damage.
Close Combat
A fast four-strike combo: jab, elbow, knee, then a spinning kick that sends them flying (3, 3, 4, 7).
Counter
A parry stance for 0.6 s: the next hit is caught, and a close attacker takes 8 and is tied up for 2 s.
Scarf Swing
Hold: the scarf latches a block and you swing like a grapple. Let go to fly on.
Scarf Pull
Yank yourself to the latched point: up your swing line, or to the block or creature you look at (4 on arrival).
Bind and Spin
Swing the bound (or looked-at) target round you twice on the scarf, smashing it into others (6 each), then fling it (6). Not bosses.
Disarm Throw
The scarf rips the held item out of a hand and throws it back to your feet.
Scarf Whip
A cracking lash of the scarf, 10 blocks: 5 damage and a stagger.
Goggles
Toggle: night vision, powered players and special mobs glow, your eyes can't be read, the stare locks on (it can't be dodged) and your eyes dry 25% slower.
Erasure Stare
Hold and stare: the one you look at (24 blocks) loses its powers -- hero powers, Quirks, mob specials. Dries your eyes; let go to blink.
Eye Drops
Use an Eye Drops from your inventory: Dry Eyes back to 0, shut eyes open.
item.projecthero.eye_drops.desc: Refreshes Eraser Head's Dry Eyes. Clears anyone's blurred sight.
message.projecthero.explosion.dry: Out of sweat: the blasts sputter out.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_explosio: Explosion Propulsion
Hold: palm blasts fly you. W/S along your look, A/D sideways, Space/Sneak up/down, sprint for more. Burns Sweat.
Explosion Dash
One blast behind you throws you about 12 blocks the way you look.
Stun Grenade
A blinding flash: everything within 8 blocks is blinded 5 s, slowed and loses its target.
Cool Off
Shake the sweat off: -40 Sweat and -50 Arm Strain. Works while your arms are strained.
AP Shot
A focused blast from the palm. Explodes on the first thing it hits for 10 (32 blocks).
AP Shot: Auto-Cannon
A rapid volley of 8 small AP shots, 4 each, following your aim.
Explosive Punch
Lunge in with a point-blank blast from the fist: 14 and a heavy knockback.
Blast Rush
Slam both palms down: six blasts march away along the ground, 8 each.
Cluster
Two rings of small explosions burst around you: 9 to everything close.
Howitzer Impact: Cluster
A quick spinning dive at your aim and a smaller blast: 18. Needs 20 Sweat.
Howitzer Impact
Blast up spinning, then corkscrew down at the target and detonate: 30 in a huge radius. Needs 30 Sweat.
Gauntlet Grenade
Pull the pin: all your Sweat in one cannon blast down your aim, 28 to all in its path. Needs 50. Big recoil.
message.projecthero.quirk.overloaded.zer: Too much weight... you feel sick.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_zero_gra: Zero Gravity Touch
Touch a mob, a dropped item or a block and it floats. Mobs take 2 damage and hang helpless; squadmates are just lifted. Bosses are immune.
Release
Fingertips together: everything you floated drops (fall damage from the height), floated blocks smash down, and a Meteor Shower cloud rains.
Meteor Shower
Rip up the ground round you into a rubble cloud high overhead that follows your aim. Release (or R again) rains it: 6 damage a piece.
Debris Shield
Rubble orbits you for 8 s and stops every arrow and projectile that comes near.
Float Self
Toggle: you float and glide on low gravity. Jump to rise, Sneak to sink, move keys to drift. Fills your Nausea.
Zero-G Leap
A huge, nearly weightless leap the way you look. No fall damage when you land.
message.projecthero.zero_gravity.max_flo: You can only float %s at once.
message.projecthero.zero_gravity.queasy: You feel queasy... let something go.
projecthero.quirk.ability.quirk_zero_gra: Comet Toss
Throw the floated thing nearest your aim hard at what you look at: 8 damage where it smashes. Nothing floated: touch and throw at once.
Zero Gravity Slam
Touch a mob and it shoots 7 blocks up, then you let go: it slams down for 8 damage plus its fall, 4 to anything next to it.
Gunhead Martial Arts
Jab, palm strike, then grab and throw it over your shoulder: 3, 3 and 6 damage. A floating target sails far.
Zero Gravity Field
For 5 s everything in a small area where you aim floats helplessly, mobs and items alike, then drops.
Catch
Everyone falling within 16 blocks, you too, is caught: their fall stops and they float down safely.
Settle
Let everything down safely, no fall damage, then kneel and breathe: Nausea drains fast while you stay still. Works while sick.
message.projecthero.zero_gravity.no_rubb: No loose ground to lift here.
